About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with U.S. and Canadian companies looking for experienced remote talent. For this opportunity, we are recruiting for a U.S. personal injury law firm that values experienced people who can take ownership of their caseload, communicate reliably, and keep cases moving without constant oversight. HireHawk supports globally distributed professionals with clear role expectations and dedicated team coordination.

About the Role

As a Personal Injury Pre-Litigation Case Manager, you will independently manage assigned personal injury cases through the full pre-litigation lifecycle after initial intake. This is an experienced-hire position for someone who already understands what should happen next on a PI file and can take action without step-by-step direction.

You will own case progression from opening and insurance claim setup through treatment coordination, records collection, demand preparation, settlement progression, and closing. You will have meaningful autonomy over your caseload while working within an established legal team, with additional support available for areas such as lien reductions.

Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of assigned personal injury cases from post-intake opening through settlement and case closing
  • Open insurance claims, communicate with carriers, and obtain or confirm applicable policy limits
  • Coordinate medical treatment and help clients connect with appropriate providers or specialists based on their injuries and case needs
  • Monitor treatment progression and manage cases with awareness of available insurance coverage and policy limits
  • Request, gather, track, and review medical records, bills, insurance documents, and other supporting case materials
  • Proactively identify the next steps required on each file and keep cases progressing without unnecessary delays
  • Maintain consistent communication with clients, medical providers, insurance representatives, and internal team members
  • Prepare cases for demand by organizing supporting documentation and assisting with or drafting demand packages and letters
  • Support settlement progression, including matters involving policy-limit tenders, and ensure files are properly prepared for closing
  • Assist with lien reductions when needed, with additional firm support available for this function

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • Prior hands-on U.S. personal injury pre-litigation case management experience
  • Strong working knowledge of the full personal injury pre-litigation lifecycle, with 3+ years of experience preferred
  • Proven ability to independently open, work up, progress, settle, and close personal injury cases
  • Experience opening insurance claims, investigating coverage, and obtaining or confirming policy limits
  • Strong knowledge of medical treatment coordination, medical records and bills, and ongoing case progression
  • Experience preparing PI cases for demand, including organizing documentation and assisting with or drafting demand packages
  • Strong written and verbal English, with the reliability and judgment to work independently with minimal supervision

Nice to Have:

  • Experience negotiating or assisting with lien reductions
  • Familiarity with Clio or another legal case-management platform
  • Experience handling policy-limit tenders and settlement documentation

Find your calling at Mercy!

Position Details:

Behavioral Health Information & Referral Counselor (Nights)

Location: Mercy Virtual Care Center, Chesterfield, MO
Schedule: Full-Time Nights

Position Summary

The Behavioral Health Information & Referral Counselor serves as a critical first point of contact for individuals and families seeking behavioral health services. This role provides assessment, support, education, and referral coordination for callers experiencing mental health and behavioral health concerns. Through compassionate communication and clinical judgment, the counselor connects individuals with the most appropriate treatment resources while ensuring timely care coordination and follow-up.

The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator, skilled problem-solver, and compassionate advocate who can effectively assist individuals in crisis while navigating complex behavioral health systems and community resources.

Key Responsibilities

Patient & Family Support

  • Provide support, education, and guidance to patients, families, and community members seeking behavioral health services.
  • Assess callers' presenting concerns and identify appropriate treatment options and resources.
  • Educate individuals and families on recommended services, treatment programs, and next steps for care.
  • Follow up with high-risk callers and families to encourage connection with recommended services and resources.

Referral & Care Coordination

  • Coordinate assessments and admissions by communicating clinical and financial information to care teams, providers, and admitting physicians.
  • Connect callers with appropriate internal programs and community-based resources.
  • Facilitate transfers and ensure smooth care transitions when a higher level of care is needed.
  • Maintain strong relationships with community agencies and referral partners to support access to care.

Documentation & Communication

  • Accurately document patient information, presenting concerns, referral recommendations, insurance information, and referral sources.
  • Enter and maintain information within departmental databases and systems in a timely manner.
  • Ensure clear communication and handoff information for on-call staff and team members to support continuity of care.
  • Maintain confidentiality and compliance with all privacy regulations and organizational policies.

Quality & Professional Practice

  • Maintain current and accurate referral resource information, including program details, contact information, and insurance participation.
  • Manage calls efficiently while ensuring callers receive thorough support and guidance.
  • Adhere to all safety, infection prevention, patient rights, and regulatory requirements.
  • Participate in departmental initiatives and perform additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Required Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Counseling, or a related field.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to assess, understand, and respond to behavioral health concerns with professionalism and empathy.
  • Excellent telephone assessment and customer service skills.
  • Knowledge of behavioral health services, levels of care, community resources, and insurance processes.
  • Ability to explain complex clinical and service information clearly to callers and families.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and situations.
  • Ability to work independently and make sound decisions in both routine and complex situations.
  • Proficiency with computer systems, databases, and documentation platforms.

Why Join Us?

As a Behavioral Health Information & Referral Counselor, you'll play an essential role in helping individuals and families access the behavioral health care they need. You'll be part of a collaborative team dedicated to improving lives through compassionate support, timely intervention, and meaningful connections to treatment and community resources.

Why Mercy?

From day one, Mercy offers outstanding benefits - including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, tuition support, and matched retirement plans for team members working 32+ hours per pay period.

Join a caring, collaborative team where your voice matters. At Mercy, you'll help shape the future of healthcare through innovation, technology, and compassion. As we grow, you'll grow with us.

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Sales Development Representative (SDR) to drive outbound sales, lead generation, and pipeline growth through strategic prospecting and high-volume outreach.

This is a hands-on outbound sales role for someone who is comfortable cold calling, prospecting, handling objections, and consistently booking qualified meetings.

You’ll identify target prospects, execute multi-channel outreach across phone, email, and LinkedIn, and create qualified opportunities for the sales team.

If you thrive in outbound sales, cold outreach, appointment setting, and KPI-driven environments, this role is built for you.

What You’ll Own

Outbound Prospecting & Lead Generation

  • Build targeted prospect lists using:
    • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
    • Apollo
    • ZoomInfo
    • Similar prospecting platforms
  • Research accounts and decision-makers to personalize outreach
  • Execute outbound campaigns across email, LinkedIn, and cold calling
  • Identify and engage qualified prospects
  • Generate meetings and pipeline opportunities for the sales team

Cold Calling & Appointment Setting

  • Make 30–40+ cold calls per day
  • Execute 60–100 outbound touchpoints per day
  • Communicate value clearly and confidently
  • Handle objections professionally
  • Qualify prospects based on business needs and fit
  • Book qualified meetings for Account Executives
  • Maintain consistent follow-up across active prospects

CRM & Pipeline Management

  • Maintain accurate CRM records using:
    • HubSpot
    • Salesforce
    • Zoho
    • Similar CRM platforms
  • Track outreach activity, prospect conversations, lead stages, and follow-ups
  • Keep pipeline data clean and current
  • Ensure accurate visibility into prospecting activity and outcomes
  • Maintain strong CRM hygiene and follow-through

Outreach Optimization

  • A/B test email copy, messaging, subject lines, and sequences
  • Monitor:
    • Response rates
    • Meeting conversion rates
    • Outreach performance
    • Pipeline generated
  • Identify opportunities to improve targeting and messaging
  • Continuously optimize campaigns based on performance data

Must-Have Experience & Skills

  • 1–3+ years of experience in:
    • SDR or BDR roles
    • Outbound sales
    • Appointment setting
    • Lead generation
  • Hands-on experience with cold calling and outbound prospecting
  • Experience executing multi-channel sales outreach
  • Familiarity with tools such as:
    • Apollo
    • Outreach.io
    • Salesloft
    • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
    • ZoomInfo
  • Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, or similar CRM systems
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Comfortable handling high daily outreach volumes
  • Strong objection-handling and prospect communication skills
  • Highly organized with consistent follow-up discipline
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • B2B SaaS or professional services sales experience
  • Experience prospecting into SMB and mid-market companies
  • Familiarity with SPIN, MEDDIC, or Challenger Sales
  • Experience working against meeting, activity, or pipeline quotas
  • Experience optimizing outbound sequences and messaging

Tools & Platforms

LinkedIn Sales Navigator | Apollo | ZoomInfo | Outreach.io | Salesloft | HubSpot | Salesforce | Zoho | Google Workspace

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’re confident picking up the phone and starting conversations
  • You enjoy outbound prospecting and creating opportunities from scratch
  • You’re resilient and comfortable handling rejection and objections
  • You communicate clearly and professionally
  • You thrive in KPI-driven sales environments
  • You’re disciplined about follow-ups and CRM organization
  • You understand that consistent activity drives pipeline
  • You’re motivated by measurable sales results

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start your day researching target accounts and building prospect lists, then move into dedicated cold-calling and outreach blocks.

Throughout the day, you’ll send personalized emails, engage prospects through LinkedIn, follow up across multiple touchpoints, qualify interested prospects, and book meetings for the sales team.

You’ll also update CRM activity and review outreach performance to improve future campaigns.

In short: you generate pipeline by consistently finding, engaging, and converting prospects into qualified sales opportunities.

Key Metrics for Success

  • 60–100 outbound touchpoints per day
  • 30–40+ cold calls per day
  • Qualified meetings booked
  • Outreach response rates
  • Meeting conversion rates
  • Pipeline and opportunities generated

Why This Role Stands Out

Interview Process

Apply Now

If you enjoy outbound sales, cold calling, prospecting, and building pipeline, and you’re motivated by turning outreach into qualified opportunities, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and help build a high-performing outbound sales pipeline.

Technology is no longer just an enabler of business strategy. It is the business strategy. And with AI reshaping how companies operate, compete and grow — while rapidly accelerating the pace of change — the stakes have never been higher.

What success looks like

Simprints is a nonprofit tech company with a mission to radically increase transparency and effectiveness in global development. Simprints partners with organizations like Gavi to boost immunization rates in developing countries, Ministries of Health like Ghana on pandemic response, and NGOs like BRAC to deliver maternal healthcare. Studies have shown Simprints increases impact through real-time, precision data, for example increasing maternal health visits by 38% in Bangladesh or accurate HIV tracing by 62% in Malawi. Our goal is to transform the way the world fights poverty, ensuring that every vaccine, every dollar, and every public good reaches the people who need them most.

They work closely with partners and internal teams to ensure projects are executed smoothly, meeting both technical and operational requirements to deliver maximum impact.

Are you passionate about delivering technology-driven projects that create real-world impact? Whether you specialize in project delivery, technical project management, or implementation support, we want to hear from you!

What We Do in Delivery

Our Delivery team ensures that Simprints' solutions are successfully implemented in diverse global settings. We work closely with partners to design, deploy, and scale biometric and digital identity projects, ensuring they deliver meaningful impact. From managing complex field deployments to providing technical solutions that solve real-world challenges, our team is at the forefront of making our technology work in the field.

Who We’re Looking For

We know that these are uncertain times for many professionals in the international development space, and we truly appreciate your interest in joining Simprints.

While we may not have an immediate role that aligns with your experience, we are always looking to connect with talented individuals who are passionate about using technology for social impact. By submitting your CV, you allow us to keep your details on file, and should a relevant opportunity arise, we will reach out to explore a potential fit. Thank you for considering Simprints, we appreciate the important work you do, and we hope to stay in touch.

We welcome professionals at all levels with experience in:
✔ Project & Program Management in Global Development
✔ Technical Project Management & Solutions Design
✔ Field Operations & Implementation Support

✔ Stakeholder & Partner Coordination

Experience in international development, social enterprises, or working with NGOs is a huge plus! If you're excited about delivering technology solutions that drive global change, submit your CV today—we’d love to explore how you can be part of the Simprints journey. 🚀

  • Project Delivery & Implementation: Oversee end-to-end project execution, from initial planning to deployment and impact measurement.
  • Technical Project Solutions: Work with partners to design and configure Simprints' technology to meet specific project needs.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineers, product teams, and external stakeholders to align technology with real-world use cases.
  • Training & Capacity Building: Equip partners and field teams with the knowledge and tools to successfully use Simprints' technology.
  • Problem-Solving in Challenging Environments: Navigate logistical, technical, and operational challenges to ensure seamless project execution.

Benefits

5 Reasons to Join Simprints

Life is short. We believe work should be inspirational, meaningful and fun. At Simprints, we’re taking on global development’s biggest challenges, powered by an amazing culture and incredible people. Work with us, and you will grow faster, learn more, and take on great responsibilities with the potential to make lasting change.

1. Genuine Impact. Work directly with our partners and users to deliver technology that has the potential to impact millions of lives across the globe. At Simprints, you’ll be part of a team that is passionate about driving real change.

2. An incredible, diverse team. Our work is at the intersection of technology and global development, and we’ve managed to build an amazing team drawn from all over the world. But don’t take our word for it—we’re an externally recognized Great Place to Work, part of the Flexa Top 100 Most Flexible Companies and a 2022 Best Workplace for Women.

3. Mutual Flex. We champion a work culture where autonomy and trust are paramount, steering clear of mere face-time metrics. Whether it's managing life's essentials like healthcare appointments or adapting work hours to match your peak productivity times, we've got you covered. In return, we count on your reciprocal flexibility when mission-critical moments arise, like stepping up for a crucial client discussion on a Friday or tackling unexpected technical glitches beyond regular hours.

4. Ultimate work-life balance.

    1. We offer a 4-day workweek, meaning everybody has the option to have Fridays off.
    2. We also offer unlimited annual leave, which allows you to prioritize your well-being

As long as you're driving results and fostering teamwork, we encourage you to strike that perfect balance between your professional and personal life. Our commitment to this model's success is solidified through semi-annual productivity assessments with our board, ensuring that our high standards of performance are consistently met.

5. Professional development. We promote continual learning and put our money where our mouth is with development plans and access to global experts through the GLG network

Simply provide a business case that shares your aspirations and the resources you need, and we'll do our best to support you.

We care about both your development in Simprints and your holistic long-term career goals. Simprints Alumni have gone on to work for Google, USAID, Gavi the vaccine alliance, Save the Children, and other top players.

Penguin Random House publishes more of the books people love than anyone else in the world and the Data Science team helps those books find their readers: recommendation systems that surface the right book for the right person, forecasting models that guide print runs and marketing spend, and AI-powered tools that support our publishing teams.

We're hiring a Senior AI Solutions Engineer to build the systems behind this next wave of AI work for improving operations: agentic applications, LLM-powered services, and the interfaces (e.g. MCP servers) that connect AI models and assistants to our internal data and tools. You'll work at the intersection of a world-class publishing business and the modern AI stack, and you'll own what you build all the way to production.

Specific responsibilities include:

  • Design, build, and operate LLM-powered applications and services (e.g. agentic workflows, retrieval/RAG systems, classification pipelines) over our catalog, sales, and operational data
  • Stand up and maintain MCP servers and tool integrations that connect AI models and assistants to our internal data and systems safely and reliably
  • Own services end-to-end: architecture, implementation, deployment, evaluation, and monitoring in our AWS/Databricks environment
  • Evaluate emerging AI tooling and patterns (agent frameworks, MCP, evaluation harnesses, new model capabilities), run structured pilots, and lead adoption of what works
  • Raise the team's AI engineering capability: run working sessions and internal demos, pair program with scientists, and build internal tools to help accelerate AI usage across the team.

    • Experience with cloud ML platforms (AWS, Databricks), model APIs (Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI), and vector databases
    • Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in computer science, machine learning, or a related quantitative field
    • Experience applying AI/ML to commercial problems such as demand forecasting, pricing, sales and marketing optimization, recommendation, or search
    • Background in media, publishing, or other content-rich domains
  • Demonstrated fluency with the current LLM stack: retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, prompt engineering, agentic patterns, and rigorous evaluation of generative systems
  • Strong Python engineering skills with experience in version control, testing, and CI

You’ll start with a strong focus on back-end operational work, then take on more direct customer communication as you learn the business and demonstrate proficiency.

This is a role for someone who thinks rather than simply processes. When a number, price, margin, or order does not make sense, you’ll be expected to investigate it, double-check the information, and confidently raise questions before moving forward.

Responsibilities

  • Enter and review sales orders accurately, ensuring customer, product, pricing, and order information is complete before processing.
  • Validate customer pricing against price sheets, product costs, freight charges, warehouse costs, and other relevant information.
  • Identify pricing, cost, margin, and order discrepancies before they create downstream operational or customer issues.
  • Perform basic business calculations involving percentages, costs, margins, multiplication, and division to verify order accuracy.
  • Investigate information that appears incorrect or inconsistent rather than processing it without question.
  • Escalate discrepancies and proactively communicate with the appropriate team members to reach a resolution.
  • Maintain a high level of accuracy while efficiently handling significant volumes of order and operational data.
  • Support customer inquiries professionally through email as your knowledge of the business grows.
  • Gradually handle occasional inbound and outbound customer calls once you are comfortable with the company’s products and processes.
  • Learn the company’s logistics, order management, pricing, and operational workflows well enough to recognize when something does not look right.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • Previous customer service, customer-facing, or operational support experience.
  • Advanced English proficiency across speaking, writing, and reading.
  • Strong numerical skills and confidence working with percentages, costs, margins, multiplication, division, and basic business calculations.
  • Excellent accuracy and attention to detail when comparing orders, prices, costs, spreadsheets, and other business data.
  • Ability to recognize unusual or incorrect figures and investigate them before proceeding.
  • Professional written communication skills and confidence asking questions or raising concerns when information is unclear.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in accounting, banking, finance, order processing, or another numbers- and data-intensive environment.
  • Experience entering or reviewing high volumes of sales orders or transactional information.
  • Previous exposure to logistics, warehousing, freight, or supply chain operations.
  • Experience working with spreadsheets, order management platforms, ERP systems, or similar business software.
  • Previous experience communicating with U.S.-based customers or teams.

jobs.title: Join our Talent Community as an Online Mental Health Coach!
jobs.excerpt: Join our Coach Talent Community to express interest in future coach role openings as well as to receive communication from Headspace (formerly Ginger) to stay up to date on new initiatives, webinars, job openings, and more!
jobs.description:
Join our Coach Talent Community to express interest in future coach role openings as well as to receive communication from Headspace (formerly Ginger) to stay up to date on new initiatives, webinars, job openings, and more! You can expect to hear from us about once a month in your inbox. In the meantime, check out this page to learn more about what it is like to be part of the Headspace care team.

Thank you in advance for providing your information. Though we are not currently interviewing for coaches, when a role becomes available this information can help us assess your background for future roles and fast track your application.

As a part-time mental health coach, you play an instrumental role in making the Headspace mission a reality! You will help people adapt to living healthier lives by discovering their personal strengths, motivations, and skills that will enable them to make lasting changes in their mindsets and behaviors. Coaches have regular touchpoints w/ their members to assist them in constructing attainable goals, offer support and encouragement, track successes and setbacks, and provide resources, tips and strategies to facilitate on-going progress.

Coaches are an integral part of each member’s multidisciplinary care team. They use previous clinical and/or coaching experience, good judgment, and our guidelines to discern when to refer members to a higher level of care, such as Therapy and/or Psychiatry, or other internal or external resources. You will collaborate with our psychiatrists and therapists to help develop and reinforce progress, as appropriate.

Headspace Care coaching is delivered through text-based-chat and video within the Headspace app. In addition to coaching our members, you’ll also have biweekly 1:1 supervision outside of your coaching hours and our Team Meeting recordings will be available for you to view when they are available.

Headspace coaches are ready to be part of a community working collaboratively to make mental health support accessible to everyone, no matter their background or experience.

Important Notes:

  • We provide 24/7 support to our members, this means coaches may be asked to work some holidays per year.
  • We are unable to hire licensed clinicians for this role or individuals 12 months from receiving licensure. Additionally, we are also unable to provide any type of clinical supervision towards licensure.
  • We are unable to employ candidates residing outside of the US. Due to the nature of healthcare services provided to our customers, partners and members, all work must be provided in the U.S. Data, specifically personal health information may not be accessed, disclosed or used outside of the U.S. Please note that the U.S. is limited to the 50 states of the United States -- it does not include U.S. territories like Puerto Rico.
  • Headspace also provides support to French or Spanish speaking members and has bilingual French/English and Spanish/English speaking coaches on it’s team. If you are interested in being a bilingual coach you will be required to provide text-based coaching to members in both languages, depending on member demand and scheduling. Although bilingual coaches are being hired to support the French Program or Spanish Program, due to high demand, they will be called on to provide regular coaching to our English- speaking general audience as well

Responsibilities

  • Carry a flexible caseload of members (up to 29hrs/week) and complete intakes of new members
  • Attend and respond to multiple tasks, situations and responsibilities simultaneously throughout your shift
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation and paperwork (I.e. discovery sessions, care plans, daily notes and other required paperwork)
  • Excellent communication, writing and typing skills (spelling, grammar, syntax)
  • Collaborate through notes with member's Clinical Team to collaborate on their care plan
  • Coaching support around a variety of topics such as depression, anxiety, stress management, relationships, communication, and career
  • Collect information on risk in the moment with members using the Columbia-Suicide Severity Rating Scale (C-SSRS), taking the appropriate next steps and escalating care as needed.

For Bilingual Mental Health Coaches Only: Headspace supports Spanish and French speaking members and has bilingual Spanish or French and English speaking coaches on its team. This is a part-time, W2 role and will require bilingual coaches to provide video and text-based coaching to members in both Spanish or French and English, depending on member demand and scheduling. Although bilingual coaches are being hired to support the Spanish or French Program, due to high demand, they will be called on to provide regular coaching to our English speaking general audience as well.

About You

As a Headspace Coach, You–

  • Excel at empathetic listening, building strong rapport through video and text-based chat, and providing compassionate support throughout the process of personal growth
  • Have the ability to create a sense of warmth, openness, and calmness through video and text-based chat
  • Have the ability to relate to others and connect quickly
  • Work well within a team and demonstrate exceptional interpersonal skills with colleagues
  • Are open to receiving and providing constructive feedback
  • Are adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity, novel situations and change
  • Are a strong critical and creative thinker
  • Are comfortable and have demonstrated experience with using multiple technological tools in your day-to-day; you are able to adapt and grow with technological developments quickly
  • Are a culturally responsive provider, open to and capable of working with diverse populations
  • Shows resilience, remaining calm under pressure and an ability to multi-task when necessary

Required Education and Experience

  • A minimum of two years of coaching experience, 6 months of which must have occurred with direct supervision, under a qualified, credentialed or licensed supervisor.
  • Board Certified as an NBC-HWC, and/or ICF-ACC, ICF-PCC, ICF-MCC coach
  • A minimum of two years relevant experience in the mental health industry
  • Knowledge of coaching techniques such as Motivational Interviewing, SMART goal setting, assessing stages of change/readiness, etc.
  • Ability to deliver video and text-based care, including working with multiple text/chats at once
  • Fluency in Google Suite, Zoom
  • Private, appropriately lit business environment to conduct video coaching sessions

Additional Requirements to Qualify as a Bilingual Mental Health Coach: As a Headspace Mental Health Coach who supports our Language Services Program, you are required to demonstrate proficiency in both video and text/chat across the following:

  • Understand a wide range of longer and more demanding texts and be able to speak proficiently in a video based session
  • Can recognize and respond to implicit meaning in video or text/chat form
  • Express ideas without too much searching for vocabulary or expressions
  • Effectively use the language for social, coaching and professional situations
  • Create well-structured and detailed responses on complex topics

Preferred but not required

  • MA degree in a psychology, social work, or counseling related field
  • Bilingual
  • Experience with triage and working within a team-based care model
  • Have worked with a video and text-based platform providing care in the past

Privacy Statement

All member records are protected according to our Privacy Policy. Further, while employees and contractors of Headspace (formerly Ginger) cannot access Headspace products/services, they will be offered benefits according to the company's benefit plan. To ensure we are adhering to best practice and ethical guidelines in the field of mental health, we take care to avoid dual relationships. A dual relationship occurs when a mental health care provider has a second, significantly different relationship with their client in addition to the traditional client-therapist relationship—including, for example, a managerial relationship.

As such, Headspace requests that individuals who have received coaching or clinical services at Headspace wait until their care with Headspace is complete before applying for a position. If someone with a Headspace account is hired for a position, please note their account will be deactivated and they will not be able to use Headspace services for the duration of their employment.

Further, if Headspace cannot find a role that fails to resolve an ethical issue associated with a dual relationship, Headspace may need to take steps to ensure ethical obligations are being adhered to, including a delayed start date or a potential leave of absence. Such steps would be taken to protect both the former member, as well as any relevant individuals from their care team, from impairment, risk of exploitation, or harm.

For how we will use the personal information you provide as part of the application process, please see: .

  • Establish best practices and develop pipelines and software that enable ML engineers and researchers to efficiently build and use datasets.

NLR is located at the foothills of the Rocky Mountains in Golden, Colorado is the nation's primary laboratory for energy systems research and development.

Join the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR), where world-class scientists, engineers, and experts are accelerating energy innovation through breakthrough research and systems integration. From our mission to our collaborative culture, NLR stands out in the research community for its commitment to an affordable and secure energy future. Spanning foundational science to applied systems engineering and analysis, we focus on solving complex challenges to deliver advanced, secure, reliable, and cost-effective energy solutions. Our work helps strengthen U.S. industries, support job creation, and promote national economic growth.

We offer robust professional development opportunities, and a competitive benefits package designed to support your career and well-being.



Job Description

The Power Systems Engineering Center (PSEC) at the National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL) is inviting applications for one or two internship positions to work on in the area of power systems and power electronics interfaces. This position will perform dynamic modeling and validation of power systems with high percentage of inverter-based resources and evaluate their impact on power grids. This work will be conducted at NREL’s Flatiron Campus. The researcher should have knowledge of power system stability analysis and control theory.

Job responsibilities will include:

  • Provide technical analysis related to power electronics and power systems control of renewable generation, battery energy storage systems, and large industrial drives.
  • Work under supervision to build power system EMT simulation and perform power system validation.
  • Integrating, testing, and using user-written “black box” models in PSCAD for wind turbine generators, solar inverters, battery energy storage systems (BESS), or other advanced power electronic based systems.
  • Evaluate studies that examine the impact of high percentage of inverter-based resource on power systems.
  • Writing and publishing results of analysis in peer-reviewed journals and technical reports
  • Follow all Environmental, Safety, and Health policies to ensure and maintain a safe working environment.

.

Basic Qualifications

Minimum of a 3.0 cumulative grade point average.

Undergraduate: Must be enrolled as a full-time student in a bachelor’s degree program from an accredited institution.

Graduate: Must be enrolled as a full-time student in a master’s degree program from an accredited institution.
Post Graduate: Earned a master’s degree within the past 12 months. Eligible for an internship period of up to one year.
Graduate + PhD: Completed master’s degree and enrolled as PhD student from an accredited institution.

  • Experience with power system EMT software tools such as PSCAD, MATLAB/Simulink, DIgSILENT, RSCAD, or other EMT simulation tools.
  • Solid knowledge on power system EMT modeling, power system stability and control.
  • Solid knowledge on the modeling and control of inverter-based resources.
  • Ability to present technical results to multi-stakeholder audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Coursework or project experience in power system or power electronics modeling.
  • Coursework or project experience using Python, R, or similar programming programing languages.
  • Experience with RTDS modeling and HIL testing.
  • Basic familiarity with EMTP-RV and/or EMTP-ATP.

Simprints is a nonprofit tech company with a mission to radically increase transparency and effectiveness in global development. We build ethical, inclusive digital ID powered by biometrics to verify that health, aid, and services truly reach people. Simprints partners with organizations like Gavi to boost immunization rates in developing countries, Ministries of Health like Ghana on pandemic response, and NGOs like BRAC to deliver maternal healthcare. Studies have shown Simprints increases impact through real-time, precision data, for example increasing maternal health visits by 38% in Bangladesh or accurate HIV tracing by 62% in Malawi. Today we’ve worked in over 17 countries helping deliver health, aid, and finance to >3M people. Our goal is to transform the way the world fights poverty, ensuring that every vaccine, every dollar, and every public good reaches the people who need them most.

Working in Partnerships at Simprints means shaping the future of digital identity in global development.

✔ Fundraising & Grant Writing (Institutional & Philanthropic)

✔ Government & NGO Partnerships

jobs.excerpt: At DICK’S Sporting Goods, we believe in how positively sports can change lives.
jobs.description:
At DICK’S Sporting Goods, we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

OVERVIEW:

Job Duties & Responsibilities

Portfolio & Account Leadership

  • Manage an assigned book of top-tier brand and advertiser accounts, serving as the senior point of contact and escalation resource for the team on those accounts.

  • Serve as an escalation point for Account Managers on the team, providing guidance on complex client situations, campaign issues, and relationship-sensitive decisions.

  • Shape the team's vision for what best-in-class account stewardship looks like within a retail media environment, and build the systems, processes, and talent to bring that vision to life.

People Leadership & Team Development

  • Directly manage 1-2 Account Managers, providing day-to-day coaching, performance feedback, and career development support.

  • Partner with the Director of Account Management to support staffing decisions, onboarding of new team members, and building a team culture grounded in accountability and client-first thinking.

  • Identify skill development opportunities for direct reports and support their growth through coaching, stretch assignments, and exposure to more complex accounts and situations.

  • Establish clear performance expectations, conduct regular 1:1s and performance reviews, and recognize and reward high performance consistently.

  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive team environment where knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning are embedded in how the team operates.

  • Build effective teams that apply their diverse skills and perspectives to achieve common goals by establishing common objectives and a shared mindset.

  • Manage execution responsibilities and workload of direct/indirect reports to achieve functional deliverables on time and with quality.

  • Develop talent through coaching, feedback, exposure, and stretch assignments in order to meet their own career goals as well as the organization’s priorities.

  • Establish strategic staffing and succession plans; successfully deliver on proposed staffing objectives.

  • Drive the talent selection process in alignment with the company’s talent philosophy for open direct/indirect reporting positions; Ensure all direct reports are appropriately trained and on-boarded.

  • Drive engagement by creating a climate where people are motivated to do their best to help the organization achieve its objectives; focus on voice of teammate data (e.g., Engagement & Pulse results), partnering with organization leadership to drive necessary changes.

Brand & Advertiser Campaign Stewardship

  • Ensure assigned brand and advertiser partners receive proactive, end-to-end account stewardship from pre-campaign kickoff through in-flight optimization, post-campaign wrap, and renewal planning.

  • Personally own and steward assigned top-book accounts, acting as a trusted advisor who understands each brand’s business objectives and translates them into actionable campaign strategy.

  • Model and champion a proactive service approach, surfacing insights, flagging risks, and recommending optimizations before clients identify them.

  • Drive retention and investment growth within the assigned portfolio by consistently delivering against campaign objectives and ensuring brand partners can clearly articulate the value they receive.

  • Maintain a consistent cadence of in-flight performance reviews, optimization check-ins, and post-campaign readouts that keep brand partners informed and invested in the partnership.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Internal Influence

  • Communicate weekly with internal leadership, including Media Planning, Sales, Analytics, and Product, representing the Account Management team's perspective and ensuring alignment on priorities.

  • Surface client feedback and campaign learnings to the Director of Account Management and cross-functional partners to inform process improvements and product decisions.

  • Partner closely with Media Activation to ensure campaign strategies are properly set up and executed to deliver against advertiser objectives.

  • Collaborate with the Analytics and Reporting function to ensure performance measurement frameworks, attribution methodologies, and reporting cadences serve both internal and client needs.

  • Work alongside Legal and Finance on advertiser contracts, Insertion Orders, and investment structures, ensuring commercial agreements accurately reflect the campaign structure.

  • Act as a bridge between Sales and Activation, ensuring a smooth handoff from commitment to activation and that client expectations set during the sales process are achievable and honored.

Operational Excellence & Process Development

  • Follow and contribute to account management processes, playbooks, and frameworks, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and consistency across the portfolio.

  • Hold a high-quality bar for campaign setup, in-flight monitoring, and wrap reporting on all assigned accounts, ensuring executional excellence at every stage of the campaign lifecycle.

  • Identify friction points in the client experience and proactively work with internal partners to resolve issues before they escalate.

  • Use campaign data and client feedback to continuously sharpen the quality of account stewardship, bringing learnings back to the team and to the Director.

  • Maintain strong visibility into the performance of all assigned accounts and use that data to prioritize attention, flag risks early, and surface upsell or renewal opportunities.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's Degree

  • 4 - 7 years w/4+ years of experience in account management, client services, or campaign management in a media, advertising, or retail & commerce media environment.

  • 1+ years of people management or mentorship experience, with a desire to grow as a people leader

  • Strong familiarity with digital media execution, including how campaigns are structured, trafficked, optimized, and measured across offsite and owned channels.

  • Strong communication and relationship management skills, including the ability to simplify complex campaign information for brand partners and internal stakeholders.

  • Experience managing brand or advertiser relationships directly, including navigating campaign issues, communicating performance, identifying growth opportunities.

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate cross-functionally and coordinate across Media Activation, Planning, Sales, and Reporting to deliver on campaign commitments.

  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret campaign performance data, identify trends, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams.

  • Preferred prior experience in retail or commerce media environment.

  • Preferred experience managing accounts with major national brands or advertising agencies.

  • Preferred exposure to Insertion Orders and campaign investment structures in a media or advertising context.

  • Preferred familiarity with retail media measurement, attribution methodologies, and how performance data is communicated to brand partners.

Overview

The Recruiter Liaison III (RL3) is a key member of the Host Healthcare Recruitment team and reports to the Manager of Business Optimization. The RL3 provides dedicated support to an assigned Recruiter, partnering closely to drive clinician placements, support sales goals, and ensure the efficient management of day-to-day desk operations.

This role combines sales, candidate engagement, and administrative responsibilities. The RL3 supports the recruitment lifecycle through candidate prospecting and job pitching, candidate matching and submissions, placement and extension support, pay package preparation, clinician follow-up, and database management. The RL3 also provides coverage for the assigned Recruiter during absences to maintain continuity of candidate communication and active recruitment activity.

The successful RL3 is proactive, highly organized, sales-minded, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. This individual demonstrates strong communication skills, sound judgment, attention to detail, and a commitment to providing an excellent experience for clinicians and internal partners.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with the assigned Recruiter to support achievement of placement, gross profit, and other established sales and performance goals.
  • Conduct candidate prospecting and outreach through phone, text, email, job pitching, and other approved communication methods to generate interest in available opportunities and support candidate activation.
  • Review candidate and job databases to identify potential clinician matches for priority, strategic, and fast-moving opportunities.
  • Gather required candidate information and prepare accurate, complete candidate profiles and submissions for the Account Management team.
  • Support new placements, extensions, and rebooks through clinician outreach, follow-up, and coordination with the Recruiter and internal partners.
  • Manage key administrative functions of the Recruiter’s desk, including preparation of gross profit scratch sheets, candidate and placement documentation, missing timecard follow-up, and other activities necessary to support the recruitment and placement process.
  • Provide coverage for the assigned Recruiter during planned and unplanned absences, maintaining candidate communication, managing active opportunities, and addressing time-sensitive desk needs to ensure continuity of business.
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation of candidate communications, recruitment activity, and placement information within Target Recruit and other applicable systems.
  • Collaborate effectively with Recruitment, Account Management, Contracts, Credentialing, and other internal teams to support successful clinician placements and resolve issues throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
  • Provide a high level of service to clinicians and internal partners by proactively identifying needs, resolving issues, and ensuring timely follow-up throughout the recruitment and placement process.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated interest in sales, recruiting, and candidate relationship management.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with clinicians and internal partners.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to prioritize competing responsibilities and meet established turnaround times.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
  • Self-motivated and proactive, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
  • Comfortable conducting outbound candidate outreach and discussing employment opportunities with prospective and current clinicians.
  • Ability to develop a thorough understanding of an assigned Recruiter’s desk, candidate pipeline, priorities, and business needs.
  • Proficiency with technology platforms and recruitment systems, including Target Recruit.
  • Demonstrated alignment with Host Healthcare’s core values and commitment to contributing positively to the team and organization.

About Anaconda

Be at the center of AI

Anaconda is built to advance AI with open source at scale, giving builders and organizations the confidence to increase productivity, and save time, spend and risk associated with open source. 95% of the Fortune 500 including Panasonic, AmTrust, Booz Allen Hamilton and over 50 million users rely on the value The Anaconda AI Platform delivers through a centralized approach to sourcing, securing, building, and deploying AI. Summary:

We're looking for a Senior Manager, Revenue Accounting to own the technical revenue accounting function as Anaconda scales from Python-for-data-science company to AI-native platform.

You'll build the revenue processes and technical rigor that allow us to integrate three 2026 acquisitions and scale toward Big Four audit readiness, all while the business is moving fast. This is a hands-on, high-judgment seat where your technical accounting decisions have real operational consequences, not memo-writing in a vacuum. This is an excellent opportunity for you to leverage your experience and skills and apply it to the world of data science, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.

This position reports to the Controller.


What You'll Do:
  • Own ASC 606 technical analysis for new and non-standard deals, including performance obligation identification, standalone selling price analysis, and variable consideration treatment, drafting technical accounting memos that guide how we recognize revenue
  • Determine revenue treatment and billing mechanics for three acquired businesses transitioning from QuickBooks into NetSuite, including one on AWS Marketplace, building integration processes that scale correctly from the start
  • Sit on the deal desk providing real-time revenue guidance to Sales and Legal on non-standard contracts, pricing structures, and hybrid models so deals close with proper revenue treatment baked in
  • Own the quote-to-cash process end-to-end across Salesforce, Nue CPQ, NetSuite, Anrok, and Stripe, improving handoffs and data flow with RevOps as systems evolve
  • Own monthly revenue close, including deferred revenue waterfall reconciliation, deferred commission accounting under ASC 340-40, and ACL/CECL credit loss analysis
  • Lead the revenue recognition thread of external audits, preparing technical memos, workpapers, and sample support that meet Big Four documentation standards
  • Build AI-enabled workflows for your team, such as memo drafting, reconciliation automation, and recurring reporting; that speed technical and operational work as revenue complexity scales
  • Manage and develop the revenue team; currently one direct report

Your Impact Will Be Measured Through:

  • Accuracy, timeliness, and audit-readiness of ASC 606 technical memos and revenue conclusions that guide how we structure and recognize deals
  • Clean, timely revenue recognition and billing integration for acquired businesses with minimal post-close adjustments
  • Turnaround time and quality of real-time deal desk guidance on non-standard contracts, enabling Sales to close deals faster with proper revenue treatment
  • Clean external audit results on revenue with minimal follow-up requests or restatements
  • Measurable improvement in quote-to-cash system accuracy and process efficiency through AI-enabled automation

What You Need:

  • 6+ years progressive revenue accounting experience with hands-on ASC 606 application in SaaS or subscription business models
  • CPA credential strongly preferred
  • Experience with ASC 340-40 deferred commission accounting
  • Demonstrated experience providing deal desk or real-time revenue guidance on complex or non-standard contracts
  • Hands-on experience with quote-to-cash systems including Salesforce, NetSuite, and CPQ or billing platforms such as Nue, Zuora, or Chargebee
  • External audit experience including technical memo writing and workpaper preparation that meets Big Four or national firm standards
  • Experience using AI tools to speed technical accounting or reconciliation work, with readiness to build AI-enabled workflows for a team
  • People management experience or clear readiness to manage and develop a technical accounting team
  • Multi-entity accounting experience navigating legal and operational complexity across business structures
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance
  • You embody our values of Clarity, Care and Candor
  • You care deeply about fostering an environment where people of all backgrounds and experiences can flourish
What Will Make You Stand Out:
  • You've integrated revenue systems post-acquisition or handled purchase accounting revenue implications when combining billing platforms
  • You've worked with various billing models, building 606-compliant allocation frameworks for tiered or variable pricing
  • You have Big Four or national accounting firm audit background combined with in-house SaaS operational experience, bringing both technical rigor and practical system fluency
  • You've built AI agents that automate manual review work like comparing dates, dollar amounts, addresses across systems and flags exceptions for human review while auto-approving clean transactions
  • You've worked in fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environments where you built revenue processes proactively rather than fixed mistakes reactively
  • You've worked at open-source, AI, or data science companies where technical products required creative revenue treatment
Why You'll Like Working Here:

  • Your work directly contributes to shaping the future of data science, machine learning, and AI in the enterprise

Job Title: Sr SAP Functional SAP MII/ME Consultant
Location: Remote / Global Travel Required
Experience Level: 10+ Years

Job Summary

We are seeking a Lead Functional SAP MII/ME Consultant to drive the business process design, gap analysis, and global rollout of our digital manufacturing platform. Working with a premier Aerospace & Defense client, you will act as the vital bridge between manufacturing business stakeholders and the technical engineering teams. You will own the functional blueprint for upgrading our existing SAP MII template and implementing end-to-end SAP ME solutions (excluding SCADA layer details), ensuring strict alignment with complex A&D compliance regulations.

Core Responsibilities

  • Requirements & Blueprinting: Lead global workshops to gather manufacturing requirements, map business processes, and author detailed functional specifications for SAP ME and MII.
  • SAP ME Functional Design: Configure and design SAP ME processes tailored to A&D operations, including complex routings, operation activities, shop floor orders, data collections, and non-conformance management.
  • As-Is / To-Be Analysis: Evaluate the existing global SAP MII implementation to identify optimization opportunities, manage change impact for upgrades, and seamlessly integrate new SAP ME functionality.
  • Enterprise Integration Alignment: Define the functional data flow and mapping between SAP ERP modules (PP, QM, MM, PM) and shop-floor solutions via SAP MII.
  • A&D Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all functional process designs adhere strictly to defense sector mandates, including ITAR tracking, EAR, AS9100 quality standards, and product serialization traceability.
  • Testing & Adoption: Own the creation of end-to-end testing scenarios (UAT/SIT), coordinate validation testing, and lead change management and training initiatives for plant personnel.

Qualifications

  • Functional Expertise: 10–15+ years of deep functional consulting experience within SAP ME (Manufacturing Execution) and SAP MII.
  • Domain Knowledge: Strong background in discrete manufacturing environments, specifically Aerospace & Defense or highly regulated industries.

The STAGES Sign Language Interpreter -CONTRACTOR is responsible for interpreting or transliterating all academic content to allow students who are D/HH to access instruction, communicate with other members of the school community, and participate in school-based activities. The scope of services and supports provided by the Educational Interpreter will be determined by the students’ Individualized Education Plans (IEPs). The Educational Interpreter serves as a collaborative member of a team that supports students identified as D/HH in a virtual academic environment and are fluent in American Sign Language (ASL). The Sign Language Interpreter- Contractor may be asked to obtain licensure in multiple states and serve students across multiple schools.

This is an Independent Consultant position (1099).

This is a Part-Time position.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

  • Experience using one or more signing systems in an educational setting, including American Sign Language (ASL), Manually Coded English, Conceptually Accurate Signed English (CASE), and/or Finger Spelling
  • Interpret and transliterate content presented in the live, synchronous virtual academic setting as delineated in the assigned students’ IEPs
  • Adapt language and materials to meet the individual needs of students with hearing loss
  • Collaborate with other members of the school community (e.g., general education teachers, special education teachers, caregivers, related service providers) to share information regarding students’ progress and needs, as well as to ensure services are delivered in compliance with IEPs
  • Serve as an integral member of the IEP team and attend IEP meetings
  • Provide expressive and voice interpretation of classroom instruction, clarify curricular content, support work completion, and provide language support in small groups or during one-on-one interactions
  • Interpret for school activities outside of the virtual classroom, extracurricular activities, and meetings with caregivers
  • Adhere to professional standards as outlined in the Code of Ethics of the National Registry of Interpreters for the Deaf
  • Serve as a liaison between students who are D/HH, hearing peers, staff, community members, and/or caregivers
  • Develop and maintain positive relationships with students, caregivers, and school staff
  • Be available to students, caregivers, and staff during designated work hours
  • Work from a professional home office environment, conducive to video and audio needs and a structured schedule
  • Must be self-motivated, dependable, creative, and passionate about meeting the needs of students
  • Prior experience supporting students identified as D/HH in the academic environment is desired but not required.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This position has no formal supervisory responsibilities.

MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum 1 year experience interpreting in educational environment and

Minimum 1 year experience providing interpreting services virtually

Certificates and Licenses:

National Interpreter Certification issued by the Registry of Interpreters for the Deaf and/or

State specific educational interpreter licensure

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Ability to work independently, with availability during typical school hours of at least 20 hours per week is required. Ability to maintain a professional home office without distraction during workday, typically 9 - 5 as defined by the school and time zone
  • Strong content and subject-matter knowledge
  • An ability to support and guide adults as well as students
  • Receptive to receiving coaching on a regular basis with administrators
  • Ability to embrace change and adapt to ensure excellent student outcomes
  • Ability to create and deliver staff development
  • Exceptionally strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Ability to rapidly learn and adapt to new technologies and teaching platforms
  • MS365 Proficient
  • Ability to clear required background check

WORK ENVIRONMENT: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This position is remote and open to residents of the 50 states and D.C. This is an Independent Consultant position (1099).

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

Assessment Scientist Core Responsibilities

eCOA Management (Endpoint Scale Implementation & UAT)

  • Lead scientific oversight of eCOA implementation, ensuring accurate translation of endpoint scales into digital platforms with full fidelity to protocol and scoring requirements
  • Drive development and review of eCOA specifications, partnering with vendors to deliver high-quality, fit-for-purpose system design
  • Own UAT strategy, including authoring and reviewing test scripts to validate endpoint logic, workflows, and data integrity
  • Lead end-to-end UAT execution, proactively identifying and resolving issues to ensure successful system delivery and study readiness

Scales Management & Translation

  • Lead global scale licensing and copyright strategy, ensuring compliant and efficient use of clinical outcome assessments
  • Ensure accurate scale selection, version control, and implementation aligned with protocol-defined endpoints
  • Oversee translation strategy and vendor execution, ensuring high-quality, culturally appropriate instruments across regions
  • Drive consistency across source scales, translations, and eCOA/eCRF implementations to protect endpoint integrity

Rater Training (Endpoint Reliability & Standardization)

  • Design and deliver tailored rater training programs to ensure high-quality, standardized endpoint data collection across sites
  • Define rater qualification standards and support selection of experienced, study-ready site personnel
  • Develop and deploy engaging training and certification programs to drive consistency in scale administration and scoring
  • Monitor rater performance and lead targeted remediation to minimize variability and protect endpoint reliability

Qualifications

• Graduate (e.g., MA/MS) degree in psychology/behavioral sciences, or related field preferred
• Knowledge of psychiatric and neuropsychiatric assessments, including patient reported outcome measures. Experience rating psychiatric and/or neuropsychiatric assessments preferred
• Experience within the clinical research or pharmaceutical industry
• Excellent planning/organizational skills and ability to prioritize and multitask
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, specifically: Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and spoken, with an ability to inform, influence, convince, and persuade
• Strong presentation skills, with experience presenting in professional settings.
• Ability to travel as necessary (approximately 20%).

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

jobs.description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time, including CPT/OPT.

The Data Architect will serve as a hands-on technical expert and solution architecture contributor, helping design Empower’s cloud and data architecture. This role will partner with enterprise architects, senior architects, business leaders, IT teams, and Empower’s Innovation Lab to shape solution architectures, support modernization initiatives, explore emerging technologies including Generative AI and Advanced Analytics, and translate experimentation into practical patterns and recommendations for delivery teams.

What you will do:

  • Partner with Enterprise Architects, Senior Architects, and cross functional teams, including business stakeholders, to shape solution architectures aligned to a unified IT data strategy.

  • Contribute to Empower’s technology roadmap by documenting target state architectures, reference architectures, and key dependencies for supported initiatives.

  • Design and support modernization and migration of complex systems to scalable, secure, and cost optimized cloud architectures, working with delivery teams through implementation.

  • Evaluate and prototype new technologies and applications, challenge existing approaches constructively, and provide input into business cases and recommendations.

  • Apply and help operationalize architectural standards, best practices, and governance expectations, supporting consistent adoption through guidance and enablement.

  • Collaborate closely with business and engineering teams to design end to end solutions that meet strategic, technical, and operational objectives.

  • Provide architectural guidance in process design, system orchestration, and enterprise integration to enable cohesive and efficient technology ecosystems.

  • Champion security, resilience, and scalability as core design principles across data platforms and data solutions.

  • Contribute to architecture discipline maturity by producing reusable patterns, decision documentation, and lessons learned that improve consistency and delivery speed.

  • Support full stack development teams through solution design and implementation, improving long term scalability, performance, and cost outcomes.

What you will bring:

  • Bachelor’s and/or master’s degree in computer science or related field, such as information systems, mathematics, or software engineering, or equivalent experience.

  • At least 5 years of experience delivering data-intensive solutions, for example in data engineering, analytics engineering, data platforms, BI, or related roles.

  • At least 1 year of demonstrated solution design ownership for moderately complex initiatives, gained as an architect or as a senior engineer or technical lead responsible for end-to-end design, architectural trade-offs, and guiding implementation.

  • Proven experience in multiple data focused roles, including Data Engineer, ETL/ELT, Data Architect, Database Administrator, BI or Analytics Engineer, Data Science, data governance, or a similar field.

  • Competency in architecture frameworks, performance optimization, and addressing cross cutting concerns including availability, caching, monitoring, scalability, and security.

  • Strong problem solving and strategic thinking, with the ability to influence cross functional teams and communicate architecture decisions clearly in distributed environments.

  • Strong expertise in designing data and cloud architecture, AWS preferred, supporting scalability, performance, and security with systems such as Snowflake or Redshift.

  • Proven ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights and reporting solutions that provide comprehensive and up to date information to business users.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

What will set you apart:

  • Data engineering experience designing and delivering ETL and ELT pipelines, including orchestration, data quality controls, and reliable operations for batch and near real time workloads.

  • Streaming and event driven data experience building and operating Kafka or Kinesis based architectures, including ordering, replay, schema evolution, and real time observability.

  • API and integration experience designing API first data access patterns, API lifecycle governance, versioning, security, and developer enablement, plus event driven integration patterns to reduce point to point complexity.

  • Data platform modernization experience designing large scale ingestion and processing platforms using Spark or comparable distributed compute and orchestrating reliable batch and near real time pipelines.

  • Data security and privacy experience implementing encryption, masking or tokenization, access controls, and auditability patterns for sensitive data and regulated environments.

  • Cloud cost and performance experience applying FinOps practices, workload right sizing, storage optimization, and performance engineering for cloud data platforms.

  • DevOps for data experience building CI/CD for data pipelines, infrastructure as code practices, and container platforms such as Kubernetes or EKS for data workloads.

  • Applied AI and GenAI experience designing safe enterprise patterns for retrieval, evaluation, monitoring, and responsible AI adoption.

  • Broad polyglot engineering experience with Java, microservices patterns, and third party API integrations that support data intensive services.

  • Certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Associate or Professional.

jobs.excerpt: L'équipe Produit s'agrandit ! AssessFirst, en quelques mots 👇Nous sommes une HR Tech en forte croissance, avec une mission claire : révolutionner le recrutement à l’échelle mondiale.
jobs.description:
L'équipe Produit s'agrandit !

AssessFirst, en quelques mots 👇

Nous sommes une HR Tech en forte croissance, avec une mission claire : révolutionner le recrutement à l’échelle mondiale.
Plutôt que de se baser sur le CV, nous aidons les entreprises à prédire la performance et l’épanouissement des talents grâce à l’analyse de leur personnalité, de leurs motivations et de leur capacité à apprendre.
Aujourd’hui, nous sommes plus de 110 collaborateurs et accompagnons 3 500+ clients dans plus de 40 pays, pour recruter et faire évoluer leurs équipes de manière plus inclusive et plus efficace.
Notre culture ? Ambition, impact et liberté.
Tu veux contribuer à transformer le futur du travail ? On veut te rencontrer.

Ce que tu feras :

Tu conçois et fais évoluer l'expérience AssessFirst dans son ensemble, de la compréhension du problème jusqu'à la mise en production. Tu travailles au quotidien avec notre Lead Designer, les Product Managers, les Front-end Engineers et les ML Engineers pour transformer des problématiques complexes en expériences simples, intuitives et engageantes.

Tu contribues directement aux décisions produit, tu challenges les solutions, tu prototypes rapidement et tu testes tes idées avant de les transformer en expériences utilisées à grande échelle. Une part importante du rôle consiste à imaginer les nouvelles interactions rendues possibles par l'IA : agents, copilots, interfaces conversationnelles, voice AI et expériences dynamiques ou génératives.

Tes missions :

  • Product Design : concevoir les fonctionnalités et expériences de bout en bout, de la discovery à la mise en production, en collaboration avec les Product Managers et les équipes Engineering.

  • AI-native experience : concevoir des expériences intégrant agents IA, copilots, conversational UI et voice AI, en lien avec les ML Engineers.

  • Design system et visual craft : maintenir et faire évoluer le design system AssessFirst, garantir la qualité du visual design et du motion, sur tous les supports.

  • Product building : construire des prototypes interactifs ou fonctionnels et collaborer directement avec les Front-end Engineers jusqu'à la mise en production.

  • Recherche continue : mener recherche utilisateur, tests et analyses d'usage, et mesurer l'efficacité des expériences après leur lancement.

Ta future équipe

Tu feras partie de l'équipe Product composée de 6 personnes.

Tu travailleras également en étroite collaboration avec notre Lead Designer, les Product Managers, les Front-end Engineers et les ML Engineers.

Expérience souhaitée

🎨 5+ ans d'expérience en Product Design sur des produits digitaux réellement mis en production.

🤖 Expérience sur des produits intégrant agents IA, copilots, conversational UI ou voice AI.

🧩 Expérience dans la création ou l'évolution de design systems.

📐 Solide culture produit et capacité à travailler à partir de problématiques encore peu définies.

💻 Bonne compréhension des technologies web et aisance dans la collaboration avec les équipes techniques.

🖌️ Maîtrise avancée de Figma et FigJam, notamment des composants, du prototypage et des design systems.

⚡ Utilisation régulière d'outils d'IA (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) pour accélérer la recherche, l'exploration et la conception ; appétence pour des outils comme FigmaMake, Cursor, v0, Lovable ou Framer.

🇬🇧 Anglais professionnel indispensable.

Qu'est ce que tu obtiendras ?

Fourchette salariale :60-70K fixe

Autonomie & flexibilité :tu t’organises librement selon les priorités et les projets du moment.

Full remote :travaille d’où tu veux en Europe ! 🌍

Tickets resto :carte Swile à 10 € par jour travaillé.

Mutuelle :couverture santé avec Alan.

Épargne & participation :dispositif d’épargne salariale et de participation.

Bien-être :participation à tes activités sportives, chèques cadeaux et plateforme d’avantages.

Coworking :accès à des espaces partagés jusqu’à 6 fois par mois avec Worklib.

Vie d’équipe :une culture forte et quatre séminaires par an pour se retrouver.

Notre processus de recrutement:

  1. Notre annonce te parle et te donne envie d’en savoir plus

  2. Tu remplis nos tests en ligne en postulant (tu recevras un lien par email).

  3. L'équipe Talent te contacte

  4. 3 entretiens maximum : avec Yohan (Team Lead) et Sima (UX/UI Designer), puis Kévin (Lead Developer Front) et Emeric (ton futur n+1), et enfin Quentin (CEO) et David notre fondateur !

  5. Bienvenue, tu fais désormais partie de l'équipe ! 👏
