jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager (BBS829)
jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to take full ownership of social media and paid advertising for a premier debate and speech education company serving students across Greater China and Southeast Asia.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to take full ownership of social media and paid advertising for a premier debate and speech education company serving students across Greater China and Southeast Asia. You will develop and execute content strategy, design graphics in Canva, coordinate with in-house video and design staff, run paid campaigns on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn, and drive the inquiry volume that fills enrollment.

This is an end-to-end ownership role, not a task-execution role. You will identify opportunities, chase down content from coaches and staff, set your own priorities, and build systems that produce consistent results without waiting to be told what to do next. The company has strong programs, a talented in-house creative team, and a clear market. What it needs is someone who can translate that into digital engagement and measurable inquiries across the Asian education market. If you thrive on autonomy, take pride in building things from scratch, and are motivated by seeing your work drive real enrollment conversions, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability Tuesday through Saturday, 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM Hong Kong Time — this schedule is non-negotiable given the need for real-time coordination with the Asia-based team and audience during peak engagement hours
  • Own the full digital marketing function for an established education brand with a strong reputation across Greater China and Southeast Asia
  • High-autonomy role with direct ownership over strategy, execution, and results

What You'll Work On

Content Strategy and Execution

  • Audit current social channels and develop an ambitious growth strategy focused on generating inquiries and boosting engagement across Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn
  • Generate fresh, high-converting content ideas tailored to parents and students in the target markets, with a clear understanding of what drives families to inquire about extracurricular education services
  • Serve as the primary project manager for content production — proactively chase coaches, staff, and students for raw footage, photos, testimonials, and program updates without waiting for content to come to you
  • Manage the content calendar and execute all posting and scheduling aligned with Hong Kong Time peak engagement windows

Graphic Asset Creation and Post-Production Coordination

  • Design static graphics independently in Canva for ads, carousels, stories, and promotional materials — this is a core hands-on responsibility
  • Brief and coordinate with the in-house video editing team for all video post-production needs, providing clear creative direction, assets, and deadlines
  • Collaborate with the in-house graphic designer for complex branding assets, providing clear briefs and managing timelines

Paid Advertising and Community Management

  • Plan, launch, and optimize paid ad campaigns on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn with a strict focus on cost per inquiry and enrollment conversion
  • Monitor engagement, respond to DMs and comments during core hours, and track analytics weekly to refine strategy toward inquiry generation
  • Translate educational value propositions into compelling marketing copy that resonates with families in the target markets

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Liaise with the marketing and post-production team to ensure all deliverables meet deadlines
  • Participate in daily async check-ins and weekly strategy syncs and over-communicate progress and blockers during core hours
  • Build repeatable workflows and systems that reduce dependency on manual oversight over time

What You Bring

  • Proven track record of owning digital marketing end to end with a portfolio or case studies showing where you identified a gap, built a solution, and drove measurable results with minimal direction
  • Deep understanding of Greater China and Southeast Asian education markets including Hong Kong, Singapore, and Mainland China, and how families in these regions evaluate extracurricular education services
  • Demonstrated success running paid campaigns and growing organic engagement on Facebook and Instagram targeting Asian education audiences
  • Experience coordinating with subject matter experts to extract content — comfortable following up persistently and professionally to get what you need
  • Strong Canva proficiency for creating polished, on-brand static graphics independently — video editing skills are not required
  • Inquiry-focused mindset with a genuine obsession over conversion metrics rather than vanity metrics
  • Strong written English with the ability to adapt tone for both students and parents in the target markets
  • Mandarin or Cantonese proficiency is highly valued for authentic market connection

Nice to Have

  • Background in education, tutoring, enrichment, or service-based industries
  • Experience with WeChat, Rednote (Xiaohongshu), or other regional platforms
  • Experience with CRM integration and lead tracking in Asian markets
  • Existing network or community connections in Hong Kong, China, or Singapore education circles

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A portfolio link or case studies showing digital marketing work you have owned including paid campaigns, content strategy, or social growth results — ideally with evidence of inquiry or conversion outcomes
  3. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your experience marketing to Asian education audiences, and walking through one campaign or content initiative you owned end to end and the results it produced

Only candidates who submit both a portfolio and Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are a self-directed digital marketer who understands the Asian education market, can build systems that generate consistent inquiries, and want full ownership over strategy and execution for a brand with a strong product and a clear market, this role gives you the autonomy and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.description:
Go-to-Market (GTM) Lead – B2B SaaS Product Launch & Growth

Full-Time | Remote | Flexible U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Go-to-Market (GTM) Lead to own the strategy and hands-on execution of two upcoming B2B SaaS product launches.

This is not a coordination-only role. As the first GTM hire, you’ll build the go-to-market motion from the ground up — from positioning and messaging to beta acquisition, launch campaigns, demand generation, and repeatable GTM playbooks.

You’ll work directly with leadership in an early-stage startup environment where speed, experimentation, and ownership matter.

If you’ve launched B2B SaaS products before, thrive in ambiguity, and enjoy building from zero, this role is for you.

What You’ll Own

B2B SaaS Go-to-Market & Product Launch

  • Own end-to-end GTM strategy and execution for two SaaS products
  • Build launch plans covering:
    • Positioning and messaging
    • Target audiences
    • Distribution
    • User acquisition
    • Demand generation
    • Launch campaigns
  • Personally execute GTM initiatives rather than simply managing them
  • Use insights from the first product launch to improve the second
  • Rapidly test, learn, and iterate based on market response

Beta User Acquisition

  • Identify and recruit qualified beta users and early adopters
  • Build and execute creative outbound and acquisition campaigns
  • Engage directly with prospective users
  • Develop relationships with early adopters and collect structured feedback
  • Turn user insights into improvements across messaging, targeting, and launch strategy
  • Drive early adoption and product engagement

Positioning, Messaging & Copywriting

  • Develop clear positioning for each SaaS product
  • Translate product capabilities into compelling customer value propositions
  • Build messaging around:
    • Customer pain points
    • Use cases
    • Differentiation
    • Business outcomes
  • Write high-converting copy for landing pages, emails, outreach, and launch campaigns
  • Continuously refine messaging based on customer feedback and performance data

Demand Generation & Launch Campaigns

  • Build and execute campaigns that generate awareness, users, and pipeline
  • Create:
    • Landing pages
    • Email campaigns
    • Outreach sequences
    • User onboarding flows
    • Launch materials
  • Test different channels, audiences, offers, and messaging
  • Track funnel performance and identify opportunities to improve conversion
  • Coordinate with leadership and other stakeholders to keep launches moving quickly

GTM Systems & Playbooks

  • Build GTM infrastructure from scratch
  • Document:
    • Launch processes
    • Outreach workflows
    • Messaging frameworks
    • Experiments
    • Performance insights
    • Lessons learned
  • Turn successful experiments into repeatable processes
  • Build scalable playbooks that can support future product launches

Required Experience & Skills

  • 4–8 years of experience across:
    • Go-to-Market
    • Product Marketing
    • Growth Marketing
    • Demand Generation
  • Proven experience launching at least one B2B SaaS product end-to-end
  • Experience working as an early GTM hire or in an early-stage startup environment
  • Strong understanding of SaaS positioning, messaging, and customer acquisition
  • Excellent copywriting and conversion-focused messaging skills
  • Hands-on experience executing:
    • Outreach campaigns
    • Demand generation
    • Product launches
    • User acquisition
  • Ability to build processes and systems from scratch
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to learn from campaign and user data
  • Comfortable working independently with minimal structure

Nice to Have

  • Experience as an employee #1–5 GTM hire
  • Early-stage B2B SaaS startup experience
  • Product-led growth experience
  • Experience running beta or early-access programs
  • Founder-led marketing exposure
  • Familiarity with:
    • CRM platforms
    • Marketing automation
    • Email marketing platforms
    • Landing page builders
  • Experience developing repeatable GTM playbooks across multiple launches

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’ve actually launched SaaS products, not just supported launches
  • You can move from strategy to execution without waiting for another team
  • You’re comfortable building when there is no existing playbook
  • You move quickly and iterate based on real customer feedback
  • You’re equally comfortable writing messaging, recruiting beta users, launching campaigns, and analyzing results
  • You thrive in high-ownership startup environments
  • You care more about measurable outcomes than activity

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day could start by reviewing beta acquisition and launch funnel performance, followed by refining product messaging based on user feedback.

You might then build a new outreach sequence, improve a landing page, recruit beta users, analyze campaign conversion rates, and work with leadership on the next launch experiment.

You’ll also document what worked, what didn’t, and how those learnings should influence the next campaign or product launch.

In short: you take B2B SaaS products from pre-launch to market by owning positioning, acquisition, execution, experimentation, and growth.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Successful and timely SaaS product launches
  • Qualified beta users acquired
  • Beta activation and engagement
  • Launch funnel conversion rates
  • Pipeline and demand generated
  • Customer acquisition performance
  • Speed of GTM experimentation and execution
  • Quality and scalability of GTM systems and playbooks

Why This Role Stands Out

  • First GTM hire with significant ownership
  • Build the GTM function from the ground up
  • Direct collaboration with startup leadership
  • Own launches across multiple B2B SaaS products
  • High autonomy over experimentation and execution
  • Opportunity to shape positioning, acquisition, and growth strategy
  • Growth potential into Head of Growth, Product Marketing Lead, or GTM Director

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Client Interview with Marketing Leadership
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you’ve successfully launched B2B SaaS products, know how to acquire early users, and thrive when building GTM systems from scratch, we’d love to hear from you.

Join a fast-moving startup environment where you’ll have direct ownership over how new products enter the market and grow.

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

Real Estate Acquisition Specialist

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Real Estate Acquisition Specialist to handle inbound seller leads generated through direct marketing campaigns.

This is a phone-intensive, consultative sales role focused on qualifying motivated property sellers, building rapport, evaluating opportunities, negotiating offers, and securing signed contracts. The ideal candidate has direct experience in real estate wholesaling, acquisitions, FSBO transactions, subject-to deals, or distressed property sales and understands how to navigate conversations with motivated homeowners.

You will play a critical role in converting inbound opportunities into signed contracts while maintaining a high level of professionalism, empathy, and persistence throughout the sales process.

Responsibilities

Lead Qualification & Seller Engagement

  • Answer inbound calls from property owners responding to cash buyer, foreclosure, probate, and distressed property marketing campaigns.
  • Conduct structured seller qualification calls to assess motivation, timeline, property condition, and pricing expectations.
  • Build trust and rapport with homeowners while uncovering their unique circumstances and goals.
  • Identify highly motivated sellers and determine deal viability.

Property Evaluation & Offer Negotiation

  • Conduct preliminary property evaluations over the phone.
  • Assess repair requirements, estimated after-repair value (ARV), and overall investment potential.
  • Present cash offers within company-approved acquisition guidelines.
  • Negotiate effectively with property owners to secure favorable agreements.
  • Handle objections professionally and guide sellers through the decision-making process.

Pipeline Management & Follow-Up

  • Maintain consistent follow-up with leads that do not convert during the initial conversation.
  • Manage lead pipelines to ensure opportunities remain active and engaged.
  • Update CRM records accurately and maintain complete documentation of all interactions.
  • Track seller conversations, follow-up schedules, and contract status.

Contract Execution & Team Collaboration

  • Secure signed purchase agreements from qualified sellers.
  • Coordinate with acquisitions, underwriting, and disposition teams on qualified opportunities.
  • Ensure a smooth handoff process once contracts are executed.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to maximize deal conversion and efficiency.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You have direct experience speaking with motivated property sellers and negotiating real estate transactions.
  • You understand wholesaling, acquisitions, distressed properties, and creative real estate strategies.
  • You are confident handling objections and difficult conversations over the phone.
  • You know how to balance relationship-building with performance-driven sales goals.
  • You are highly organized and disciplined with follow-up.
  • You thrive in a remote, results-oriented environment.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

  • Previous experience in Real Estate Wholesaling, Acquisitions, FSBO, Subject-To transactions, or Distressed Property Sales.
  • Proven track record of getting motivated sellers under contract.
  • Strong phone sales, rapport-building, and objection-handling skills.
  • Experience negotiating real estate transactions and purchase agreements.
  • Familiarity with ARV calculations, repair estimates, and wholesale deal analysis.
  • Experience using CRM systems and managing sales pipelines.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience working with U.S.-based real estate investors or wholesaling companies.
  • Familiarity with foreclosure, probate, tax delinquent, and distressed property lead types.
  • Experience using Podio, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or similar CRM platforms.
  • Knowledge of creative financing strategies, including Subject-To transactions.
  • Track record of consistently exceeding acquisition, contract, or sales goals.

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

Your day begins by reviewing new inbound seller leads and prioritizing follow-up opportunities. Throughout the day, you'll speak directly with homeowners, uncover motivation, evaluate property opportunities, negotiate offers, and move qualified prospects toward signed contracts.

You will maintain detailed CRM records, coordinate with internal teams regarding active opportunities, and ensure no lead falls through the cracks. Consistent follow-up is a critical part of the role, as many deals require multiple touchpoints before converting.

Success comes from building trust, understanding seller motivations, and creating win-win solutions that result in executed contracts.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary of $1,500–$2,000 USD per month.
  • Performance bonuses tied to contracts signed and closed deals.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work with a growing real estate investment team.
  • Clear performance metrics and growth opportunities.
  • Ongoing support and collaboration with experienced acquisitions professionals.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Recruiter Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Offer Stage

Job Description

The Regulatory Affairs candidate is responsible for ensuring global product compliance and adherence to applicable regulatory requirements. This role supports regulatory submissions for product marketing in international markets and contributes to maintaining compliance across the company’s IVD portfolio.

The position supports new product development by providing regulatory input and guidance throughout the product lifecycle from design and development through commercialization to ensure compliance and timely market access.

  • Responsibilities also include monitoring evolving global regulations, assessing their impact on company operations, and supporting updates to processes and documentation as needed.

  • Additional activities include maintaining regulatory documentation, assisting with post-market compliance, and contributing to internal training and continuous improvement initiatives within the Regulatory Affairs function.

  • Prepare, coordinate, and submit regulatory documentation and product registrations for key global markets, including the U.S. (FDA), EU (IVDR), Canada, LATAM, Asia-Pacific, Middle East, and MDSAP-participating countries, ensuring timely approvals and continued market access.

  • Compile, review, and maintain regulatory technical documentation, including technical files, GSPRs, and CERs, to ensure compliance with IVDR and country-specific requirements.

  • Partner with R&D, Quality, and Commercial teams to integrate regulatory requirements into product development, design control, labeling, and change control processes.

  • Ensure company-wide compliance with cGMP and established procedures by collaborating with Quality Systems on adherence to GMP/QSR, ISO 13485, and MDSAP standards.

  • Perform product risk assessments and support evaluation of complaints and non-conformances; assist with investigation and documentation.

  • Manage and support recalls, Medical Device Reporting (MDR), advisory notices, and related post-market regulatory reporting.

  • Provide strategic regulatory guidance on submission planning, global compliance strategies, risk classification, and literature research.

  • Research and interpret global regulations to assess impact and recommend actionable compliance strategies.

  • Manage product registration, listing, and licensing activities, including renewal of business licenses in global markets.

  • Develop and maintain regulatory SOPs, guidelines, templates, and training content; deliver Regulatory Affairs and company-wide regulatory compliance training.

  • Review and approve product labeling, IFUs, user manuals, SDSs, and promotional content for regulatory compliance.

  • Monitor complaint-handling systems and support CAPA management to ensure effective resolution and prevention of recurrence.

  • Track changes in global regulatory requirements and perform gap analyses to ensure continued compliance and proactive remediation.

  • Generate and manage import/export documentation and facilitate customs clearance for product distribution.

  • Lead or support global Post-Market Surveillance (PMS) activities, including complaint trend analysis, vigilance reporting, and preparation of PMS documentation in accordance with IVDR.

  • Develop and execute Post-Market Performance Follow-up (PMPF) plans to gather performance data, literature, and user feedback for integration into CERs and risk management.

  • Contribute to departmental continuous improvement initiatives to enhance process efficiency, regulatory compliance, and documentation quality.

  • Support internal and external audits and inspections by regulatory authorities and notified bodies; prepare documentation and coordinate responses to audit findings.

  • Assess the regulatory impact of product and process changes and contribute to the change control process to ensure timely and compliant implementation.

  • Coordinate with external regulatory consultants or local agents for international submissions; support budgeting and planning activities for regulatory projects.

  • Support R&D throughout the product development process, from concept and feasibility through design, verification/validation, and commercialization, to ensure regulatory requirements are met at every stage.

  • Provide ongoing regulatory support for marketed products, including evaluation of design or process changes, post-market modifications, and lifecycle management activities to maintain global compliance.

  • Practical experience in the IVD field, with a solid understanding of regulatory requirements.

  • Knowledge of compliance requirements related to IVD Regulation (EU) 2017/746, NMPA, MFDS, AMDD, and other relevant markets.

  • Familiarity with international standards and regulations applicable to IVD devices, including ISO 13485:2016, ISO 14971:2019, and MDSAP.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate and resolve regulatory issues.

  • Effective interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate within cross-functional teams.

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines with some guidance.

  • Clear oral and written communication skills appropriate for internal and external stakeholders.

  • Experience with eQMS platforms such as MasterControl, AssurX, or Veeva Vault QMS.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

  • Minimum of three years of experience in the regulated medical device, IVD, or a related industry.

  • Strong knowledge of international submissions across LATAM, the EU, Asia, and MDSAP countries.

  • Experience with antibody-based diagnostics is strongly preferred.

  • Excellent leadership, communication, and project management skills.

  • Familiarity with eQMS platforms, including MasterControl, Veeva Vault, or AssurX, is highly desirable.

  • Primarily local travel during the business day, with some out-of-area and overnight travel expected. Less than 20% travel is required.

The DRG Revenue Integrity Auditor (DRG-A) performs comprehensive Diagnostic Related Group (DRG) validation and quality audits on inpatient medical records to ensure accurate representation of each patient's clinical story.

  • Perform detailed DRG validation reviews of inpatient charts.

    • Severity of Illness (SOI)
    • Risk of Mortality (ROM)
    • Case Mix Index (CMI)
    • Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) capture
    • Other coding and reimbursement factors

    • ICD-10-CM/PCS
    • CMS Guidelines
    • MCG
    • InterQual
    • National Coverage Determinations (NCDs)
    • Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs)
    • Payer clinical policy guidelines

  • Identify documentation gaps and formulate compliant physician queries when appropriate.
  • Analyze records for coding opportunities, sequencing accuracy, and clinical support.
  • Maintain high-quality review standards while meeting productivity and quality expectations.
  • Stay current with regulatory, coding, reimbursement, and clinical documentation updates.
  • Support development of training content and educational resources.
  • Mentor and provide shadowing opportunities for new team members.
  • Assist with project analysis, reporting, and client-facing feedback initiatives.
  • Participate in internal and external audits of Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDI) programs.
  • Protect patient privacy and ensure proper handling of all PHI in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Attend required meetings, training sessions, and educational programs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Counsel - Data Protection, Privacy & Cyber Security
jobs.excerpt: Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own.
jobs.description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

Counsel - Data Protection, Privacy & Cyber Security

Position Summary

Empower is transforming how Americans experience financial services, bringing together workplace retirement, personal wealth, and innovative financial solutions to help millions of people achieve their financial goals. With that scale comes an increasingly complex and evolving regulatory environment—and an opportunity for talented lawyers to build deep expertise while working on issues that matter across the enterprise.

We are seeking a Counsel – Data Protection, Privacy & Cybersecurity" to join Empower’s Legal Department. This is an opportunity for an early-career attorney to develop expertise at the intersection of privacy, data protection, cybersecurity, anti-money laundering (AML), financial crimes, and financial services regulation while working alongside experienced attorneys and business partners across Empower.

You will provide legal research, analysis, and practical guidance on privacy and AML matters affecting Empower’s businesses, products, customers, and operations. You will work closely with colleagues across Legal, Compliance, Financial Crimes, Risk, Technology, Cybersecurity, Product, Operations, and other functions to help Empower navigate evolving regulatory requirements and implement practical solutions.

This role is well suited for an attorney who is intellectually curious, enjoys learning new areas of law, and wants meaningful responsibility and exposure early in their career. You do not need to arrive as an expert in every area—we are looking for strong legal fundamentals, sound judgment, curiosity, and someone who wants to grow.

What You Will Do

Privacy, Data Protection & Cybersecurity

  • Research, interpret, and provide legal guidance regarding federal, state, and evolving global privacy, data protection, cybersecurity, consumer protection, and related laws and regulations, including GLBA, state comprehensive privacy laws, FCRA, TCPA, CAN-SPAM, and other applicable requirements.
  • Advise business partners on privacy and data protection requirements affecting Empower’s products, services, operations, and customer interactions.
  • Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of privacy policies, notices, procedures, and other compliance frameworks.
  • Provide legal support regarding the collection, use, sharing, retention, and protection of personal information.
  • Assist with legal issues involving cybersecurity, data incidents, information security, online privacy, and evolving technology and data practices.
  • Review and draft privacy and data protection provisions in client, vendor, and other commercial agreements, and support contract negotiations and RFPs.
  • Assist with records retention and information governance matters, including interpreting legal and regulatory retention requirements.
  • Support regulatory examinations, inquiries, and other matters involving privacy, cybersecurity, data protection, and related issues.
  • Monitor emerging privacy, cybersecurity, technology, and consumer protection developments and help translate new legal requirements into practical guidance for the business.
  • Research and provide legal guidance on evolving laws, regulations, regulatory guidance, and industry standards governing artificial intelligence and other emerging technologies, including requirements relating to privacy, data use, transparency, automated decision-making, governance, and consumer protection.
  • Partner with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Risk, Technology, Cybersecurity, Product, and other stakeholders on the responsible development, procurement, and use of AI-enabled tools and applications, including helping assess legal and regulatory considerations associated with new AI use cases.

AML & Financial Crimes

  • Research and analyze federal and state laws, regulations, regulatory guidance, and industry developments relating to anti-money laundering, Bank Secrecy Act requirements, sanctions, and financial crimes.
  • Provide legal support to Empower’s Compliance and Financial Crimes teams regarding the interpretation and application of AML and related regulatory requirements.
  • Assist with legal questions involving customer identification and verification, customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, suspicious activity, sanctions screening, and other components of Empower’s financial crimes compliance framework.
  • Support the review and development of AML and financial crimes policies, procedures, controls, and governance frameworks.
  • Assist with regulatory examinations, inquiries, internal reviews, and remediation efforts involving AML and financial crimes matters.
  • Monitor legislative, regulatory, and enforcement developments and work with senior attorneys and compliance partners to assess their potential impact on Empower’s businesses and operations.
  • Partner with attorneys across the Legal Department on matters where privacy, data use, fraud prevention, AML, sanctions, and other regulatory requirements intersect.

Business Partnership & Professional Development

  • Work closely with attorneys and business partners across Empower to identify legal issues, conduct research and analysis, and develop practical, business-focused solutions.
  • Prepare legal memoranda, regulatory analyses, summaries, presentations, policies, and other materials for legal and business audiences.
  • Translate complex legal and regulatory requirements into clear, actionable guidance.
  • Develop strong working relationships across Legal, Compliance, Financial Crimes, Risk, Technology, Cybersecurity, Product, Operations, and other functions.
  • Collaborate with attorneys across the Legal Department to provide consistent, enterprise-wide legal guidance and contribute to a “one team” approach.
  • Take on increasing responsibility as your knowledge of Empower’s businesses and applicable regulatory frameworks grows.

What You Will Bring

  • Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing with a state bar.
  • 3+ years of relevant legal experience; experience may include a law firm, corporate legal department, government agency, regulator, judicial clerkship, or other relevant setting.
  • Strong legal research, analytical, writing, and problem-solving skills.
  • Interest in developing expertise in privacy, data protection, cybersecurity, AML, financial crimes, and financial services regulation.
  • Ability to understand complex legal requirements and communicate them clearly and practically to legal and non-legal audiences.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, including the ability to manage multiple matters and competing priorities.
  • Collaborative approach and willingness to work across functions and subject-matter areas.
  • Intellectual curiosity, initiative, and enthusiasm for learning new areas of law and developing new expertise.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, and integrity in handling confidential and sensitive information.

What Will Set You Apart

  • Experience or coursework involving privacy, cybersecurity, AML/BSA, financial crimes, consumer financial services, securities, banking, or other financial services regulation.
  • Familiarity with privacy and data protection frameworks, including GLBA and state comprehensive privacy laws.
  • Familiarity with the Bank Secrecy Act, USA PATRIOT Act, FinCEN regulations or guidance, OFAC sanctions requirements, or other AML and financial crimes frameworks.
  • Experience working in or with a financial services, fintech, retirement, wealth management, banking, insurance, or other regulated organization.
  • CIPP/US certification, or interest in obtaining the certification after joining Empower.
  • Demonstrated interest in emerging issues involving data, technology, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, fraud, or financial crimes.

What Sets This Role Apart:

Build broad expertise early. Privacy, cybersecurity, fraud, AML, sanctions, and financial crimes increasingly intersect. This role offers the opportunity to develop experience across these disciplines rather than being limited to a single regulatory specialty.

Learn in a business with significant scale and complexity. Empower operates across retirement and wealth and serves millions of customers. You will see how legal and regulatory requirements apply in a sophisticated financial services organization and gain exposure to issues that span products, technology, operations, compliance, and customer experience.

Have meaningful impact. You will work on real business and regulatory issues from the outset, with opportunities to take on greater responsibility as your expertise develops.

Work across the enterprise. You will collaborate with experienced professionals across Legal, Compliance, Financial Crimes, Risk, Technology, Cybersecurity, Product, Operations, and other teams, giving you broad exposure to both the legal and business sides of Empower.

Develop as a lawyer. This role is designed for someone who wants to learn. You will work with experienced attorneys and subject-matter experts while developing the judgment, regulatory expertise, and business acumen needed to become a trusted legal advisor.

How We Work at Empower

At Empower, how we work matters as much as what we accomplish. We value collaboration, transparency, shared ownership, and practical problem-solving. Our Legal team works alongside the business to help identify solutions, manage risk thoughtfully, and enable Empower to innovate and grow responsibly.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Approaches problems with curiosity and a willingness to learn.
  • Builds strong, trust-based relationships and operates with a “one team” mindset.
  • Communicates clearly and pragmatically.
  • Takes ownership while knowing when to seek guidance.
  • Exercises sound judgment and leads with integrity.
  • Welcomes different perspectives and contributes to a collaborative, inclusive environment.

Why Empower

Empower is uniquely positioned at the intersection of workplace retirement and personal wealth, creating opportunities to help millions of people navigate some of the most important financial decisions of their lives.

For a lawyer early in their career, that scale creates something equally valuable: the opportunity to learn. Privacy, technology, cybersecurity, fraud prevention, AML, and financial crimes are evolving rapidly, and Empower provides a platform to develop expertise in these areas while seeing firsthand how legal advice shapes products, operations, technology, compliance, and customer experiences.

If you are looking for a role where you can build expertise, take on meaningful responsibility, learn from experienced colleagues, and help a leading financial services organization navigate some of its most interesting emerging legal and regulatory issues, we’d like to meet you.

What we offer you

We offer an array of diverse and inclusive benefits regardless of where you are in your career. We believe that providing our employees with the means to lead healthy balanced lives results in the best possible work performance.

  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • Retirement savings – 401(k) plan with generous company matching contributions (up to 6%), financial advisory services, potential company discretionary contribution, and a broad investment lineup
  • Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250/year
  • Business-casual environment that includes the option to wear jeans
  • Generous paid time off upon hire – including a paid time off program plus ten paid company holidays and three floating holidays each calendar year
  • Paid volunteer time — 16 hours per calendar year
  • Leave of absence programs – including paid parental leave, paid short- and long-term disability, and Family and Medical Leave (FMLA)
  • Business Resource Groups (BRGs) – BRGs facilitate inclusion and collaboration across our business internally and throughout the communities where we live, work and play. BRGs are open to all.

Base Salary Range

$125,400.00 - $181,875.00

The salary range above shows the typical minimum to maximum base salary range for this position in the location listed. Non-sales positions have the opportunity to participate in a bonus program. Sales positions are eligible for sales incentives, and in some instances a bonus plan, whereby total compensation may far exceed base salary depending on individual performance. Actual compensation offered may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer.

Equal opportunity employer • Drug-free workplace

We are an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age (40 and over), race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, religion, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law.

***For remote and hybrid positions you will be required to provide reliable high-speed internet with a wired connection as well as a place in your home to work with limited disruption. You must have reliable connectivity from an internet service provider that is fiber, cable or DSL internet. Other necessary computer equipment, will be provided. You may be required to work in the office if you do not have an adequate home work environment and the required internet connection.***

Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Requirements

Mission of the role

As an AI Solutions Engineer, you will be one of Sleek's most senior individual contributors, responsible for turning AI and automation opportunities into deployed, measurable business capabilities across our Accounting, Corporate Secretarial, Compliance, Sales, Marketing, HR and Finance teams.

This is a highly hands-on role. You will take ambiguous, manual business processes from discovery and specification through coding, deployment, monitoring, support and eventual handover to the business team.

You will work closely with non-technical subject-matter experts and senior leadership to identify high-value opportunities, build practical AI solutions, and prove that they deliver measurable business value.

The role requires someone who is equally comfortable writing production code, talking to a business stakeholder, challenging assumptions, and demonstrating why an automation is worth building.

You will also take ownership of existing automations and be expected to independently diagnose and resolve technical issues rather than relying on external technical support.

Key outcomes in the first 6–12 months

Outcome 1: Deliver Production AI Automations

Lead and deliver at least 3 end-to-end business automations within the first 6 months, taking each initiative from identifying the problem through discovery, specification, development, deployment and production support.

Build against real business systems and data, including LLM APIs and SDKs, databases and warehouses, accounting APIs, Slack, document-generation workflows and scheduled jobs.

Take ownership of stabilising and improving existing automations where required, ensuring they are reliable, maintainable and supported by Sleek-owned infrastructure.

Outcome 2: Generate Measurable Business Value

Target SGD $100,000+ in annualized value across 12 months, setting clear baselines and ROI metrics before building.

Measure success holistically through cost savings, capacity released, faster turnarounds, error reduction, or revenue enablement.

Track usage, costs, and adoption from day one, regularly auditing the portfolio to scale winning solutions or stop low-impact builds.

Outcome 3: Build and Hand Over Sustainable Solutions

Design low-code/config-driven interfaces that allow non-technical teams to safely operate and update daily workflows.

Provide documentation, safeguards, and power-user training for daily ops, keeping core code and infrastructure maintained under technical scope.

Build on Sleek-owned credentials with documented fallbacks, clear rollback procedures, and no reliance on personal accounts or single-point failures.

Outcome 4: Become a Trusted AI Partner Across the Business

Build strong relationships with stakeholders across Accounting, Corporate Secretarial, Compliance, Sales, Marketing, HR and Finance across Sleek's four markets.

Independently conduct discovery with subject-matter experts, turn ambiguous requirements into practical specifications and challenge assumptions using actual business volumes and data.

Identify opportunities proactively rather than waiting for fully defined projects, and communicate technical concepts and solutions clearly to non-technical colleagues and senior leadership.

Must-have experience

  1. Production Software Engineering: 10+ years of professional technology/industry experience, including at least 4+ years of hands-on software development/coding experience. Proven experience independently building, deploying, monitoring, debugging and supporting production software.
  2. Python: Strong hands-on Python development experience is essential, with the ability to independently diagnose and resolve technical issues in production.
  3. Production AI/LLM Systems: Proven experience building and deploying LLM-based systems into production for real users. This must go beyond prompt experimentation or using AI chat tools.
  4. Agentic Development Tools: Hands-on and current experience using agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, Codex or similar tools. These should be tools the candidate actively uses rather than tools they are planning to learn.
  5. AI Automation: Demonstrable experience building AI-powered automations, agents, workflows or applications that solve real business problems.
  6. Data & Systems: Comfortable working with SQL, data warehouses, third-party APIs, file and document formats, and integrations between different business systems.
  7. End-to-End Ownership: Proven experience building a system or significant application from scratch and taking responsibility for it through production, rather than only contributing to an existing codebase.
  8. Enablement: Demonstrable experience taking a non-technical colleague or business team from little or no development experience to independently maintaining or extending a tool.
  9. Business Partnership: Experience working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand problems, gather requirements, define solutions and manage expectations.
  10. Commercial Acumen: Able to establish a business baseline, develop an ROI case and measure whether an automation has delivered genuine business value.
  11. Startup Environment: Experience working in a startup, scale-up or smaller team environment where engineers are expected to operate independently, move quickly and take broad ownership.

Must-have attributes

Ownership & Accountability: Takes full responsibility for outcomes and sees problems through to resolution. Comfortable owning a system from idea to production rather than waiting for someone else to define the next step.

Initiative & Bias for Action: A proactive self-starter who actively looks for problems worth solving and prefers to ship, learn and iterate rather than over-engineer.

Strong Communication: Personable and confident when working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Able to extract requirements from busy subject-matter experts and communicate technical concepts in plain language.

Commercial Mindset: Thinks beyond whether something can be built and asks whether it should be built. Comfortable defending an ROI case and stopping projects when the expected value is not materialising.

Curiosity & AI Enthusiasm: A genuine self-learner who actively experiments with new AI technologies and applies them to practical problems.

Structured Thinking: Able to take ambiguous problems, break them down into manageable components, establish priorities and make pragmatic decisions.

Humility: Open to feedback, willing to acknowledge knowledge gaps and comfortable learning from subject-matter experts across the business.

Resilience: Comfortable troubleshooting problems independently and working through technical or business obstacles without becoming blocked.

Nice-to-have experience

  • Experience working in a regulated, multi-jurisdiction or professional-services environment.
  • Experience in accounting, bookkeeping, corporate secretarial, compliance or fintech operations.
  • Experience working with accounting platforms or APIs such as Xero.
  • Experience with BigQuery or other cloud data warehouses.
  • Experience building integrations with Slack or similar collaboration platforms.
  • Experience with document-generation and document-processing workflows.
  • Experience building AI agents, tool-calling systems or multi-step AI workflows.
  • Experience working with evaluation frameworks, golden sets and production LLM monitoring.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek And We will be looking for candidates who have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don't know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self-awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you're more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

Attention to detail: AI systems and automations need to work reliably with real business data. You'll need to identify gaps, edge cases, errors and failure modes before they create problems for users.

Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn't their first language. For you to excel, you'll need to be present in your conversations, extract what stakeholders actually need and communicate solutions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Initiative: We are looking for someone who actively identifies opportunities rather than waiting for a fully defined project. You should be comfortable approaching a business team, understanding their problems and proposing a practical solution.

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the following interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

TA Screen: The initial interview with Talent Acquisition will assess the candidate's relevant experience, motivation, communication, ownership and practical AI experience.

Technical Interview: Candidates will be assessed on their experience building and deploying production software and AI/LLM systems.

Soft Skills Interview: A 45-60-minute interview to assess the behavioural skills.

Reference Verification: Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek.com.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You’ll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we’ve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we’ve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Position Overview

The Strategic Client Success Manager is the relationship anchor for Momentive's most strategic enterprise clients. In this role, you own the full client experience after implementation — from onboarding through long-term adoption and renewal readiness — and serve as the trusted point of contact for a defined portfolio of Tier 1 accounts. You are accountable for client health and retention, not just client satisfaction.


Position Summary

This role sits within the Account Management structure and owns the post-implementation relationship with Momentive's Tier 1 enterprise clients. You are responsible for driving measurable outcomes — product adoption, tracking & improving client health,, value realization, and gross revenue retention — across a defined portfolio of high-value accounts. You will build executive-level relationships, orchestrate cross-functional resources, and translate client goals into clear, structured success plans. You report to the Director, Account Management and work in close partnership with Account Managers, Implementation, Support, and Product to deliver one connected client experience.


It is important for us to maintain a strong connection with the core client success organization to share methods, best practices and insights gleaned from clients to drive product innovation and organization performance improvements. To ensure this connection is strong, the Director, Account Management and team will have a dotted line to the leader of Client Success


This role works collaboratively with the Account Manager and the goal is to keep and grow the client relationship.


A Day in the Life


  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for a portfolio of Tier 1 enterprise clients post-implementation, owning the full client experience from onboarding through renewal.
  • Lead structured onboarding for new enterprise clients — establish success plans, define adoption milestones, and ensure a seamless transition from implementation to sustained product use.
  • Monitor and manage client health across your portfolio, product utilization data, NPS, and stakeholder sentiment; act early when risk appears, not after a contract is already at risk.
  • Build and maintain relationships at multiple levels of the client organization, including C-suite and VP-level stakeholders, to embed Momentive as a strategic partner.
  • Lead quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with senior client stakeholders that connect product usage to the client's strategic goals and demonstrate clear value delivered.
  • Own renewal readiness for your accounts: build the case well before contract dates, flag risk early, and coordinate with the Account Manager to ensure timely, confident renewals.
  • Orchestrate cross-functional resources — Support, Product, Implementation, and Professional Services — to resolve client issues and keep accounts progressing.
  • Track and report against key outcome metrics for your portfolio: Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), health scores, NPS, and product utilization.
  • Maintain accurate account records in Salesforce, including success plans, health notes, stakeholder maps, and renewal timelines
  • Bring client feedback and portfolio-level patterns back to Product, Marketing, and Sales leadership so the roadmap and messaging reflect what enterprise clients need.
  • Partner with the Account Manager on account strategy — coordinating on accounts with both retention and growth activity and contributing to a unified account plan.
  • Build and refine scalable playbooks for onboarding, health recovery, and executive engagement that raise the bar for the entire Tier 1 segment.

We are looking for someone who brings


Experience:

  • 5+ years in Client Success, Account Management, or a client-facing role in B2B SaaS, with direct experience managing enterprise or strategic accounts.
  • A demonstrable track record of driving adoption, improving health scores, and retaining complex, high-value accounts against GRR and NPS targets.
  • Experience leading executive-level business reviews and building trusted relationships with C-suite and VP-level stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage post-implementation onboarding and build structured success plans that directly connect product use to client outcomes.
  • Comfort coordinating across internal teams — Support, Product, Implementation — to solve client problems and deliver a connected experience.
  • Experience working with associations, nonprofits, or membership organizations is a plus.

Technical/Computer Skills:

  • Salesforce or a comparable CRM, used daily to manage account health, success plans, and renewal timelines.
  • Client success platforms such as Gainsight, Totango, or ChurnZero for health scoring, lifecycle management, and portfolio reporting.
  • Comfort working with product utilization data and translating usage trends into client conversations about value and adoption.
  • Microsoft Office 365, including Excel and PowerPoint for reporting and executive-ready presentations.

Other Skills:

  • Relationship-first mindset with the ability to build trust quickly at multiple levels of a client organization.
  • Strong executive presence — comfortable facilitating senior stakeholder conversations and presenting data-driven insights with clarity and confidence.
  • Proactive, structured approach to portfolio management: you know where every account stands, what the risk is, and what the next step is.
  • Ability to synthesize complex information — client goals, product capabilities, usage data — into a clear and compelling success narrative.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to tailor messaging for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaborative internal partner: you bring the right people in at the right time to serve clients well without creating noise.
  • Willingness to travel as needed to meet with enterprise clients and support key account moments.

About Us

Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. Mission-driven nonprofits and associations rely on Momentive’s cloud-based software and services to address their most pressing challenges – from engaging their communities to simplifying operations and growing revenue. Designed to help organizations connect more, manage more, and ultimately expect more, Momentive's solutions are built with reliability at the core and strategically focus on fundraising, learning, events, careers, volunteering, accounting, and association management. Momentive partners with organizations that believe "good enough" is never enough – so they can bring on better outcomes for everyone they serve. Learn more at momentivesoftware.com.

Why Work Here?

At Momentive Software, we’re a team of passionate problem-solvers, innovators, and volunteers who believe in using technology to make a real difference. We dream big, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that help our customers drive meaningful change. If you’re looking for a place where your work matters and your ideas are valued, you’ll find it here.

401(k) Savings Plan with Company Match

Generous Sick Leave

Inclusive & Welcoming Environment

Purpose-Driven Culture

Work-Life Balance

Employer-Paid Short-Term Disability

Remote Work Flexibility

Momentive Software actively embraces diversity and equal opportunity in a meaningful way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, which is why we do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

jobs.excerpt: EBSCO Information Services (EBSCO) delivers a fully optimized research experience, seamlessly integrated with a powerful discovery platform to support the information needs and maximize the research experience of our end-users.
jobs.description:
EBSCO Information Services (EBSCO) delivers a fully optimized research experience, seamlessly integrated with a powerful discovery platform to support the information needs and maximize the research experience of our end-users. Headquartered in Ipswich, MA, EBSCO employs more than 2,700 people worldwide, with most embracing hybrid or remote work models. As an AI-enabled service leader, we thrive on innovation, forward-thinking strategies, and the dedication of our exceptional team. At EBSCO, we’re driven to inspire, empower and support research. Our mission is to transform lives by providing reliable and relevant information — when, where and how people need it. We’re seeking dynamic, creative individuals whose diverse perspectives will help us achieve this global, inclusive mission. Join us to help make an impact.

Your Opportunity

The Customer Proposals Specialist II develops accurate, compelling responses to RFPs, RFIs, and other procurement requests for EBSCO’s FOLIO Library Services Platform and related SaaS solutions. This role combines professional library experience, knowledge of library systems and workflows, strong research and writing skills, and project management to translate complex customer requirements into clear, customer-focused proposal responses. The ideal candidate understands how libraries operate and can confidently evaluate technical and functional requirements from a librarian’s perspective.

What You'll Do

  • Develop technically accurate, customer-focused responses to RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, proposals, clarifications, and other procurement documents for FOLIO and related EBSCO SaaS solutions
  • Analyze customer requirements to identify response needs, potential gaps, clarification questions, and areas requiring subject matter expert input
  • Research FOLIO capabilities, library workflows, integrations, implementation approaches, and related EBSCO solutions to develop complete and accurate proposal responses
  • Coordinate proposal projects from initial review through submission, including requirements analysis, assignments, timelines, stakeholder follow-up, document preparation, and final quality review
  • Collaborate with Sales, Product Management, Implementation, Technical Support, Information Security, Legal, and other subject matter experts to address complex functional and technical requirements
  • Translate technical product information and library systems concepts into clear, concise language focused on customer needs, workflows, and outcomes
  • Maintain reusable FOLIO and library systems content within the RFP response repository by adding new information and updating existing responses as products and capabilities evolve
  • Review proposal content for accuracy, consistency, completeness, compliance, grammar, and overall response quality

Your Team

You will be welcomed as a member of the EBSCO RFP Team and will work closely with colleagues dedicated to proposals for FOLIO and related library technology solutions, as well as Sales, Product Management, Implementation, and technical subject matter experts across EBSCO. There will be ample resources, tools, training, and support to ensure your success as a Customer Proposals Specialist II and your development and career growth at EIS

About You

  • 2+ years’ experience working in a sales or comparable corporate environment with a proven record of successful communications and/or writing experience
  • 2+ years of professional writing, research, project coordination, proposal development, or comparable experience requiring the interpretation and communication of detailed information
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects or deadlines while coordinating information and deliverables across multiple stakeholders

What sets you apart

  • Master of Library Science, Master of Library and Information Science, or equivalent graduate library degree
  • Experience implementing or migrating to an integrated library system or library services platform
  • Experience as a systems librarian, technical services librarian, electronic resources librarian, implementation librarian, or in a comparable library technology role
  • Experience in responding to RFPs, RFIs, technical questionnaires, procurement documents, or other formal customer requirements

Pay Range

USD $60,240.00 - USD $86,060.00 /Yr.

jobs.description:
Amentum is a global leader in advanced engineering and innovative technology solutions, trusted by the United States and its allies to address their most significant and complex challenges in science, security and sustainability. Headquartered in Chantilly, Virginia, we have approximately 50,000 employees in more than 70 countries across all 7 continents.

The Manager, Employee Communications & Engagementis responsible for the day-to-day execution of Amentum employee network operations, employee connection programs, CSR-related employee activation, and employee-facing communications that increase awareness and participation. Up to approximately 50% of the role is dedicated to Amentum Connect Networks, Amentum Technology Networks, Amentum Business Networks, and related CSR activations. The remaining scope supports employee engagement initiatives through communications execution, campaign and event coordination, recognition and connection activities, and program management.

The role implements established network governance and communication strategies, provides operational and editorial support to network leads, and develops high-quality content aligned with enterprise messaging, brand standards, business priorities, and employee experience goals. This position partners with the Director, Employee Engagement & Communications, the Senior Manager, Employee Engagement & Experience, Enterprise Employee Communications, Human Resources, and business stakeholders.

This is a US Remote role teleworking from home, requiring occasional travel to work on-site at Amentum’s U.S. headquarters in Virginia. U.S. Citizenship is required to apply.

Key Responsibilities

1. Employee Networks, Community Connections & CSR Activation

  • Serve as the primary operational point of contact for network leads and leadership teams, providing guidance and support for annual planning, program execution, leadership capability, and budget and expense administration.
  • Support the execution of an integrated communications strategy for enterprise employee engagement initiatives and employee networks, ensuring alignment with enterprise messaging, brand standards, and business priorities.
  • Maintain and apply approved network policies, frameworks, toolkits, guidelines, templates, membership records, reporting processes, and administrative practices to enable consistent network operations.
  • Coordinate enterprise-level network initiatives, leadership forums, events, and member engagement activities that strengthen employee connection and collaboration.
  • Provide communications guidance and editorial support to network leads, including message development, content review, and channel selection.
  • Partner with Director, Employee Communications and Engagement, to prepare c-suite executive sponsors and advisors for leadership chats, enterprise events, and network advisory activities through briefing materials, content coordination, and follow-up.
  • Partner with employee networks and CSR stakeholders to plan and activate enterprise-wide volunteerism, community impact, and giving-related initiatives aligned with enterprise priorities.
  • Monitor applicable legal, regulatory, policy, and executive order developments and implement approved changes to network guidance, communications, and operating practices in partnership with Legal, Human Resources, and other appropriate stakeholders.

2. Enterprise Employee Communications & Storytelling

  • Execute communications plans for enterprise-wide employee engagement initiatives, employee networks, CSR activities, and related events in alignment with strategies established by the Director and Enterprise Employee Communications.
  • Develop, write, edit, and distribute enterprise-wide employee communications, including emails, intranet content, leadership messages, newsletters, toolkits, presentations, event communications, and promotional materials.
  • Create clear, consistent storytelling that highlights employee achievements, network activities, recognition, community impact, and Amentum culture and values in action.
  • Partner closely with Enterprise Employee Communications to align content with enterprise messaging, editorial calendars, messaging frameworks, brand standards, accessibility requirements, and channel best practices.
  • Maintain content calendars and communication plans for assigned initiatives to support timely, coordinated execution across channels.

3. Employee Engagement Activation & Program Support

  • Support execution of enterprise employee engagement initiatives designed and led by the Director or broader Employee Engagement team.
  • Coordinate project plans, timelines, stakeholder inputs, materials, logistics, communications, and events for employee connection, recognition, appreciation, and engagement activities.
  • Support initiatives that increase employee awareness, participation, collaboration, and access to relevant career development and employee voice opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Human Resources, Talent, Learning & Development, Employee Experience, and Enterprise Employee Communications to connect assigned programs to broader workforce priorities.
  • Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships to ensure assigned programs and communications are relevant, scalable, and executable.

4. Measurement, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Track network participation, program activity, event outcomes, and communication performance using established measures and reporting processes.
  • Compile employee feedback, participation data, and communication insights supplied through programs and partner teams to identify execution improvements and inform recommendations to the Director.
  • Maintain accurate status reports, calendars, records, and dashboards for assigned network, CSR, communication, and engagement activities.
  • Identify delivery risks, dependencies, and resource constraints, and escalate issues with practical recommendations.
  • Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned.

Key Competencies, Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • ​​Program Execution: Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to organize multiple workstreams, events, timelines, and stakeholders.
  • Employee Communications: Strong writing, editing, verbal communication, and content development skills across multiple employee channels.
  • Community Building: Strong knowledge of employee networks, community programs, volunteerism, and practices that foster employee connection and participation.
  • Relationship Management: Ability to build trusted relationships with network leads, executive sponsors, communications partners, HR teams, and business stakeholders.
  • Editorial Judgment: Ability to translate business and employee needs into clear, audience-centered content while following established messaging, brand, accessibility, and review requirements.
  • Measurement: Ability to track participation and communication performance, organize data, identify trends, and recommend practical improvements.
  • Operational Excellence: Strong attention to detail, follow-through, judgment, and ability to manage sensitive information appropriately.
  • Adaptability: Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, matrixed environment with evolving priorities and requirements.
  • Influence: Ability to guide and support stakeholders without direct authority and escalate decisions appropriately.
  • Strong writing, editing, project management, facilitation, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.

Qualifications

  • Typically requires 8 or more years of experience in internal communications, employee engagement, community or network management, program management, human resources, organizational development, marketing, or a related field with Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Human Resources, Business Administration, Marketing, Organizational Development, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Experience developing employee-facing content and coordinating enterprise programs, campaigns, events, or stakeholder-driven initiatives in a complex organization.
  • Experience supporting employee networks, employee resource groups, community programs, CSR activities, or similar employee programs preferred.
  • Experience using digital communication, collaboration, intranet, event, and reporting tools.
  • U.S. Citizenship is required.
  • U.S. remote role with the ability to travel periodically, less than 10%, to the Chantilly, Virginia area to work on-site.
