jobs.description:
Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

About the Role

Arrowhead Intermediaries is looking for a Data Quality Analyst to join our Data Strategy and Business Intelligence organization. This role sits at the intersection of statistical rigor and data governance: you'll own the quality, integrity, and reliability of the data that powers our reporting, analytics, and downstream machine learning applications. You'll work closely with the Director of Data Products to define what “good data” means for our systems, then build the validation logic, controls, and investigative processes to enforce it.

This is a great fit for someone who thinks like an analyst but cares as much about why the numbers are wrong as what the numbers say, someone comfortable owning a data quality question end to end: framing it, tracing it to root cause, and communicating the fix to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Difficult data quality problems rarely have an off-the-shelf fix. We need someone who can reason from first principles: questioning assumptions about how the data was generated, tracing a discrepancy back to its source system, and building a systematic validation approach.

What You'll Do

  • Design and maintain validation rules, reconciliation processes, and quality checks across systems of record
  • Investigate data integrity issues, tracing discrepancies between platforms and systems back to root cause
  • Build and maintain data pipelines and profiling workflows in Python/R and SQL to support cleaning, structuring, and validation of incoming data
  • Partner with data engineering and BI teams to define review and approval controls for data entering reporting and analytics pipelines
  • Apply statistical methods (descriptive and inferential) to detect anomalies, quantify data quality issues, and support root cause analysis
  • Evaluate the behavior and output of machine learning or scoring models against real-world outcomes, flagging drift or inconsistency
  • Translate data quality findings into clear, actionable reporting for non-technical decision-makers and leadership
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define data quality metrics, standards, and reporting cadences across the Data Strategy and Business Intelligence organization

What We're Looking For

  • Experience with Python/R and SQL for data profiling, cleaning, and validation
  • Familiarity with statistical analysis: hypothesis framing, exploratory data analysis, interpretation of uncertainty
  • Exposure to machine learning concepts and an understanding of how model output is evaluated for quality and consistency
  • Demonstrated experience designing data validation rules, reconciliation processes, or quality controls across multiple systems of record
  • Strong root-cause investigation skills, comfortable tracing data discrepancy from symptom to source
  • A systems mindset: able to see how data flows across upstream sources, pipelines, and downstream consumers, and to spot where a fix in one place will surface problems in another
  • A first-principles approach to problem-solving: able to break an unfamiliar or ambiguous data quality issue down to its underlying causes rather than relying on standard playbooks
  • Comfortable working closely with engineering teams, whether that means partnering on pipeline changes, scoping a fix at its source, or translating a data quality issue into something an engineer can act on
  • Visualization and communication skills (Matplotlib, ggplot, and/or Power BI) to make findings accessible to non-technical audiences
  • Experience with AI tooling and LLM-based workflows (e.g., Claude, GPT) is important

A background in data science, analytics, or a related field, formal training or eq

Pay Range

$80,000.00 - $95,000.00 Annual

The pay range provided above is made in good faith and based on our lowest and highest annual salary or hourly rate paid for the role and takes into account years of experience required, geography, and/or budget for the role.

jobs.description:
Own the Process. Earn Like You Matter.

Most mortgage companies treat processors like back-office support. At Griffin Funding, you're the operator who makes million-dollar deals close, and you're paid like it.

What You'll Actually Make

Our processors fund 15-20 Non-QM loans per month and earn $3,750–$5,000 in bonuses on top of their base salary. Strong performers consistently earn $10,000+ per month. Your bonus isn't just volume. It's tied to pull-through, borrower experience, and five-star reviews. Clean execution pays.

What Makes This Role Different

You're not a document collector. You're pre-underwriting every file before submission. You're catching guideline conflicts, income calculation errors, and property issues before underwriting does. You're thinking two steps ahead on every loan.

You handle complexity that most processors never see. Bank statement income. P&L programs. DSCR investor loans. Multiple property scenarios. Self-employed borrowers with variable comp. This isn't cookie-cutter Fannie Mae processing. You're building real expertise.

Your opinion matters. When a loan officer brings you a marginal deal, you're the one who tells them if it works or not. You know the guidelines. You know what underwriting will flag. You're a strategic partner.

What We're Looking For

Experience that counts. 2+ years of processing residential loans in NON-QM Loans, specifically DSCR & Bank Statement loans within the past 2 years. You've worked in an LOS, you can read a credit report in 60 seconds, and you know the difference between program guidelines and investor overlays.

You pre-underwrite in your sleep. You catch DTI errors before they become conditions. You spot income calculation mistakes in the application. You know when an appraisal will come in, short before it's even ordered. You review files the way underwriters think.

You calculate complex income correctly. Self-employed? You're pulling 1040s, Schedules C, K-1s, and depreciation addbacks. Variable comp? You're averaging it correctly and documenting the stability. Bank statements? You're applying the right percentage and structuring it according to the guidelines. Rental income? You know when to use actuals vs. market rent and which investor accepts what.

You solve problems, not create them. When something's missing, you find it. When guidelines conflict, you figure it out. When underwriting pushes back, you know if they're right or if you need to resubmit with clarification.

You communicate like a professional. Borrowers aren't confused by your requests. Loan officers aren't chasing you for updates. You explain what you need, why you need it, and when it's due.

You want to get better. You're not here to process the same file 1,000 times. You want to learn DSCR. You want to master Non-QM overlays. You want to become the processor that loan officers fight to work with because you make their deals close.

Why Processors Stay at Griffin

Non-QM expertise builds your resume. Most processors never touch investor products, complex income scenarios, or Non-QM programs. Here, it's your daily work. You're becoming the processor other companies will pay a premium for.

Performance-based pay that's actually fair. Your bonus is tied to funded volume, pull-through rate, and borrower reviews. Close clean files, keep deals moving, deliver great experiences get paid accordingly.

Systems that don't fight you. Organized pipelines. Dedicated support for title, appraisal, and conditions tracking. Technology that actually helps. You spend your time processing, not fixing broken workflows.

Advancement built into the structure. Senior processor. Non-QM product specialist. Processing trainer. Operations leadership. We aim to promote the people who've proven they can run the system at a high level.

A culture that respects execution. Loan officers know they don't close without you. Leadership knows you're the quality control between a submitted file and a funded loan. Borrowers leave five-star reviews because you kept them informed and made it smooth. Your work is visible, valued, and compensated accordingly.

What We Expect From Day One

You take ownership. Your files are your responsibility. You know what's in your pipeline, what's at risk, and what's funding this week.

We're a referral-based company. 1st party SEO driven leads. Every file you touch reflects on Griffin Funding's reputation. Clean files build trust with realtors, financial advisors, and CPAs who refer their clients to us. And repeat/ referral business!

You stay humble and keep learning. Guidelines change. Investors update overlays. New loan programs roll out. You don't coast on what you knew last year.

Ready to Process at a Higher Level?

Most processors spend their careers managing chaos, hoping to survive the day. At Griffin Funding, you'll manage complexity, earn what you're worth, and build expertise that makes you one of the best in the business.

Strategic. Highly Compensated. That's processing at Griffin Funding.

jobs.description:
About the opportunity

VictoriaMetrics is a fast-growing company revolutionizing open-source monitoring and observability solutions. We’re trusted by enterprises and the open-source community alike to provide high-performance, scalable solutions. We operate in a dynamic, startup environment where innovation and customer satisfaction are at the core of what we do.

As our Support Department evolves, we are looking for a highly skilled and motivated VictoriaMetrics Expert to join our Expertise Center team. This role is for an experienced specialist with a strong background in development and/or high-level systems engineering. We need a specialist with a proven track record of deep technical analysis who will focus on building our internal technical expertise to provide first-class assistance to our enterprise clients, develop internal monitoring, and create tooling.

Role Overview:

Your responsibilities as a VictoriaMetrics Expert will include:

  • Taking deep dives into complex customer issues, reproducing them in sandbox environments, including under load.

  • Work closely with the development team to resolve identified problems.

  • Creating and developing internal tooling (Go is a significant advantage) to improve observability, automation (e.g., problem detection, AI integrations), and overall operational efficiency.

  • Developing internal monitoring, creating runbooks, dashboards, and guides.

  • Handling problem management: performing root cause analysis and driving long-term solutions, including creating artifacts (docs, runbooks).

  • Building and maintaining the internal knowledge base to support other teams.

  • Collaborating with other teams (engineering, customer success, solution engineering) to address complex issues and contribute to product improvement.

  • Participating in critical incident resolution with a focus on rapid mitigation followed by root cause analysis.

  • The preferred time zone for this position is GMT -5 – GMT -8.

  • We operate in a fully remote setup with a flexible schedule. This is a contract position (a service agreement with a US entity; self-employed or sole proprietor status is possible).

Key Qualifications:

  • Required Experience:

    • A minimum of 4-5+ years in a senior technical position, such as Software Developer, SRE, Performance Engineer, or Systems Engineer role.

  • Technical Skills:

    • Advanced troubleshooting skills.

    • Deep knowledge of programming or scripting languages (experience with Go is a plus).

    • Practical experience with Kubernetes (K8s).

    • Knowledge of Linux (advanced knowledge is a plus).

    • Understanding of IT infrastructure and troubleshooting distributed systems.

  • Soft Skills:

    • Excellent communication skills, able to clearly explain complex technical concepts in English.

    • A passion for solving complex technical problems and building expertise.

    • A sense of responsibility and urgency working with external customers.

    • A quick learner with a proactive attitude and a passion for problem-solving.

  • Startup Mindset:

    • Comfortable with evolving processes and the need for flexibility.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with VictoriaMetrics or other time-series databases/monitoring tools (Grafana/Prometheus).

  • Familiarity with VictoriaLogs or other log storage and analysis platforms is a strong plus

  • Experience with open-source technologies and community engagement.

About VictoriaMetrics:

We are the company behind the popular open-source, high-performance time-series database and monitoring solution: VictoriaMetrics. We’ve recently introduced our open source logs management product, VictoriaLogs, as well as the brand-new VictoriaTraces. Fortune 500 companies use our products as their core monitoring & observability solutions. Our services are used by Spotify, Hubspot, WIX, Grammarly, CERN and thousands of others. Our open source products have been downloaded 1B+ times to date. We are a profitable company with a fully remote team distributed worldwide.

Interview Process:

  • Introductory Video Call (30 min): Meet to discuss your experience and fit and clarify role and expectations.

  • Technical Interview (1 hr): A deep dive into your technical skills with our team.

  • Call with founders (optional, 30 min): An extra session, if needed.

  • Offer: Embark on your journey with VictoriaMetrics.

jobs.title: Organic Growth Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.
jobs.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate across 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Requirements

Mission of the role

Own organic and AI-search performance across Sleek's four core markets and convert that visibility into leads. The primary KPI is to generate leads from organic and AI traffic and convert into new customers. This role exists to fix the conversion gap the current setup can't: our funnel is constrained by lead conversion, not traffic — the two failing markets (AU, UK) fall short on target because visitors don't convert, not because pages don't rank.

Key outcomes In the first 6–12 months

Outcome 1: Grow leads through high-intent traffic

Lift monthly leads to the +15% stretch requirement by March 2027 — SG ~446, HK ~223, AU ~134, UK ~146 — by growing qualified organic + AI traffic to commercial/service pages ~10–15% above current trajectory and winning the high-intent, transactional queries that bring buyers.

Traffic growth here is in service of lead volume on pages that convert — not informational traffic that doesn't.

Identify the high-intent commercial/transactional queries where Sleek's service pages under-rank, and close those gaps.

Fix cannibalization where informational blogs absorb traffic owed to commercial pages; consolidate or re-point intent.

Build internal-linking and funnel paths from informational content to the commercial pages that convert.

Prioritise commercial-page visibility and lead capture over raw informational traffic.

Outcome 2: Lift site-user-to-lead conversion

Land the four markets on the 15% stretch by March 2027 to SG ~1.29×, HK ~1.26×, AU ~1.85×, UK ~1.05× on current lead rate — moving combined Organic+AI attainment to ~92–100% of target with December as mid-point check.

Establish per-market conversion baselines and instrument site-user→lead tracking across all four sites.

Diagnose drop-off on the highest-traffic non-converting pages; prioritise CRO reworks over new content.

Own the AU conversion-recovery investigation (1.3%→0.6% drop) as a first-90-days deliverable.

Ship structured CRO fixes (CTAs, form friction, intent alignment, page structure) with product and engineering.

Report baseline, test results and per-market progress monthly.

Outcome 3: Grow new customers from AI/LLM-referred discovery

+50% new customers attributable to AI/LLM-referred traffic vs current baseline by March 2027, plus a lift in AI citation / share-of-voice on priority tracked queries.

Audit site structure, schema and content for LLM extractability gaps.

Strengthen E-E-A-T, structured content and citeable formatting on priority pages.

Track brand citation and AI-referral attribution monthly (PEEC/Bing AI tracking is still maturing — expect to harden measurement).

Build the AI-visibility reporting the team currently lacks.

Must-have experience

  • Minimum 4+ years of hands-on SEO experience across technical, on-page and off-page SEO, managing a large page inventory in a B2B or eCommerce organisation.
  • Proven CRO impact with quantified outcomes, specifically improving site-user→lead / funnel conversion rather than only improving rankings or traffic.
  • Hands-on experience building and scaling programmatic SEO using data-driven, templated pages across large page inventories.
  • Deep technical SEO experience, including Core Web Vitals, structured data / JSON-LD schema, site architecture, crawl budget, and indexation.
  • Applied AI-search / GEO experience with measurable outcomes, including experience with brand-citation tracking, AI-referral analysis, and structuring pages for LLM extraction.
  • Hands-on experience designing and building AI-driven workflows, automations or agents for SEO, CRO, analytics or related marketing processes.
  • Strong experience with behavioural-analytics tools such as Microsoft Clarity and Hotjar and CRM platforms such as HubSpot; GA4 and GSC assumed baseline.
  • Proven ability to work directly with Product and Engineering teams to get SEO and CRO changes shipped, rather than working through an account-management layer.
  • Experience in a considered-purchase / professional-services category such as fintech, legal, accounting, compliance, or B2B services is preferred.

Must-have attributes

Conversion-driven: Optimises for leads and new customers; treats rankings and traffic as means, not end.

Ownership: Accountable for conversion performance and revenue impact across markets.

Systems thinker: Understands how traffic, conversion, AI visibility and content interact — and builds systems across them.

Structured Thinking: Prioritises across four markets, many services, and competing levers.

Data Driven: Diagnoses with data; distinguishes signal from noise; doesn't act on single-month blips.

Can Have Tough Conversations in a Positive Way: Able to challenge assumptions, communicate clearly, and work constructively with stakeholders when priorities or approaches differ.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

  • Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.
  • Humility: There is so much we don't know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.
  • Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you're more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.
  • Attention to detail: You'll be managing multiple, complex workstreams from numerous stakeholders. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing or inconsistent.
  • Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn't their first language. For you to excel, you'll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the following interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

TA Screen / One-way Video Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview and a TA screen with the member of the Hiring Tam

AI Assessment: Candidates who pass TA screening will be invited to complete an AI assessment. Candidates will have 3 days to complete the assessment, after which the hiring team will review the submission and determine whether to progress the candidate to the technical skills round.

Technical Round: A ~60–90 minute live test conducted by the Hiring Manager to assess SEO, CRO, technical SEO, AI-search/GEO knowledge, data-driven problem solving, and the ability to prioritise and execute against commercial outcomes.

Soft Skills Round: A ~60 minute interview conducted by Head of E-commerce to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioural values.

Reference Verification: Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify:

Your education

Any criminal history

Any political exposure

Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek.com.

.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You'll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don't mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year.

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You'll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you'll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There's also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We're also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we've been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we've joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

We are looking for an experienced Virtual Medical Assistant & Patient Scheduling Coordinator to support a growing U.S.-based gastroenterology practice.

This is a hybrid patient-facing and clinical administrative role. Your initial focus will be patient calls, scheduling, appointment coordination, and front-desk support. As you become familiar with the practice, your responsibilities may expand into broader Medical Assistant and provider-support functions.

The ideal candidate has experience supporting a U.S.-based medical practice, is confident communicating directly with patients and providers, and has hands-on experience using eClinicalWorks (eCW).

Key Responsibilities

1. Patient Calls, Scheduling & Front Desk Support

  • Manage inbound and outbound patient calls, respond to basic inquiries, and follow up on appointment requests and prospective patient leads.

2. Medical Assistant & Provider Support

  • Support Physicians and Nurse Practitioners with chart preparation, intake information, medical documentation, and other remote clinical administrative tasks.

  • Assist with new prescription requests, medication refill requests, and related documentation according to established clinic protocols.

  • Track laboratory, pathology, and diagnostic results and appropriately communicate or route information to providers and patients as directed.

3. Insurance Verification & Prior Authorization

  • Verify patient insurance coverage and accurately document relevant benefits and coverage information in the patient record.

  • Process and follow up on prior authorization requests for procedures, medications, visits, and other services as assigned.

  • Coordinate with patients, providers, and insurance representatives to obtain required information and resolve authorization or coverage-related issues.

4. Workflow Documentation & Team Collaboration

  • Document clinic-specific scheduling, communication, and administrative processes as you learn the practice's workflows.

  • Help develop clear SOPs and step-by-step procedures that can support consistent operations and future team expansion.

  • Maintain clear and timely communication with Physicians, Nurse Practitioners, schedulers, front-desk staff, and other members of the clinic team.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience supporting a U.S.-based medical practice

  • Experience performing both medical receptionist/front-desk and Medical Assistant-related administrative responsibilities

  • Hands-on eClinicalWorks (eCW) experience is required

  • Strong experience with patient scheduling and appointment coordination

  • Familiarity with prior authorizations, insurance verification, prescriptions/refills, and laboratory or diagnostic-result workflows

  • Excellent spoken and written English communication skills

  • Strong attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and documentation skills

  • Comfortable communicating directly with patients, providers, and clinic staff

  • Ability to work independently while maintaining consistent communication with the onsite team

  • Thursday or Friday availability may occasionally be required depending on patient volume and scheduling needs. Schedule changes will be communicated for at least a week if Thursday or Friday schedule is needed.

Tools & Systems

  • eClinicalWorks (eCW) for patient records, scheduling, and clinical documentation

  • net2phone for inbound and outbound patient calls

  • Clinic email and text messaging platforms

  • Secure VPN and other productivity and communication tools

We are working on an ambitious new platform that provides AI capabilities to all JetBrains products. Our platform is based on models developed in-house for writing and coding assistance, as well as integration with our strategic partners.

We are looking for a Research Engineer who can contribute to training foundation models for coding tasks. You’ll be working on developing Large Language Models from scratch and deploying them into production environments where they will be accessible by end users across the globe.

  • Work with stakeholders to convert business requirements into technical specifications.
  • Train LLMs from scratch on a large GPU cluster.
  • Collect and process pre-training and fine-tuning datasets.
  • Support and improve existing subsystems.

We’ll be happy to have you on our team if you have:

  • Experience in distributed training of multi-billion parameter models.

jobs.title: Copy of Director, Brand Marketing
jobs.excerpt: Role OverviewThe Director of Brand Marketing will be the steward and champion of the Alliance Animal Health brand, leading how AAH comes to life across audiences, channels, and experiences.
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Director of Brand Marketing will be the steward and champion of the Alliance Animal Health brand, leading how AAH comes to life across audiences, channels, and experiences. This role owns the strategic vision, positioning, and activation of the brand and ensures it shows up consistently and compellingly for veterinarians, hospital teams, prospective partners, candidates, and industry influencers.

The Director will lead several of AAH’s most visible brand initiatives, including recruitment marketing, employer brand, and brand-forward events and experiences such as our signature VetTalks event. This role will also partner closely with Talent Acquisition, Business Development, Human Resources, Operations, and other teams to translate business priorities into meaningful brand strategies and programs.

As the brand function continues to grow, the Director will play a critical role in evolving AAH’s social media and PR strategy, shaping our presence across key channels, guiding thought leadership for executives and medical leaders, and helping position AAH as one of the most respected and talked-about brands in veterinary medicine.

This is a highly visible, strategic, and hands-on leadership role for a marketer who can set a clear vision, inspire a team, influence senior stakeholders, and ensure strong execution. The right person will be energized by the opportunity to build, experiment, and leave a clear, measurable mark on a growing organization.

Key Responsibilities

Brand Strategy & Leadership

  • Own and evolve the strategic vision and positioning for the Alliance Animal Health corporate brand while providing leadership and governance across AAH’s broader brand portfolio.
  • Translate the brand strategy into annual and multi-year roadmaps with clear priorities, initiatives, budgets, and success metrics.
  • Serve as the internal voice of the brand, ensuring AAH has a cohesive, differentiated presence across channels, audiences, and experiences.
  • Lead the development and ongoing evolution of brand guidelines, messaging frameworks, and toolkits for internal stakeholders and external partners.
  • Advise senior leaders and cross-functional partners on how to bring the AAH brand to life through communications, campaigns, events, and other high-visibility initiatives.
  • Lead, coach, and develop members of the Brand team, establishing clear priorities and creating opportunities for growth.
  • Oversee agency, freelance, and vendor relationships within the brand function, ensuring resources are aligned with AAH’s highest-priority opportunities.

Recruitment Marketing & Employer Brand

  • Partner closely with Talent Acquisition to develop and lead recruitment marketing strategies that drive candidate awareness, consideration, leads, and applications.
  • Own employer-brand storytelling for AAH, bringing our culture, career opportunities, and employee experience to life in a compelling and differentiated way.
  • Lead and execute recruitment marketing channel strategy across web, social media, job boards, email, events, and other emerging opportunities.
  • Monitor recruitment marketing performance and continuously test and optimize messaging, creative, audience strategies, and channels.
  • Develop and optimize candidate journeys and nurture programs in partnership with Talent Acquisition, from initial awareness through application, offer, and onboarding.
  • Guide the development and versioning of recruitment marketing content and creative assets for different roles, audiences, and markets.
  • Oversee employer reputation strategies across platforms such as Glassdoor and Indeed.
  • Ensure recruitment marketing efforts are closely connected to broader AAH brand strategy while addressing the distinct needs of veterinary candidates.

Brand Portfolio Leadership

  • Provide strategic oversight across AAH’s growing brand portfolio, including the Alliance Animal Health corporate brand and PriorityPet Urgent Care.
  • Establish the overarching brand architecture, ensuring each brand has a clear role, differentiated positioning, and connection to AAH’s broader growth strategy.
  • Guide and support the Brand Manager responsible for bringing the PriorityPet Urgent Care corporate brand to life, including its positioning, veterinarian recruitment strategy, corporate social presence, campaigns, and industry activations.
  • Ensure the PPUC brand is consistent and scalable while maintaining a distinct identity designed to attract prospective doctor partners and support the growth of the de novo pipeline.
  • Partner with Growth Marketing, Talent Acquisition, Strategy, Operations, and other leaders to align enterprise brand priorities with recruitment and business-growth goals.
  • Establish shared standards, planning processes, and measurement frameworks across the brand portfolio.
  • Maintain visibility into brand and recruitment marketing performance, helping the team translate insights into stronger positioning, campaigns, and channel strategies.
  • Ensure clear coordination between enterprise-level brand building and the teams responsible for local hospital marketing, market launches, and grand openings.

Events, Experiences & VetTalks

  • Lead the strategy, planning, and execution of brand-forward events, with an emphasis on:
    • AAH’s signature VetTalks series, including concept development, programming, speaker strategy, promotion, attendee experience, and post-event content.
    • Key industry conferences and trade shows where AAH shows up as an employer, partner, and thought leader.
    • Select partner-, employee-, and candidate-focused events.
  • Ensure every event reflects the AAH brand and creates a thoughtful, differentiated experience for attendees.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams and external vendors on event branding, creative, programming, content, promotion, and logistics.
  • Establish clear goals and measurement plans for major events, including awareness, engagement, candidate pipeline, partner relationships, and content value.
  • Create repeatable playbooks and templates that allow events to scale efficiently while remaining consistent and on-brand.

Support for Business Development

  • Collaborate with Business Development leadership to align brand strategy with partner hospital growth and JV acquisition goals.
  • Develop compelling pitch materials, presentations, campaigns, and content that bring the AAH story and partnership model to life for prospective partners.
  • Ensure brand consistency and impact across Business Development touchpoints, including conferences, dinners, webinars, email campaigns, presentations, and direct outreach.
  • Support launch and integration plans for new partner hospitals from a brand and communications perspective.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen AAH’s reputation and visibility among practice owners and other priority industry audiences.

Brand Campaigns, Content & Communications

  • Lead integrated brand campaigns that build awareness, consideration, and preference across priority audiences.
  • Oversee the development of creative concepts, copy, and content across video, social media, web, email, presentations, and collateral for AAH.
  • Bring “The Surprising Side of Corporate” and the broader AAH story to life through compelling, audience-centered storytelling.
  • Shape AAH’s social media strategy and oversee the development of content that strengthens engagement, awareness, and reputation.
  • Help evolve AAH’s PR and thought-leadership strategy, identifying opportunities to elevate executives, medical leaders, and the organization’s expertise.
  • Manage creative agencies, freelancers, and production partners, ensuring high-quality work is delivered on time and within budget.
  • Maintain and optimize AAH’s corporate website and key brand, recruitment, and Business Development landing pages.

Insights, Measurement & Brand Governance

  • Define and track brand health and campaign performance metrics, including awareness, perception, engagement, candidate pipeline, partner interest, and business impact.
  • Establish clear goals and reporting frameworks for major brand initiatives and investments.
  • Regularly share insights, performance results, and recommendations with senior leadership and cross-functional partners.
  • Use audience, competitive, and performance insights to guide brand strategy and identify opportunities for innovation.
  • Manage the brand marketing budget, prioritizing investments based on organizational goals and expected impact.
  • Uphold brand governance across the organization by reviewing high-visibility assets and coaching stakeholders on brand standards and best practices.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree is a plus.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in brand management, integrated marketing, employer branding, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience owning brand strategy and translating it into integrated programs, campaigns, and experiences.
  • Experience leading and developing team members and providing strategic direction across multiple areas of responsibility.
  • Proven ability to influence senior leaders and align cross-functional stakeholders around a shared strategy.
  • Experience partnering closely with Talent Acquisition on employer brand or recruitment marketing strategies.
  • Experience developing or launching a new brand, sub-brand, location concept, or go-to-market platform is strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on experience planning and executing events and experiential marketing; experience leading a flagship or signature event is a strong plus.
  • Experience working with Business Development, growth, or other commercially focused teams is preferred.
  • Strong experience managing agencies, production partners, budgets, and complex cross-functional initiatives.
  • Experience with multi-stakeholder brands, including B2B, B2C, and talent or recruitment audiences, is preferred.
  • Experience in healthcare, animal health, veterinary medicine, or another mission-driven service organization is a plus.
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to interpret performance metrics, communicate insights, and translate findings into action.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strategic leader, practical doer: Can establish a clear brand vision, align others around it, and remain close enough to the work to ensure it comes to life effectively.
  • Brand builder: Understands how to develop differentiated positioning and translate it consistently across audiences, channels, and experiences.
  • People leader: Builds clarity, develops talent, and creates an environment in which team members can do their best work.
  • Exceptional communicator: Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to tailor messaging for veterinarians, hospital teams, executives, candidates, and prospective partners.
  • Influential relationship-builder: Develops trusted partnerships across Talent Acquisition, Business Development, Operations, and hospital leadership.
  • Strong creative judgment: Recognizes compelling ideas and knows how to guide creative work so it is strategically sound, distinctive, and effective.
  • Business-minded: Connects brand decisions and investments to organizational priorities and measurable outcomes.
  • Skilled project leader: Brings structure to complex initiatives and can effectively manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, budgets, and deadlines.
  • Creative and curious: Looks for fresh ways to bring the brand to life and help AAH stand out within veterinary medicine.
  • Mission-aligned: Demonstrates genuine enthusiasm for supporting veterinary professionals and improving the lives of pets, pet owners, and hospital teams.

Compensation & Structure

  • Competitive base salary (negotiable and commensurate with experience)
  • Bonus opportunity targeted at 20% target bonus
  • Additional growth opportunities as recruitment responsibilities expand
  • Reports directly to ER/Specialty Talent Acquisition Manager

Join Us

If you love the ER/Specialty veterinary world, enjoy connecting with people, and want to help build something impactful, we’d love to talk with you.

WE ARE A DRUG-FREE, SMOKE-FREE, EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.

Company Policy & Federal & State Laws Forbid Discrimination Because of Age, Color, Race, Religion, Sex, Disability, Sexual Orientation or National Origin

For additional details including our full equal opportunity statement, texting/outreach communication authorization, physical requirements of the job and more, please visit .

Alliance Animal Health is a fast-growing, private equity backed Veterinarian Service Organization that operates as a majority owner and business partner to many veterinarian practices across the US. Our goal is to make it easier for our practices at every step by providing world-class business solutions like talent acquisition, marketing, human resources, finance, and operations, so that they can focus their energy on providing incredible care for animals. In fact, our Core Values are (quite literally) written with PETS in mind: Passion, Engagement, Trust and Service.

We want our doctor partners to choose what's best for their practice because they are the experts in medicine, while we customize the support, the co-ownership approach, and business solutions based on their goals. We pride ourselves on maintaining a culture of open communication and collaboration to deliver innovative solutions to advance today’s veterinary environment - without disrupting the medical autonomy and what makes each of our hospitals unique.

Why Alliance Animal Health

At Alliance Animal Health, we partner with veterinary practices so they can focus on what matters most: quality medicine and exceptional patient care.

As Director of Brand Marketing, you’ll shape how AAH comes to life for the people who work here, the candidates considering joining us, the practice owners exploring a partnership, and the veterinary community as a whole. You’ll have the opportunity to strengthen an established corporate brand, build a new de novo brand, elevate recruitment marketing, and create events and experiences that deepen AAH’s reputation and impact.

USF Advancement connects the university with donors who want to make a difference by providing philanthropic support to promote student success, research, academic excellence and other strategic priorities. With an endowment that now exceeds $700 million in value, our dedicated team of approximately 200 professionals, including 60 fundraisers, encompasses alumni, development and foundation operations. The team is responsible for raising more than $150 million annually and has broken records year after year with more than $184 million raised in fiscal year 2025.

The Prospect Management Analyst supports the advancement division's fundraising efforts through data analysis, portfolio monitoring, reporting, prospect assignment management, and process administration. Reporting to the Senior Prospect Management Strategist, this position plays a key role in providing actionable insights that strengthen portfolio health, improve pipeline management, and support data-informed fundraising strategies across the organization.

The Analyst is responsible for monitoring prospects, portfolios, and proposal activity; developing reports and dashboards; identifying trends and opportunities; supporting prospect assignment processes; and ensuring the integrity of prospect management data. This position collaborates with Prospect Management, Prospect Research, Advancement Services, and Development staff to enhance fundraising effectiveness through analytical support, operational excellence, and continuous process improvement.

Employees of USF Advancement live out the values of responsibility, innovation, service, and excellence in each of its highly collaborative departments. We use trusted data and ethical AI to enhance decision-making, strengthen engagement, and enable our teams to focus on what matters most: relationships and impact.

The University of South Florida is a top-ranked research university serving approximately 50,000 students from across the globe at campuses in Tampa, St. Petersburg and USF Health. In 2025, U.S. News & World Report recognized USF with its highest overall ranking in university history, as a top 50 public university for the seventh consecutive year and as one of the top 15 best values among all public universities in the nation. jobs.excerpt: About UsLet’s go on an adventure together!  Hey there, we’re G Adventures.
jobs.description:
About Us

Let’s go on an adventure together!


Hey there, we’re G Adventures. We’re one of the world’s leading small group travel companies, and we’ve always believed that travel isn’t just about where you go — it’s about how it changes you.


For the last 35 years, we’ve set out to do things differently. No cookie-cutter tours. No giant buses or cruise ships. And not to mention, as few selfie sticks as possible. Just real humans, travelling your heart out across the world with open minds and a non-stop desire to make our planet better, simply by exploring it.


At G Adventures, our DNA (or GNA, if you will) is built on belonging — where bringing your authentic self to work every day isn’t just accepted, it’s downright celebrated. For our office crew — you wanna rock a t-shirt with your dog’s face on it? We say go for it. For our Chief Experience Officers — you wanna hit the road and call some of the most epic places on Earth your home office? We love that — and we’ve got you. Wanna spend your days with people you genuinely like? Us too — and we’re pretty sure you’ll fit right in, wherever that is.


Now about that career of yours — this is the kind of place where you can spread your wings and truly grow into your role. The best part? You get to do it all alongside a passionate, freakishly talented, one-of-a-kind bunch excited to produce top-notch work and spread a ridiculous amount of goodness at the same time.

Feel like this could be the right fit? We think so too, and we’re already way too excited to meet you.


About the Role


Do you believe travel can change lives?


Not just for travellers — but for the people and places they visit?


Do you thrive in unpredictable days, long bus rides, spontaneous problem-solving, and conversations with strangers who quickly feel like friends?


Then you might be exactly who we’re looking for.


At G Adventures, we don’t call our tour leaders “tour leaders.” We call them Chief Experience Officers (CEOs). Our founder gave up the title because he believes the true leaders of this company are the ones out in the world, face-to-face with our travellers every single day.


You’re not just running a trip.


You’re shaping an experience.


You’re the reason a good tour becomes an unforgettable one.


Before we go further, please ensure you are legally able to lead tours through the following countries:

  • Jordan

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

This role lives at the intersection of logistics, leadership, storytelling, and heart.


On any given day, you’ll be:

  • Managing group dynamics
  • Coordinating transport and suppliers
  • Sharing the culture, history, and nuance of a place
  • Supporting community partners
  • Helping travellers feel like they truly belong

You’re not just guiding people through a destination. You’re helping them understand it.

What Makes a Great CEO

You don’t just do the job — you live it.


You:

  • Believe in community tourism and responsible travel
  • Champion G for Good and our Raise the World efforts on tour
  • Communicate clearly with travellers, suppliers, and offices
  • Bring calm, positivity, and energy to long, unpredictable days
  • Handle the unexpected like it’s part of the plan
  • Turn information into stories travellers will never forget
  • Create a sense of safety, inclusion, and belonging within your group
  • Stay endlessly curious about the places you guide in

You Travel Your Heart Out — and it shows.


The Practical Stuff

On each departure, you’ll:

  • Be the face of G Adventures in the field
  • Manage day-to-day logistics and reservations
  • Promote Planeterra and G for Good initiatives
  • Support optional activities, meals, and traveller needs
  • Handle incidents calmly and professionally
  • Maintain budgets, receipts, and daily accounts
  • Provide post-trip reports and updates
  • Occasionally support the training of new CEOs

What You’ll Need

  • Valid First Aid/CPR
  • Basic budgeting and accounting comfort
  • A valid passport/visa and required vaccinations
  • Comfort using Google Suite and mobile apps
  • Experience in tourism, hospitality, or extensive travel
  • Strong English language skills
  • Willingness to undergo a background check if required

Why This Role Is Different

You won’t sit behind a desk.


You won’t have two days that look the same.


You won’t just be guiding tours.


You’ll be creating moments travellers talk about for the rest of their lives — while helping the people and places you visit, too.


If that sounds like the kind of work you want to do, we can’t wait to meet you.

Velera is the nation’s premier payments credit union service organization (CUSO) and an integrated fintech solutions provider. The Delinquency Management Solutions Lead serves as a senior technical lead and subject matter expert responsible for the design, administration, integration, automation, reporting, and continuous improvement of the business systems and supporting technologies utilized within Delinquency Management operations. This position independently translates complex operational, client, regulatory, data, and technology requirements into scalable solutions supporting collections operations, client implementations, borrower communications, payment services, reporting and analytics, workflow management, and system integrations. The role evaluates technical capabilities, recommends appropriate solution and integration approaches, and leads configuration, development support, testing, implementation, production support, and continuous improvement activities that strengthen operational performance, data integrity, compliance, client service, and business outcomes. The Senior Delinquency Management Systems Administrator collaborates with business leadership, Information Technology, vendors, consultants, compliance partners, and clients and serves as a senior escalation resource for complex operational, integration, reporting, data, and technology issues.

Day in the Life:

  • Evaluate, recommend, implement, and optimize technology solutions, integrations, automation capabilities, and process improvements that improve operational efficiency, scalability, compliance, client service, and business performance.

  • Lead system implementations, upgrades, conversions, platform enhancements, testing, deployments, and production stabilization activities.

  • Strong project leadership, vendor management, stakeholder management, facilitation, negotiation, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

jobs.description:
SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.

Job Description Summary:

The Construction Engineer I supports four core Construction Engineering functions across SOLV’s EPC operations by providing engineering coordination, technical communication, and documentation rigor. This role contributes to (1) Warranty Analysis, by gathering data and supporting engineering review of potential design or installation issues; (2) Emerging Technologies Implementation, by assisting with GPS-enabled pile driving, drone-based survey workflows, and new construction tools; (3) Construction Engineering Support During Operations, by coordinating RFIs, design updates, and field engineering clarifications; and (4) Pile Load Testing Support During Initial Design, by assisting with planning, scheduling, documentation, and engineering communication for pre-construction pile testing programs.

This role is remote and will require travel. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

Job Description:

*This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned

Position Responsibilities and Duties:

Warranty Forensics

  • Gather field data, photos, as-built information, and installation details to support warranty claim evaluations.

  • Document potential design, manufacturing, or installation concerns and organize findings for review by senior engineering staff.

  • Compare field conditions against design documents, specifications, and installation standards to help identify root causes of warranty-related issues.

  • Maintain accurate, traceable warranty documentation logs to support issue tracking, escalation, and resolution.

  • Assist in coordinating engineering input for remediation plans and communicating required actions to project teams and clients.

Emerging Technologies Implementation

  • Support the deployment of advanced construction technologies, including GPS enabled pile driving, drone-based topo capture, and machine control datasets.

  • Prepare and maintain engineering datasets used for GPS machine control, real time grading/terrain workflows, and other technology-enabled processes.

  • Assist with field execution of drone flights, data collection, and upload processes as required by construction and engineering teams.

  • Capture and organize field feedback on technology performance and communicate improvement opportunities to engineering leadership.

  • Participate in development, rollout, and continuous improvement of new construction technology SOPs.

​Construction Engineering Support During Operations

  • Coordinate daily engineering information flow to field teams, ensuring timely distribution of drawing updates, clarifications, and consultant responses.

  • Manage RFIs by drafting clear, concise questions, gathering supporting documentation, routing to the correct engineering discipline, and tracking closure to avoid schedule delays.

  • Interpret and communicate project-specific design requirements such as SOLV standards, contract requirements, and permit conditions.

  • Maintain engineering document control systems, including drawing sets, data room folders, engineering exhibits, submittals, and version tracking.

  • Participate in constructability reviews by identifying missing details, design conflicts, or potential field execution risks.

  • Support owner/IE comment cycles by preparing comment logs, collecting consultant responses, and presenting organized summaries to project managers and field teams.

  • Monitor engineering deliverable timelines, identify at-risk items, and support mitigation efforts with internal and external engineering partners.

Pile Load Testing Support During Initial Design

  • Assist with coordinating pre-construction pile load testing activities, including drill-rig scheduling, field logistics, and test setup.

  • Document load test procedures, test sequences, and field results accurately and consistently.

  • Track, organize, and communicate pile test data to project engineers, geotechnical consultants, and design partners.

  • Ensure pile test documentation aligns with contract requirements, industry standards, and engineering expectations.

  • Support identification of soil behavior or foundation performance concerns based on load test observations and results.

General Engineering Responsibilities

  • Conduct drawing comparisons, quantity checks, and review of plan sets to identify potential discrepancies or missing information.

  • Participate in project site visits to gather field data, observe installation methods, validate design assumptions, and enhance constructability awareness.

  • Identify and escalate engineering risks such as conflicting details, missing information, or unforeseen field conditions.

  • Contribute to SOP, workflow, and internal database development, including lessons learned, testing procedures, and advanced technology processes.

  • Build strong working relationships with project managers, superintendents, field engineers, consultants, and internal engineering teams to support fast issue resolution.

​Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Environmental Studies, or a closely related technical field (preferred).

  • 0–3 years of relevant experience, with the ability to perform tasks with guidance and grow toward independent execution (aligned with Engineer I expectations).

  • Engineer‑in‑Training (EIT) certification preferred or willingness to pursue certification.

  • Strong ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, including civil, structural, electrical, and geotechnical plans.

  • Foundational understanding of construction processes, testing practices (such as pile load testing), and engineering documentation.

  • High attention to detail with strong organizational skills and the ability to maintain accurate, disciplined documentation across multiple engineering workflows.

  • Problem‑solving mindset with the ability to identify inconsistencies, collect supporting information, and escalate engineering concerns appropriately.

  • Strong communication skills, capable of explaining design updates, gathering field information, and collaborating with project managers, engineers, and field teams.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel and Word; exposure to CAD, GIS, drone‑capture platforms, GPS machine‑control datasets, or similar tools preferred.

  • Willingness to learn and support emerging construction technologies, including drone‑based surveys, GPS‑enabled equipment, and digital field data systems.

  • Ability to conduct field work, including walking construction sites, collecting data, observing installation methods, and participating in testing activities.

  • Sense of urgency and ownership, able to support fast‑paced construction environments and respond quickly to engineering information needs.

  • Team‑oriented, with the ability to work collaboratively across engineering, operations, warranty, and technology‑focused groups.

Our client is a U.S.-based behavioral and mental health practice providing patient-centered mental health care. The practice supports patients through services that include medication management, psychotherapy, coaching, and patient education.

We’re looking for an experienced Medical Virtual Assistant to help keep patient communication, scheduling, and intake workflows running smoothly while the provider is in sessions.

Your primary focus will be answering patient calls and managing appointment scheduling, followed by referral and inbox follow-up. You’ll also assist with insurance verification, prior authorizations, patient forms, medication refill request routing, and message triage.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Verify patient insurance eligibility and coverage.
  • Support prior authorization workflows.
  • Coordinate patient paperwork and required forms.
  • Screen and appropriately route medication refill requests.
  • Triage patient messages and determine what can be handled administratively versus what should be escalated to the provider.

  • Experience as a Medical/Healthcare Virtual Assistant or in a similar healthcare support role.

  • Ability to appropriately triage and escalate patient or clinical messages.
  • Strong attention to detail when handling patient information, referrals, and appointment requests.
  • Organized, responsive, reliable, and consistent with follow-through.
  • Comfortable working in a patient-facing mental health practice environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience supporting a behavioral health, mental health, psychiatry, or similar healthcare practice.
  • Experience coordinating referrals and new patient intake.
  • Familiarity with medication refill request routing.

Basic Requirements

  • Must speak and write English clearly and professionally.
  • Must have relevant work experience.
  • Must be able to provide an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).

About the Role

We’re looking for a Data Analytics & BI Analyst to help turn data from across the business into clear, reliable, and actionable insights.

This role will sit at the intersection of data, reporting, and business decision-making. You’ll work across multiple systems and functional areas to bring together information, ensure it is accurate and consistent, and build reporting that helps teams understand performance and make better decisions.

You’ll partner closely with teams across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Finance, and Operations to understand what questions matter most and translate those needs into scalable dashboards, reporting, and analysis.

This is a great opportunity for someone who is technically strong but equally comfortable thinking about the business behind the numbers. We’re looking for someone who can go beyond simply pulling data and help determine what should be measured, how it should be interpreted, and how it can be communicated clearly.

What You’ll Do

  • Pull together and analyze data from multiple systems and sources to create a reliable, consolidated view of business performance.
  • Build and maintain scalable dashboards and reporting for key business areas, including MBRs/QBRs, Sales, Marketing, funnel performance, customer trends, and product usage.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to understand business questions, identify the metrics that matter most, and translate those needs into meaningful reporting and analysis.
  • Develop and maintain data models and reporting structures that make business data easier to access, understand, and use consistently across the organization.
  • Establish strong data validation and quality-control processes to ensure reporting is accurate, consistent, and trusted.
  • Work closely with Data Engineers and other technical partners to identify data gaps, clarify requirements, and improve how data is collected, structured, and made available for reporting.
  • Translate complex datasets into clear insights, trends, and actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Query and manipulate data using SQL and other analytical tools to support business reporting and ad hoc analysis.
  • Build intuitive dashboards and visualizations that allow teams and leaders to quickly understand performance and identify areas requiring attention.
  • Help define, document, and standardize key business metrics and reporting methodologies across teams.
  • Investigate discrepancies and inconsistencies across systems and work with relevant teams to improve overall data quality.
  • Support recurring executive and leadership reporting, including monthly and quarterly business reviews.
  • Respond to ad hoc analytical requests while identifying opportunities to turn repeat questions into scalable reporting solutions.
  • Continuously improve dashboards, reporting workflows, and analytical processes as the company and its data needs evolve.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, business analytics, or a related role, ideally within a SaaS or technology environment.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large or complex datasets.
  • Experience working with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar platforms.
  • Experience building dashboards and reports using BI and visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, Metabase, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, metric definitions, and reporting best practices.
  • Experience combining and reconciling data across multiple business systems such as CRM, product analytics, marketing, billing, finance, or customer success platforms.
  • Strong analytical judgment and the ability to determine what information is meaningful rather than simply reporting every available metric.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches.
  • Strong attention to detail and a high bar for data accuracy and reliability.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain data and insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally and partnering with both technical and business teams.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively in a fast-moving environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working in a high-growth SaaS environment.
  • Familiarity with SaaS metrics such as ARR/MRR, churn, retention, conversion, CAC, LTV, product adoption, and funnel performance.
  • Experience supporting executive reporting, MBRs, or QBRs.
  • Experience with tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Stripe, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar business and product platforms.
  • Familiarity with dbt or other analytics engineering tools.
  • Experience helping establish standardized company-wide metrics or reporting frameworks.

jobs.excerpt: Full-Stack Developer Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Working Hours: U.
jobs.description:
Full-Stack Developer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for a Full-Stack Developer with strong experience in TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Postgres to build and ship features across a modern client portal.

You’ll own features from design through production, working across the frontend, backend, database, and integrations as needed. This is a hands-on role where you’ll be expected to think beyond the happy path, build reliable features, and improve the codebase as you go.

You’ll work closely with a small engineering and product team, receiving fast feedback and having significant ownership over what you build.

What You’ll Own

End-to-End Feature Development

  • Take features from design prototype through production
  • Build frontend interfaces using TypeScript, React, and Next.js
  • Handle route handlers, database migrations, emails, and UI as part of a complete feature
  • Work across candidate profiles, roles and candidates pages, interview flows, billing, and other portal features
  • Ensure features are production-ready rather than focused only on the happy path

Data & UI Resilience

  • Build features that handle real-world data and edge cases
  • Account for empty states, error states, long names, lengthy CVs, and multiple applications
  • Ensure UI states are clear, intentional, and user-friendly
  • Identify potential edge cases before they become production issues
  • Improve existing features when you identify reliability or usability gaps

Testing & Code Quality

  • Write automated tests for areas that currently lack coverage
  • Add regression coverage for new features and important workflows
  • Keep the codebase stable and maintainable
  • Identify and resolve issues discovered through testing or code review
  • Leave each area of the codebase better than you found it

Database & Backend

  • Write and review Postgres migrations
  • Work confidently with SQL, joins, and database relationships
  • Read and reason about row-level security policies
  • Maintain predictable Supabase Auth and Realtime behavior
  • Understand how frontend, backend, and database changes work together

Third-Party Integrations

  • Work with integrations such as Stripe, Resend, Workable, and SparkHire
  • Connect third-party services to product features when required
  • Troubleshoot integration-related issues
  • Read and understand the existing Python FastAPI service when features interact with AI or data functionality

Code Review & Collaboration

  • Write clear and well-documented pull requests
  • Provide enough context for reviewers to understand and approve changes efficiently
  • Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback
  • Progress toward reviewing API and database migration pull requests independently
  • Collaborate directly with engineering and product team members in a fast feedback environment

Requirements

  • 2–4 years of experience shipping production TypeScript and React applications
  • Strong experience with Next.js, ideally including App Router, Server Components, and Route Handlers
  • Solid understanding of SQL and relational databases
  • Ability to write joins, read migrations, and understand database relationships
  • Understanding of Postgres and row-level security concepts
  • Experience building production-ready UIs with thoughtful empty, loading, and error states
  • Experience working in a monorepo or codebase where features span frontend, backend, and database layers
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests
  • Familiarity with pull requests and modern code-review workflows
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Ability to own features independently from requirements through deployment
  • Strong written communication and attention to detail

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Supabase
  • Experience with Stripe or Resend
  • Experience working with Workable or SparkHire integrations
  • Familiarity with Python and FastAPI
  • Experience with unit or integration testing
  • Experience working with AI or data-focused backend services
  • Experience using tools such as CodeRabbit or similar AI-assisted code review tools
  • Previous experience working in a small, fast-moving product team

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Can take a feature from a brief to production without needing every task broken down
  • Think about migrations, edge cases, testing, and integrations alongside the UI
  • Care about how features behave with real-world data
  • Communicate proactively when you encounter blockers
  • Welcome feedback and use it to improve your work
  • Are comfortable working across both frontend and backend systems
  • Prefer shipping small, reliable improvements consistently
  • Take pride in leaving the codebase cleaner and more stable than you found it

What Success Looks Like

  • Features move efficiently from design to production
  • New functionality works reliably across real-world data scenarios
  • Strong automated test coverage across key areas of the portal
  • Database migrations and security policies remain reliable and well-structured
  • Pull requests are clear, focused, and easy to review
  • Third-party integrations work consistently across product workflows
  • Bugs and edge cases are identified and addressed proactively
  • The codebase becomes more stable and maintainable over time

Typical Day

Your day may start with a design prototype, feature request, or product comment. You’ll work across the stack to turn that requirement into a production-ready feature—writing the database migration, building the UI, implementing the route handler, connecting required integrations, and adding tests.

Other days may involve fixing an edge case that surfaced in production, such as a candidate with multiple applications causing an unexpected issue in a list view. You’ll investigate the problem, implement the fix, test it, and deploy the improvement.

The team operates with a tight feedback loop, so expect short standups, direct collaboration, and most decisions to happen through comments and pull requests rather than lengthy meetings.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. AI Rating & Recruiter Screening
  3. Technical/Client Interview
  4. Final Selection & Onboarding
