Job Title: Senior IT Manager
Company: Solen Software Group
Location: US or Canada
Employment Type : Full-time

About Solen Software Group

Solen Software Group is an evergreen holding company that acquires and operates software businesses with strong fundamentals and long-term potential. We invest for the long term, empower entrepreneurial teams, and build enduring companies across a growing portfolio of SaaS businesses.

The Role

Solen is hiring a Senior IT Manager to help mature the IT function across the holding company and more than twenty operating companies. This person will inherit a partially built environment with standards and implementations already underway, uneven documentation, and a mix of internal and external support. The mandate is to make that environment reliable, repeatable, secure, well documented, and capable of scaling with the portfolio.

This is a hands-on builder role. During the first year, the Senior IT Manager will personally diagnose problems, complete implementations, support users, document recurring work, and learn the true shape of demand. That operating experience will inform recommendations about what Solen should own internally, outsource, or solve through technology. The role may eventually lead a team, but it is not being hired to inherit a mature organization and manage from a distance.

The Senior IT Manager will recommend improvements, influence operating companies, and execute agreed direction. Jason retains final authority over consequential cross-company standards and major IT decisions, while expecting this leader to challenge assumptions, surface risks, and bring better ideas forward.

What Success Looks Like in Year One

Build a repeatable IT operating foundation. Complete and operationalize core identity and access management, device management, remote monitoring, onboarding and offboarding, code repository, cybersecurity, and governance standards. Execute the IT components of Solen's 100-Day Integration Plan consistently for acquired companies.

Turn knowledge into organizational capability. Create and maintain practical standards, runbooks, and SOPs for major IT components so another capable IT professional can execute recurring work without rediscovering the process or relying on tribal knowledge.

Establish practical security and governance. Apply controls in proportion to business risk, customer and regulatory obligations, cost, and employee friction. This includes Data Loss Prevention, incident response, ongoing compliance review, and repeatable vulnerability and penetration testing completed before applicable public announcements or press releases.

Define the long-term operating model. Use hands-on experience and operating data to recommend which capabilities Solen should build internally, buy, outsource, or reduce through technology. Include the capabilities and talent required, the future role of managed services and contractors, vendor and tool consolidation, and centralized optimization of AWS, Azure, and other hosting costs.

Make IT a trusted business function. Deliver responsive, consistent service and sound recommendations so IT enables operating companies rather than becoming a blocker. Build credibility through execution, practical judgment, and reliable systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own day-to-day IT execution across Solen HQ and the operating companies, including complex identity, access, device, network, application, and endpoint issues.
  • Complete and operate standards for Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Intune or similar MDM platforms, endpoint security, remote monitoring and management, patching, device compliance, and SaaS administration.
  • Design and run end-to-end employee onboarding and offboarding, including hardware procurement and recovery, account provisioning and revocation, licensing, data transfer, and evidence capture.
  • Maintain practical identity and access controls including conditional access, phishing-resistant MFA, SSO, passkeys or self-service password reset, and least-privilege administration.
  • Implement Data Loss Prevention and other information-protection controls appropriate to each business's risk and obligations.
  • Establish repeatable vulnerability scanning and penetration-testing processes, including completing applicable testing before public announcements or press releases and tracking remediation to closure.
  • Create and maintain incident response plans, security operating procedures, compliance reviews, and recurring risk assessments.
  • Execute the IT workstream of the 100-Day Integration Plan for acquisitions and improve the playbook as Solen learns from each integration.
  • Standardize tools and practices across operating companies where the value outweighs migration cost and disruption, while documenting justified exceptions.
  • Centralize visibility into AWS, Azure, and other hosting spend; identify waste, duplicate services, commitment opportunities, architecture tradeoffs, and practical optimization actions with Finance and technical leaders.
  • Evaluate vendors, managed services, contractors, and internal staffing based on capability, service quality, risk, total cost, and recurring demand rather than headcount alone.
  • Document systems, configurations, decisions, runbooks, and SOPs in a shared repository and test whether others can execute them.
  • Provide useful service and risk metrics to leadership, identify recurring patterns, and improve processes in the sequence reliable, repeatable, optimized, and then automated.

What You Bring

  • Broad, hands-on IT capability across identity, endpoints, SaaS administration, networking fundamentals, cybersecurity, device lifecycle, monitoring, troubleshooting, and basic scripting or automation.
  • A structured approach to ambiguous environments: assess the current state, separate urgent risk from noise, prioritize, execute, and adjust based on evidence.
  • Practical business and security judgment. You can explain likelihood, impact, mitigation value, cost, operational friction, and compensating controls instead of relying on best-practice slogans.
  • A builder's mindset. You solve the immediate problem and then create a repeatable process, documentation, ownership, and feedback loop.
  • Commercial judgment and a natural focus on cheaper, better, and faster without confusing frugality with choosing the lowest price.
  • The confidence to recommend a different approach, challenge assumptions constructively, and operate with appropriate independence.
  • Clear communication with technical and nontechnical stakeholders and the ability to influence operating companies without relying on positional authority.

Experience

  • Five or more years of progressive responsibility across IT infrastructure, systems, security, and end-user technology in SaaS, software, or another distributed environment.
  • Demonstrated experience building or materially improving IT operations in an environment with ambiguity, incomplete documentation, or rapid growth.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Windows administration, and modern endpoint management; working knowledge of macOS and Google Workspace is useful.
  • Experience with identity and access management, MDM, endpoint protection, RMM, networking fundamentals, incident response, vulnerability management, and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
  • Experience supporting acquisitions, multiple business entities, or distributed teams is preferred.
  • Experience evaluating managed services, vendors, cloud or hosting costs, and build-versus-buy decisions is preferred.
  • Leadership or team-building experience is useful, but current hands-on capability and sound judgment matter more than having managed a large team.

Why This Role

This role offers the opportunity to shape how IT operates across a growing software group. The right person will have meaningful autonomy, direct access to leadership, and the chance to build durable systems while helping determine the team and operating model Solen will need for its next stage.

Solen-isms (How We Operate)

· Ownership Mindset: We own the mission. We don't wait to be told. We lead, fix, and build as if it were ours. When problems arise, we run toward them, not away.

· Benchmark to Best: We seek out excellence. We measure ourselves against the best and adapt quickly, always looking for the edge that moves us forward.

· Openly Self-Critical: Leaders go first: they surface their misses early, ask for direct feedback, and turn “game film” into better decisions and better systems.

· Disagree & Commit: Leaders disagree openly and constructively, regardless of title or tenure, because truth is how we avoid bureaucracy and benchmark to best.

· Figureitoutiveness: Embracing challenges, fostering growth, and taking initiative, leaders thrive on hard work and high failure tolerance.

· Mutual Elevation: Committed to growth, elevating teams, developing future leaders, and removing barriers to mastery and joy.

· Learn-it-alls: Learn-it-alls, not know-it-alls, embracing failure as part of growth and progress.

· Pioneering: Pioneering driven by opportunity, using first principles thinking and unbound by tradition or rules.

· Will to Win: Leaders relentlessly pursue potential, reject mediocrity, and get what they tolerate.

· Dialectical: We learn through conversation. We ask, listen, question, and evolve — valuing disagreement as a tool for alignment and deeper understanding.

· Frugality: Achieving more with less, focusing on quality, long-term value, and company-wide responsibility.

· Candor: We communicate with integrity, transparency, and respect in all conversations.

· Kaizen: Kaizen is continuous improvement as a way of life. Leaders make hundreds of small upgrades that compound, turning lessons into standards and standards into durable systems.

Recruitment Disclaimer

Solen Software Group will never request payment, banking information, or other sensitive personal or financial details during any stage of the recruitment process. All official communication will come from a verified @solensoftwaregroup.com email address. Any outreach outside these standards should be disregarded and reported through our official channels.

We thank all applicants for their interest in joining Solen Software Group. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Sales Assistant – CRM, Scheduling & Sales Operations | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized and execution-focused Sales Assistant to support a fast-moving sales team across CRM management, scheduling, proposals, reporting, and day-to-day sales operations.

This is not a sales-closing role. Your responsibility is to keep the sales team organized, prepared, and focused on revenue-generating activities.

You’ll help ensure CRM records stay accurate, sales calls and follow-ups happen on time, proposals are polished, pipeline reporting remains reliable, and no lead, task, or opportunity falls through the cracks.

If you enjoy structure, coordination, and helping high-performing sales teams operate efficiently, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

CRM Management & Sales Operations

  • Maintain accurate records in CRM platforms such as:
    • Salesforce
    • HubSpot
    • Zoho CRM
    • Pipedrive
  • Update leads, contacts, opportunities, and pipeline stages
  • Keep notes, activities, follow-ups, and next steps current
  • Identify and remove duplicate, incomplete, or outdated records
  • Maintain strong CRM hygiene and reliable pipeline visibility
  • Track outstanding sales activities and deadlines
  • Support day-to-day sales workflows and operational organization
  • Ensure sales representatives have accurate information when they need it

Scheduling & Calendar Coordination

  • Schedule:
    • Sales calls
    • Product demos
    • Follow-up meetings
    • Internal meetings
  • Coordinate calendars across multiple time zones
  • Manage scheduling through Google Calendar, Outlook, and Calendly
  • Handle reschedules, reminders, and meeting logistics
  • Monitor upcoming meetings and identify potential scheduling conflicts
  • Ensure sales representatives have the right context and materials before meetings
  • Keep follow-up meetings and next steps moving on time

Proposals & Sales Documents

  • Prepare, format, and proofread:
    • Sales proposals
    • Quotes
    • Presentations
    • Client-facing documents
  • Support RFP and RFI responses using approved templates
  • Create polished materials using Google Slides, PowerPoint, and Canva
  • Review documents for accuracy, formatting, and completeness
  • Ensure sales materials are professional and delivered on time
  • Maintain organized versions of proposals and supporting documents

Reporting & Pipeline Tracking

  • Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports
  • Track:
    • Pipeline activity
    • Conversion metrics
    • Sales KPIs
    • Deal progression
  • Maintain dashboards and reporting trackers
  • Keep pipeline information current and reliable
  • Identify missing or outdated information before reporting
  • Ensure leadership has accurate visibility into sales activity and pipeline performance

Communication & Follow-Up

  • Draft professional follow-up emails, reminders, and meeting summaries
  • Support inbound lead routing and response coordination
  • Track outstanding actions and follow-ups
  • Ensure prospects receive timely communication
  • Help maintain momentum throughout the sales process
  • Flag overdue tasks or stalled opportunities for appropriate follow-up

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations
  • Coordinate internal handoffs and approvals
  • Track deal-related tasks and documentation
  • Help prevent communication gaps and operational delays
  • Support smooth transitions from sales into onboarding or delivery
  • Maintain visibility into outstanding dependencies across teams

Requirements

  • 1–2+ years of experience in:
    • Sales Support
    • Administrative Support
    • Operations Coordination
    • Executive Assistance
  • Hands-on experience with at least one CRM, such as:
    • Salesforce
    • HubSpot
    • Zoho CRM
    • Pipedrive
  • Strong scheduling and calendar management experience
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office
  • Strong written English communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities
  • High attention to detail and consistent follow-through
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Availability during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience preparing sales proposals, decks, or presentations
  • Exposure to SDR or BDR workflows
  • Previous experience supporting Account Executives or sales leadership
  • Experience in:
    • SaaS
    • Recruiting
    • Marketing agencies
    • Professional services
  • Basic Excel or Google Sheets reporting skills
  • Familiarity with:
    • Pivot Tables
    • Dashboards
    • Pipeline reporting

Tools & Technology

Salesforce | HubSpot | Zoho CRM | Pipedrive | Google Workspace | Microsoft Office | Google Calendar | Outlook | Calendly | Google Sheets | Excel | Google Slides | PowerPoint | Canva

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Are highly organized and proactive
  • Enjoy keeping CRMs, calendars, and workflows clean
  • Communicate clearly and professionally
  • Follow through without needing repeated reminders
  • Can manage multiple priorities without sacrificing accuracy
  • Notice missing information or overdue tasks before they become problems
  • Enjoy supporting sales teams and making their workflows more efficient
  • Take ownership of administrative details from start to finish
  • Understand that strong sales operations directly support revenue performance

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You might start your day by reviewing the CRM, updating pipeline records, checking upcoming sales meetings, and identifying outstanding follow-ups.

Throughout the day, you’ll coordinate calendars, prepare proposals and presentations, send follow-up communications, update reports, and help sales representatives stay organized.

You’ll also coordinate with other departments to ensure deal-related tasks, approvals, and handoffs move forward without unnecessary delays.

In short: you keep the sales engine organized, accurate, and moving so the sales team can focus on selling.

Key Metrics for Success

  • CRM accuracy and pipeline cleanliness
  • Follow-ups completed on time
  • Accurate and efficient scheduling
  • Proposal and sales-document quality
  • Reporting accuracy and consistency
  • Reduction in missed tasks or communication gaps
  • Timely sales-to-onboarding handoffs
  • Positive feedback from sales leadership
  • Reliable operational support throughout the sales process

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High-impact support role directly connected to revenue operations
  • Hands-on exposure to modern CRM and sales systems
  • Clear ownership of important sales workflows
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Opportunity to develop skills across CRM management, reporting, pipeline operations, and sales enablement
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Sales Operations
    • Revenue Operations
    • Account Management
    • Executive Operations

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Practical Task – CRM Cleanup & Proposal Formatting
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Background Verification

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re highly organized, comfortable with CRM systems, scheduling, reporting, and sales coordination, and enjoy helping sales teams operate efficiently, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help keep the sales pipeline organized, communication moving, and the sales team focused on closing opportunities.

jobs.description:
QA/QC Technical eCommerce Manager

Location: Remote, US / Miami
Reports to: Head of Engineering

About Dose

Dose is a functional wellness company offering innovative, clinically-backed supplements to consumers. A science-first approach, unique product design, and mission-orientation are just a few of the differentiating factors propelling Dose to be one of the fastest-growing companies in the health & wellness sector. Dose’s founder, Vasu Goyal, developed Dose while observing the gap between marketed promises and functional results. We’re committed to challenging the industry with products that actually work — and taste great.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a QA/QC Technical eCommerce Manager to own digital quality across Dose’s online ecosystem — from our Shopify Plus storefront to marketing surfaces and backend integrations.

This is a hands-on technical role where you’ll build the QA program that safeguards conversion, data integrity, accessibility, and performance. You’ll work cross-functionally with Engineering, Growth, Lifecycle, Design, and CX to help Dose ship fast without breaking checkout, analytics, or the customer experience.

You’ll be accountable for:

  • Zero critical conversion defects reaching production.

  • Analytics event accuracy and data integrity (≥ 99%).

  • Performance and accessibility SLAs (Core Web Vitals “Good” rates; WCAG 2.2 AA compliance).

  • Reliable, on-time releases with automated regression coverage.

  • Rapid incident detection, clear communication, and closed-loop corrective action.

What You’ll Do

Quality Systems & Release Management

  • Define and run the end-to-end QA lifecycle — requirements → test plans → automation → UAT → production verification.

  • Establish go/no-go criteria for every release and maintain a stable staging environment.

  • Own regression suites for storefront, checkout, account, subscription, and CMS flows.

Test Engineering & Automation

  • Build and maintain automated tests (Playwright, Cypress) across critical paths and devices; integrate with CI/CD pipelines.

  • Create synthetic test data (users, orders, subscriptions) and mock external services as needed.

Analytics, Tagging & Experiment QA

  • Govern the data layer spec and validate events across GA4, server-side tagging, and consent states.

  • Manage pixels and tags (Klaviyo, Braze, Meta, Google, RMNs) for accuracy and privacy compliance (CMP, TCPA, GDPR/CCPA).

  • QA A/B tests and feature flags (Eppo, Optimizely) for bucketing, exposures, and conversions.

Content, Merchandising & SEO QA

  • Pre-flight new products, promotions, and campaigns for pricing, tax, shipping, and inventory accuracy.

  • Validate structured data, canonicalization, and sitemap health to maintain SEO integrity.

Performance, Accessibility & Security

  • Monitor Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) and enforce Lighthouse and performance budgets.

  • Ensure WCAG 2.2 AA compliance (keyboard navigation, color contrast, alt text).

  • Validate payment flows (Shop Pay, Apple Pay, Google Pay, credit cards) and maintain PCI awareness.

Monitoring, Incidents & Continuous Improvement

  • Implement real-time monitoring (Sentry, uptime, log alerts) and post-release verifications.

  • Lead incident triage and root-cause analyses; drive corrective/preventive actions.

  • Maintain QA dashboards tracking defects, MTTR, and test coverage.

Integrations & Ecosystem QA

  • QA integrations across Shopify Plus, subscriptions (Recharge or similar), reviews (Okendo), search/recommendations, ESP/SMS, and reverse-ETL pipelines.

  • Validate ERP/3PL hooks that impact inventory, pricing, and delivery promises.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5–8 years in e-commerce QA or QA leadership, including automation for high-traffic storefronts.

  • Hands-on experience with Shopify Plus (or similar), checkout/payment stacks, and subscription platforms.

  • Deep knowledge of GA4, server-side tagging, data layers, and pixels.

  • Proficiency with Playwright/Cypress, CI/CD pipelines, and defect tracking (Jira, Linear).

  • Familiarity with Core Web Vitals, WCAG 2.2 AA, technical SEO, and performance tuning.

  • Clear, concise communicator who can translate defects into business impact and drive prioritization.

  • Bonus: SQL, API testing (Postman), schema/contract testing, and retail media network experience.

Team & Growth

You’ll start as an individual contributor with dotted-line leadership over agency and contract QA partners — and the opportunity to hire a QA Engineer (automation) and Content QA Coordinator as scope scales.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Dose, you’ll set the quality bar for one of the fastest-growing wellness brands in the U.S. You’ll protect what matters most — the customer experience — while building a modern, scalable QA program from the ground up.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $150,000 – $165,000 USD (depending on experience, location, and skills)

  • Performance Bonus: Based on company and individual goals

  • Benefits: Comprehensive health coverage, 401(k), and flexible PTO

Final pay will depend on your background, expertise, and where you live.

Equal Opportunity

Dose is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in all its forms and make all employment decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, in line with applicable laws. If you need an accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know.

Vice President – Direct Originations

Location: Remote
Industry: Equipment Finance and Leasing

Position Overview

Altius Search Group is recruiting an experienced equipment finance originator on behalf of a well-established and growing equipment finance company.

The Vice President – Direct Originations will be responsible for developing new equipment finance relationships directly with middle-market and larger commercial businesses. The successful candidate will identify capital equipment requirements, develop relationships with senior financial decision-makers, and structure financing solutions that support each client’s operational and strategic objectives.

This is a true new-business-development role for an established originator who can independently build a pipeline, open new relationships, and manage opportunities from initial prospecting through credit approval, documentation, and funding.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop new equipment finance business directly with middle-market, large corporate, private equity-sponsored, and other commercial clients.

  • Build and manage an active pipeline through targeted prospecting, referrals, existing industry relationships, and strategic business-development initiatives.

  • Establish relationships with CFOs, treasurers, controllers, procurement leaders, operating executives, private equity sponsors, and other senior decision-makers.

  • Identify upcoming capital expenditures, technology investments, facility expansions, automation projects, and equipment replacement requirements.

  • Structure equipment loans, leases, and customized financing solutions based on each client’s financial objectives and operational needs.

  • Prepare and present financing proposals that clearly communicate the proposed structure, pricing, and overall value to the client.

  • Work closely with credit, operations, documentation, asset management, and senior leadership to move transactions efficiently from the initial opportunity through funding.

  • Gather the financial, operational, and transaction information required to develop complete and compelling credit presentations.

  • Maintain ownership of the client relationship throughout the transaction process and provide consistent communication to all stakeholders.

  • Expand existing relationships by identifying additional equipment categories, locations, business units, and financing requirements.

  • Maintain accurate pipeline reporting, production forecasts, calling activity, and account-development plans.

  • Represent the company professionally at client meetings, industry events, conferences, and other business-development activities.

Target Markets

The originator will have the flexibility to pursue opportunities across a variety of equipment-intensive industries, potentially including:

  • Manufacturing and industrial equipment

  • Technology and information systems

  • Data centers and AI infrastructure

  • Distribution and warehouse automation

  • Healthcare and patient-care technology

  • Construction and commercial equipment

  • Education

  • Transportation

  • Private equity-sponsored portfolio companies

Requirements

Candidate Qualifications

  • Established experience originating equipment finance transactions directly with commercial end users.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently generate new business and maintain a consistent pipeline of qualified opportunities.

  • Existing relationships with middle-market companies, larger corporate borrowers, private equity sponsors, or senior financial decision-makers.

  • Proven record of producing meaningful annual equipment finance volume.

  • Strong understanding of equipment loans, finance leases, tax leases, and other commercial financing structures.

  • Ability to evaluate financial statements and understand cash flow, leverage, liquidity, collateral, and the business purpose behind a transaction.

  • Experience structuring and presenting transactions to credit and senior management.

  • Ability to sell consultatively and communicate value beyond pricing alone.

  • Strong executive presence, communication skills, judgment, and follow-through.

  • Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial, collaborative, and growth-oriented environment.

  • Willingness to travel as necessary for client development and relationship management.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be an experienced direct originator with a portable network of commercial relationships and a history of generating consistent equipment finance production.

The individual should be entrepreneurial and self-directed while also working effectively with internal credit, documentation, and operational partners. Candidates should understand how to develop business directly with middle-market and larger companies rather than relying primarily on broker, vendor, or bank-referral channels.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

  • Join a growing independent equipment finance company with experienced industry leadership.

  • Ability to originate across multiple industries and equipment categories.

  • Flexible underwriting and the ability to evaluate complex business models and transactions.

  • Responsive credit decisions and an efficient transaction process.

  • Opportunity to develop direct relationships with middle-market and larger commercial clients.

  • Entrepreneurial environment with access to senior leadership.

  • Competitive compensation structure with meaningful performance-based earning potential.

Compensation

The company offers a competitive compensation package consisting of a base salary, performance-based incentive compensation, and comprehensive employee benefits. Specific compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, relationships, historical production, and anticipated contribution.

About Altius Search Group

Altius Search Group specializes in executive recruiting within the equipment finance, commercial lending, and leasing industries. All inquiries will be handled confidentially.

Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply or contact Altius Search Group for additional information.

Remote VP opportunity for an established equipment finance originator to develop direct middle-market relationships with a growing independent lender.

During your first three months, you'll receive paid onboarding and training while learning our clients, processes and tools. After this period, the role continues on a commission basis with no earning cap.

If you're used to agency recruitment and enjoy the satisfaction of turning your own pipeline into placements, you'll probably feel at home here.

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact supporting the Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program. GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. The Cyber Security Analyst SME will work as part of the CMM cloud engineering and security team, serving as the program's subject matter expert on information systems security and compliance across its Infrastructure and Application environments.

The CMM program maintains separate evidence mapping for Infrastructure and Application pipelines and mandates pipeline gating so that deployments cannot occur unless security criteria are met. The Cyber Security Analyst SME provides the day-to-day governance and evidence necessary to keep releases moving without compromising control integrity, while serving as the program's subject matter expert on Information Assurance (IA), Computer Network Defense (CND), and enterprise security strategy.

The Cyber Security Analyst SME will execute the following responsibilities:

  • Maintain separate security evidence mapping for Infrastructure and Application pipelines, ensuring artifacts satisfy required controls at each stage of the CI/CD process.
  • Enforce pipeline gating criteria so that deployments cannot proceed to production unless required security evidence and approvals are in place.
  • Perform, monitor, test, and troubleshoot hardware and software Information Assurance (IA) problems pertaining to the Computing Environment (CE), Network Environments (NE), Data Platforms (DP), and enclave environments.
  • Collect and analyze data and events from Computer Network Defense (CND) tools such as system alerts, firewall, and network traffic logs, and host system logs.
  • Assess and identify the systems and networks within the NE acceptable configurations and policies.
  • Develop and manage security for more than one IT functional area (e.g., data, systems, network, and/or web) across the enterprise.
  • Lead the development and implementation of security policies and procedures (e.g., user log-on and authentication rules, security breach escalation procedures, security auditing procedures, and use of firewalls and encryption routines).
  • Brief and present status reports on security matters, developing security risk analysis scenarios and response procedures.
  • Track and monitor software viruses and other malicious code across the environment.
  • Lead the evaluation of products and/or procedures to enhance productivity and effectiveness.
  • Provide direct support to the business and IT staff for security-related issues.
  • Partner with DevSecOps, engineering, and governance teams to integrate security and compliance requirements into the release and deployment process.

  • Experience documenting security incidents and performing security vulnerability assessments.
  • Experience working with Agile teams and SAFe to perform testing and uncover system and network vulnerabilities.
  • Experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
  • Strong working experience in AWS Cloud Security (certification preferred); 3+ years' experience.
  • Prior ATO experience in an AWS environment for a large agency; 4+ years' experience.
  • Solid understanding of NIST Standards.
  • Prior experience with the ATO process, FedRAMP, CIS, and ISO 27001 (4+ years).

  • Experience with CSAM or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with data governance, metadata management, and data quality practices.
  • Experience with SQL for data querying and validation.

  • Familiarity with statistical analysis tools/techniques (e.g., Excel, R, Python) preferred.
  • Experience with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, AWS preferred).
  • Understanding of data architecture concepts (data lake, lakehouse, warehouse).
  • Strong analytical, problem‑solving, & statistical analysis skills with attention to detail and data accuracy.

COMMUNICATION & ORGANIZATIONAL

This individual is accountable for delivery quality, customer adoption, engagement health, partner performance, customer value realization, and overall portfolio success. They are expected to independently assess situations, establish priorities, make informed business decisions, and take proactive action to improve outcomes across their portfolio.

Success in this role requires maintaining detailed visibility into every active engagement, including customer objectives, implementation progress, adoption trends, delivery risks, milestones, partner performance, blockers, and business outcomes. The Senior Partner Success Manager proactively identifies stalled or at-risk engagements, diagnoses root causes, coordinates resolution across internal and external stakeholders, and drives successful customer outcomes.

This role serves as the operational leader across partner-delivered customer engagements, balancing customer success, partner accountability, delivery excellence, AI solution adoption, and operational scalability. The ideal candidate combines strong relationship management skills with business acumen, program management discipline, customer success expertise, and technical fluency in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Large Language Models (LLMs), AI-enabled workflows, automation technologies, and enterprise software solutions. Candidates should have practical experience leveraging AI-driven business solutions and automation as part of their daily work.

ABOUT CONCENTRIX

At Concentrix, we help the world's best brands build exceptional customer experiences through innovative technology, operational excellence, and human-centered solutions. As organizations accelerate adoption of AI, automation, cloud technologies, and digital transformation initiatives, Concentrix partners with clients and strategic ecosystem partners to deliver measurable business outcomes at scale.

We are seeking a Senior Partner Success Manager to drive the successful delivery, adoption, and expansion of partner-led AI solutions while ensuring customers achieve meaningful business value and long-term success.

Success in this role requires comfort operating in a highly dynamic, rapidly evolving environment where priorities shift quickly, new challenges emerge daily, and ambiguity is often present. The ideal candidate thrives in an AI-native culture, demonstrates strong initiative, embraces continuous learning, and can quickly evaluate information, make sound decisions, and drive execution without waiting for direction.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Portfolio Ownership & Customer Engagement Success

  • Own and actively manage a book of business consisting of multiple concurrent partner-led customer engagements, balancing priorities, allocating attention based on business impact, and ensuring successful outcomes across the portfolio.
  • Maintain weekly visibility into each engagement's scope, timeline, milestones, blockers, implementation status, customer health, and adoption trends.
  • Act as the accountable owner for engagement success, making judgment calls regarding prioritization, escalation, intervention strategies, and risk mitigation activities when challenges emerge.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer goals, solution objectives, operational requirements, and success criteria.
  • Coordinate seamless transitions from sales, implementation, deployment, and ongoing customer adoption phases.

Delivery Excellence & Engagement Management

  • Conduct weekly engagement reviews across the portfolio, identifying stalled, delayed, deteriorating, or at-risk engagements and implementing intervention strategies designed to restore momentum and improve customer outcomes.
  • Assess delivery plans, implementation approaches, project governance models, resource allocations, and customer readiness to identify risks before they impact outcomes.
  • Continuously prioritize resources, actions, and stakeholder engagement efforts across the portfolio based on customer impact, business value, risk exposure, and strategic importance.
  • Track engagement progression against milestones, timelines, adoption metrics, and business objectives.
  • Ensure customer deliverables are completed on time, within scope, and aligned to agreed success measures.
  • Maintain a structured operating rhythm that promotes accountability, transparency, and execution excellence.
  • Maintain and execute a self-built weekly engagement review cadence that ensures timely identification, prioritization, and resolution of delivery, adoption, and customer outcome risks across the portfolio.

Risk Management & Issue Resolution

  • Diagnose and remove barriers to successful delivery, including partner capacity constraints, implementation delays, resource challenges, scope changes, customer readiness issues, technical dependencies, adoption risks, and change management obstacles.
  • Exercise independent judgment to determine when intervention is required, when risks should be escalated, and what recovery actions are necessary to protect customer outcomes.
  • Evaluate competing priorities, incomplete information, and complex stakeholder dynamics to make sound business decisions in fast-moving situations.
  • Lead structured recovery efforts for red, escalated, or strategically important customer accounts, driving accountability across all involved stakeholders.
  • Manage escalations involving delivery quality, customer satisfaction, implementation performance, partner accountability, adoption concerns, or operational execution.
  • Bring forward clear diagnoses, accountable owners, remediation plans, and timelines for resolution rather than simply reporting status.
  • Drive issues through resolution by coordinating efforts across customers, partners, delivery teams, product teams, alliance organizations, and executive stakeholders.
  • Develop recovery plans for stalled, underperforming, or at-risk engagements.

Customer Adoption, Consumption & Business Outcomes

  • Own customer adoption, utilization, consumption growth, retention indicators, and business value realization across the portfolio.
  • Identify customers showing declining adoption, stalled progress, or realization gaps and proactively design intervention plans to improve engagement health and business outcomes.
  • Monitor customer engagement metrics to identify trends, opportunities, and potential risks.
  • Develop and execute action plans to improve customer adoption, operational effectiveness, and solution utilization.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Sales, Delivery, and Product teams to maximize customer value and expansion opportunities.
  • Track and report on metrics related to adoption growth, business outcomes, engagement completion, and customer success.
  • Demonstrate accountability for measurable outcomes tied to completed delivery, customer adoption, utilization, consumption, retention, time-to-value achievement, and realization of documented customer business outcomes.

Partner Leadership & Accountability

  • Build trusted executive-level relationships with partner practice leaders, delivery leaders, alliance executives, architects, engagement managers, and operational stakeholders.
  • Influence, challenge, and hold partners accountable for delivery performance, staffing decisions, operational execution, customer commitments, and business outcomes.
  • Hold partners accountable for engagement execution, customer outcomes, adoption targets, and delivery performance.
  • Provide data-driven recommendations and constructive challenge when partner decisions, delivery approaches, or resource allocations may negatively impact customer success.
  • Drive difficult conversations when necessary, using sound judgment and business rationale to align partners around corrective actions and improved performance.
  • Lead quarterly partner practice reviews and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with partner alliance and delivery leaders, establishing and monitoring joint goals for completed customer engagements, customer adoption, certified practitioner capacity, customer references, repeatable offerings, and industry positioning.
  • Help partners strengthen their AI delivery capability, grow certified AI expertise, develop repeatable AI solutions, and create customer success stories that can be used to support future client engagements.
  • Steward partner co-investment and program funding requests by assessing each request against a defined customer or business outcome, recommending approval or rejection, and reconciling investment against agreed milestones and achieved results.

Practice Development & Operational Excellence

  • Create scalable operating models, governance frameworks, review methodologies, engagement health assessments, escalation processes, success plans, and delivery playbooks.
  • Transform successful engagement practices into repeatable methodologies that improve consistency, scalability, and operational performance.
  • Document and institutionalize best practices, engagement review frameworks, risk management processes, and adoption strategies.
  • Continuously improve operational effectiveness through process optimization and performance analysis.
  • Help shape the long-term Partner Success operating model for Concentrix AI-enabled service offerings.

AI, LLM & Technology Enablement

  • Demonstrate advanced proficiency using AI, LLMs, automation platforms, and emerging agentic AI technologies as a core component of daily work.
  • Regularly utilize agentic AI tools and AI-powered assistants to analyze portfolio health, identify risks, generate recommendations, uncover trends, automate workflows, and improve operational decision-making.
  • Leverage AI to increase scale, efficiency, and effectiveness while applying independent business judgment to validate recommendations and determine appropriate actions.
  • Apply AI tools to analyze customer data, identify risks, generate recommendations, streamline workflows, and improve decision-making.
  • Utilize AI-generated insights while applying sound business judgment and operational expertise.
  • Leverage customer telemetry, engagement metrics, adoption data, and operational reporting to drive actions and recommendations.
  • Stay informed on advancements in AI, LLMs, automation, SaaS platforms, and enterprise technologies impacting customers and partners.
  • Champion AI-first ways of working and identify opportunities to embed AI-driven processes into customer, partner, and operational workflows.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Professional Services, Operations, Support, Solution Design, Alliance, and Executive Leadership teams to drive alignment and successful customer outcomes.
  • Build alignment across stakeholders with differing priorities, ensuring decisions are made and actions are executed in a timely manner.
  • Coordinate successful handoffs between customer acquisition, implementation, delivery, and adoption activities.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor regarding customer health, partner performance, operational risks, and engagement status.
  • Present recommendations, performance updates, escalation plans, and business reviews to executive, technical, and operational audiences.

SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE WILL BE MEASURED BY

  • Customer adoption and utilization growth
  • Customer satisfaction and retention
  • Engagement completion within scope and timeline commitments
  • Time from engagement assignment to successful completion
  • AI solution adoption and consumption growth
  • Partner performance and relationship strength
  • At-risk engagement identification and recovery effectiveness
  • Time from an engagement being identified as stalled or at risk to successful resolution and restoration of forward progress.
  • Escalation resolution effectiveness and speed
  • Portfolio health and risk reduction
  • Customer business outcome achievement
  • Executive stakeholder trust and engagement
  • Operational scalability and process improvement
  • Adherence to and effectiveness of a structured, self-built weekly portfolio review rhythm that consistently identifies risks, drives accountability, and improves engagement outcomes.
  • Development and adoption of repeatable playbooks, methodologies, and governance frameworks
  • Effective use of AI-enabled solutions and automation to improve business outcomes

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in Partner Success, Customer Success, Delivery Management, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Consulting, Program Management, or related fields.
  • Experience owning a high-volume portfolio of concurrent customer engagements, projects, implementations, or accounts (typically 10-30 simultaneously) from initiation through successful outcomes.
  • Demonstrated success managing metrics tied to customer behavior and business outcomes, including adoption, utilization, consumption, retention, customer success, or expansion.
  • Demonstrated ownership of delivery outcomes, customer adoption, utilization, retention, consumption growth, time-to-value, or business value realization, with the ability to quantify impact and results achieved.
  • Experience reviewing implementation plans, delivery approaches, project scope, and customer readiness to identify execution risk and drive successful outcomes.
  • Ability to interpret statements of work (SOWs), delivery commitments, implementation plans, governance models, and documented success criteria, and identify gaps between contracted outcomes, partner execution, and actual customer experience.
  • Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex delivery, adoption, operational, and stakeholder challenges.
  • Ability to describe, in specific and personal terms, at least one stalled or at-risk customer engagement they individually diagnosed, led, and successfully unblocked, distinct from activities primarily executed by a broader team.
  • Strong experience managing escalations and recovering at-risk customer engagements.
  • Deep understanding of customer success within usage-based, subscription-based, SaaS, AI, cloud, or technology-driven businesses.
  • Experience designing operational processes, governance models, frameworks, methodologies, playbooks, or review structures that scale across teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influence skills across customer, partner, executive, technical, and operational audiences.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and executive communication skills.
  • Technical fluency sufficient to lead delivery reviews, evaluate implementation plans, participate in solution discussions, and engage credibly with technical stakeholders.
  • Proven hands-on experience leveraging AI, LLMs, agentic AI tools, AI-enabled workflows, automation technologies, or AI-driven business solutions as part of daily operations. Candidates should be able to demonstrate how AI has been used to improve decision-making, operational efficiency, customer outcomes, productivity, or business results.
  • Proven hands-on experience using an LLM to build or materially improve a business workflow, analytical deliverable, operating process, or customer solution. Candidates must be able to demonstrate a real artifact or workflow, explain the problem addressed, describe how prompts or instructions were refined, identify limitations or unsupported outputs, and articulate the resulting business impact.

Preferred

  • Experience in roles with direct accountability for delivery execution, customer outcomes, implementation success, adoption, utilization, and value realization. Candidates whose background is primarily limited to relationship management, account stewardship, sales, or account growth without ownership of delivery outcomes may not be successful in this role.
  • Experience leading red account reviews, executive escalations, customer recovery programs, and structured intervention planning for at-risk accounts.
  • 5 to 8+ years supporting systems integrators, consulting firms, alliance partners, or partner-led delivery organizations.
  • Experience working with organizations such as Accenture, Deloitte, Capgemini, Cognizant, Infosys, TCS, Wipro, or similar consulting and integration partners.
  • Experience supporting SaaS, AI, cloud, enterprise software, professional services, or digital transformation environments.
  • Experience managing offshore, contract, or shared services delivery resources.
  • Experience administering co-investment funding, innovation initiatives, partner enablement programs, or market development funds.
  • Experience leading executive Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).
  • Industry expertise in Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Retail, Manufacturing, Technology, or Public Sector markets.
  • Experience supporting enterprise and strategic customer accounts.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Gainsight, HubSpot, Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent CRM and customer success platforms.
  • Must reside in the United States and have a valid U.S. residential address.

The salary for this position is $105,000 to 110,000 Annually, plus bonus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program (EAP), 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays, and paid training days.

WHY JOIN CONCENTRIX

At Concentrix, you'll help shape the future of AI-powered customer experiences while partnering with one of the world's leading AI-native organizations. You'll operate in a fast-moving environment where AI is embedded into daily workflows, decisions are made quickly, ownership is expected, and innovation is constant. This role offers the opportunity to directly influence customer success, partner performance, AI adoption, and business outcomes at scale.

We’re equally committed to building a career environment where talented engineers can do their best work, grow their expertise, and make a real impact.

In June2024, Haag merged with Salas O’Brien, expanding what’s possible for our team. Haag remains focused on forensic engineering, and we now offer the added strength of a broader, employee-owned organization. This brings deeper technical resources, expanded collaboration, and more opportunities to build your career across a wide range of disciplines and industries.

Founded in 1975, Salas O’Brien is an employee-owned engineering and professional services firm focused on achieving impact for our clients, our team, and the world. We are engineered for impact, and we bring that same commitment to our people as we do to our projects. We live our values every day: Inspire, Achieve, and Connect, as shared owners of our success with a focus on a sustainable future.

We work across a variety of industries providing integrated engineering and consulting services. Our specialized experience includes design for energy, manufacturing and industrial process, data centers, healthcare, science and technology, high-rise buildings, education, and other building types as well as structural and building sciences, infrastructure asset management, advanced robotics, and more. Our technical expertise is paired with an exceptional team of business development, human resources, finance and accounting, information technology, and marketing professionals, all of whom play a key role in bringing our commitments to deliver outstanding client outcomes and build long-term careers.

Job Summary: We’re seeking an experienced Forensic Structural Engineer in the Columbus, OH area. In this remote/home office role, you will investigate and evaluate the cause and extent of structural damage resulting from storms, natural disasters, fires/explosions, construction/design defects, accidents, foundation movement, and more.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Forensic Investigations: Conduct site inspections to determine the cause, origin, and extent of structural damage; evaluate failure modes and contributing factors.
  • Analysis & Reporting: Develop clear, well-supported conclusions and produce high-quality technical reports, documentation, and deliverables.
  • Client Communication: Provide timely, professional updates to clients, contractors, and internal stakeholders; proactively close communication gaps and manage expectations.
  • Collaboration & Independence: Work independently from a home office while leveraging internal experts and resources; build long-term relationships with colleagues, clients, and partners.
  • Project Ownership: Drive issues to resolution with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring deliverables meet or exceed customer expectations and applicable standards.
  • Continuous Improvement: Contribute ideas that strengthen processes, tools, and customer outcomes; help others navigate change and adopt improvements.

Qualifications and Experience

Experience:

  • 2+ years of forensic engineering experience required; 5–10 years preferred.
  • Must be able to work independently and with a cross-functional team of experts.
  • Strong technical writing skills are required; the ability to write effective reports is critical. Strong verbal communication skills are necessary; you should be an effective communicator in face-to-face interactions.
  • The ability to provide the utmost in customer service to our clients is a must.
  • Technical proficiency with computers, phones, cameras, etc.
  • Expert Witness experience is preferred.
  • You must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship or any restrictions.

Licensure:

  • Professional Engineer (P.E.) license in Ohio is required, or eligible by reciprocity.

Physical & Travel Requirements:

  • Ability to perform fieldwork, including confined spaces and roof inspections.
  • Must be able to carry ladders and operate required equipment.
  • Willingness to travel locally, regionally, and nationally by vehicle or plane as needed.
  • Some overnight travel will be required. However, most investigations can be done without overnight travel.

Education:

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Civil or Structural Engineering or a closely related degree from an ABET-accredited university required.
  • Master of Science Degree in Civil or Structural Engineering preferred.

Location:

  • Remote (home office) – Cleveland, OH area

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Base salary range: $115,000 – $165,000 per year.
  • In addition to the base salary, the compensation plan includes additional, nondiscretionary compensation based on billable productivity above a minimum threshold. Employees may elect at any time to transition to a model based primarily on a higher percentage of their billable rate applied to all billable hours worked. In practice, most employees choose to transition between approximately one and three years, once their billable hours support consistently higher earnings under this model.

This role is also eligible for a comprehensive U.S. based benefits package, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off and company holidays
  • Wellness programs and employee assistance resources
  • Professional development support

jobs.title: Jr. Salesforce Administrator / QA Tester
jobs.excerpt: Role Summary Prove Partners is consolidating two Salesforce orgs and migrating a legacy system of record into Salesforce.
jobs.description:
Role Summary
Prove Partners is consolidating two Salesforce orgs and migrating a legacy system of record into Salesforce. The program runs in continuous release cycles, and every cycle changes objects, page layouts, permission sets, flows, Apex, and integrations. Each of those changes has to be proven out end to end before it reaches production users.

We are looking for a junior Salesforce administrator (remote) who wants to spend the bulk of their time in structured, repeatable quality assurance. This person will execute full end-to-end test passes in our sandboxes, over and over, across each release: building and maintaining the test scripts, running them, logging what breaks, retesting fixes, and confirming regressions have not been introduced elsewhere.

Repetition is the job, not a side effect of it. The right candidate is someone who is genuinely comfortable running the same 200-step regression pass every sprint and catching the one step that changed — and who is methodical enough to keep the documentation accurate while doing it.

Engagement at a Glance

Working titleJunior Salesforce Administrator / QA TesterReports toDirector of Program Management & CRMLocationOffshore / nearshore, fully remoteTime zone requirementMinimum 6 hours of daily overlap with 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. US EasternCommitmentFull-time, 40 hours per weekDuration6–12 months, with option to extendEngagement typeOpen — vendor staff augmentation, individual contractor, or employer-of-recordSeniorityJunior (1–3 years); this is a hands-on execution role, not a lead role
Time zone is a hard requirement. Testing is iterative and conversational — the tester needs to be able to ask an administrator or developer a question and get an answer inside the same working session. Candidates should be located where the standard working day overlaps with US Eastern.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-end and regression testing (primary, ~60% of time)

  • Execute full end-to-end test passes across core business processes in the sandbox environments, following documented scripts, for every release cycle.
  • Run regression suites after each configuration or code change to confirm that existing functionality still behaves as expected.
  • Test across the full record lifecycle — record creation, field updates, stage and status transitions, automation firing, downstream record effects, and reporting output.
  • Retest and close out defects after fixes are deployed, and confirm the fix has not broken adjacent functionality.
  • Validate behavior after sandbox refreshes and deployments, including smoke testing of critical paths.

Test design and documentation (~20% of time)

  • Write and maintain test cases and test scripts from user stories, acceptance criteria, and process documentation.
  • Keep the test case library current as requirements change; retire cases that no longer apply and add coverage for new functionality.
  • Log defects with clear, reproducible steps, expected vs. actual results, affected records, screenshots, and severity.
  • Maintain test execution records so that release readiness can be assessed at a glance.

Test data and environment support (~10% of time)

  • Prepare and refresh test data sets, including bulk loads via Data Loader or Data Import Wizard.
  • Write basic SOQL queries to verify data state and confirm expected record changes.
  • Test across multiple user profiles and permission sets to confirm record visibility, field-level security, and sharing behave correctly for each role.

Light administrative configuration (~10% of time)

  • Perform straightforward declarative configuration under supervision — custom fields, page layouts, list views, validation rules, simple reports and dashboards.
  • Assist with user setup, permission set assignment, and access troubleshooting.
  • Support user acceptance testing cycles: prepare UAT scripts, walk business testers through them, and consolidate their feedback.

Required Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of hands-on experience in a Salesforce environment as an administrator, QA tester, business analyst, or support analyst.
  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce platform: standard and custom objects, record types, page layouts, profiles and permission sets, validation rules, and Flow.
  • Demonstrated experience executing manual test cases and logging defects in a tracked system (Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar).
  • Ability to read a user story or acceptance criteria and translate it into concrete test steps.
  • Comfort with repetitive, detail-intensive work and a track record of sustained accuracy in it.
  • Basic SOQL and comfort with Data Loader or a comparable data tool.
  • Clear written and spoken English — defect reports and test notes are read by developers and business stakeholders, so writing quality matters.
  • Availability for the required daily overlap with US Eastern business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM-201) — preferred, not required. Hands-on experience carries more weight than the credential, and we will consider candidates who are working toward it.
  • Experience testing during a data migration or multi-org consolidation.
  • Exposure to integration testing between Salesforce and external systems, including basic API concepts.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or comparable tracking and documentation tools.
  • Any experience with test automation (Selenium, Provar, Playwright) or reading Apex test results — useful, but this role is manual-first.
  • Background in healthcare, insurance, legal services, or another regulated environment where access control and audit trails matter.

What Success Looks Like

  • By 15 days: has run a full end-to-end pass on at least one core process independently, using existing scripts, and is logging usable defects without rework.
  • By 30 days: is authoring new test cases from user stories with minimal correction, and owns the regression suite for at least one functional area.
  • By 60 days: is the reliable go-to for release readiness on their areas — the team trusts that if this person has signed off, the release is safe to deploy.

jobs.description:
Welcome to Centr - The Home of Strength

Centr is a performance fitness platform founded by Chris Hemsworth. We sell connected fitness equipment, digital training subscriptions, and bundles that combine both. We're the official equipment provider for HYROX.

Our subscription business is the engine, and the funnel doesn't yet deliver. Mobile converts respectably; web converts far below it. Paid acquisition costs more than a product this good should have to spend. And the biggest opportunity is hiding in plain sight: equipment buyers, customers who already paid us hundreds or thousands of dollars and unlocked a free trial as part of their purchase, convert at a fraction of other channels. The people who signaled the highest intent are opportunities we're losing. We're not asking you to optimize a mature funnel. We're asking you to build one.

About the role

You own the subscription funnel from the moment a user encounters Centr through their first 30 days of paid usage. Web pages between ad click and trial start, in-app onboarding through first workout, offer architecture at trial end, cancellation, and the in-app surfaces that drive equipment upsell once they're a subscriber. You'll work next to the Sr. Ecom Manager (storefront, CRM, bundle), our growth agency (paid acquisition), and the Core UX product team (long-term in-app experience).

A dedicated full-stack web engineer is paired to you, and the two of you ship the web funnel autonomously. Paywalls and pricing iterate via RevenueCat config without dev tickets. Native mobile work routes through Core UX engineering, so part of your job is making the case for prioritization rather than assuming the capacity.

We move these numbers by building experiences worth converting on. Our read is that the funnel underperforms because the experience does, not because we haven't pushed hard enough. We'd rather earn a subscription than trap someone into one. Get the experience right and the numbers follow.

What you'll own

  • Web subscription onboarding. Signup, assessment, paywall, offer, trial activation. Closing the conversion gap between web and mobile is a first-90-days priority.
  • QR-to-app landing. The post-scan experience for retail equipment buyers (Costco, Academy) and bundle buyers.
  • In-app activation. Install through day 7. Onboarding flow, day-0/1/3 nudges, push, in-app engagement during trial.
  • Trial-to-paid conversion. Offer architecture at trial end, in-app re-engagement, cancellation on web and in-app, win-back surfaces inside the product.
  • Pricing and packaging. Plan architecture across iOS, Android, and web. Differentiated offers for new vs. returning vs. lapsed users.
  • In-app equipment upsell. The shopping feature, placement, and surfacing logic that turns subscribers into bundle and equipment buyers.

What success looks like

  • Web trial conversion closes a meaningful share of the gap to mobile
  • iOS install → paid conversion improves materially against today's baseline
  • A QR-to-app flow we're excited to point Costco and Academy traffic at
  • An in-app equipment upsell surface producing measurable attach from existing subscribers
  • A cancellation flow that recovers a respectable share of would-be churners
  • CAC payback shortened enough that paid spend can scale with confidence

You should apply if

  • You've owned a subscription funnel end-to-end and moved trial-to-paid at consumer scale
  • You've shipped against both mobile (iOS/Android) and web subscription flows and understand why they behave differently
  • You know where the landmines are in RevenueCat, App Store / Play Store, Stripe, and Recharge
  • You believe the best growth work is indistinguishable from the best product work. You move trial-to-paid by making the trial deliver value, not by hiding the cancel button
  • You're effective at influencing roadmaps you don't own (a meaningful chunk of your highest-leverage work lives inside the Core UX roadmap)
  • You spend more time in Claude Code than anyone you know

This might not be the right fit if

  • Your experience is all with mature, well-instrumented funnels. Building one from zero is a different muscle, and this role is mostly the zero-to-one kind
  • You love CRO and landing-page work but don't want to own pricing, paywalls, and trial design alongside it
  • You'd rather hit targets with pressure tactics than earn them through the experience
  • You want to own strategy and hand off execution. Here you'd do both
  • You want a proven playbook to run. We're still writing ours, and that's the fun of it

Why this role

Centr's subscription business has the brand, the content, the equipment, and the HYROX tailwind. What it's missing is someone to own the funnel that ties them together. If building that sounds like the best problem you could be working on, we'd like to meet you.

JOB PURPOSE AND SUMMARY

Under the direction of the Compliance Manager, the Compliance Analyst supports the organization's compliance program through regulatory change management, grievances and complaints, OSHA and clinic compliance, licensing, audits, corrective actions, reporting, and driving process improvement.

This is a remote position requiring a detail-oriented and organized professional who can manage multiple priorities, exercise sound judgment, communicate effectively with stakeholders, and independently manage assigned projects and responsibilities.

  • Live and exemplify Starling Oncology's core values while promoting a positive experience for patients, providers, and staff.

  • Analyze compliance data and maintain reporting, documentation, and tracking systems to support regulatory requirements, audit readiness, and informed decision-making.
  • Identify and implement process and workflow improvements through the development and enhancement of procedures, tools, and technology solutions.
  • Support the development, implementation, and communication of compliance policies, procedures, training materials, and educational resources.
  • Build and maintain effective working relationships of trust and confidence with internal and external stakeholders regarding assigned compliance matters.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Self-starter with the ability to take initiative, solve problems, and follow through on commitments.
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess risk and develop practical recommendations.
  • Strong organizational, planning, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage competing deadlines while maintaining accuracy and quality.
  • Solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to identify challenges, assess risk, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships, collaborate across teams, and communicate professionally with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to interpret regulatory and operational requirements and translate them into actionable business practices.
  • Ability to leverage technology and business applications to improve efficiency, reporting, and workflow management.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information, with a focus on patient privacy, professionalism, integrity, and discretion.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and other business applications.
  • Experience in healthcare compliance, regulatory affairs, grievances and appeals, auditing, quality, risk management, or healthcare operations required.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION, AND/OR TRAINING

The position primarily involves prolonged periods of sitting, extensive computer use, and frequent phone and virtual communication.
