Role: Curriculum Developer (Data)

Team: Product

Package: Pension, Unlimited Leave, Flexible Working

Location: Remote (occasional face-to-face meetings as required)

Duration: Permanent, Full Time

About Corndel:

Corndel is an award‑winning UK training provider specialising in high‑quality leadership and technology programmes that accelerate organisational and personal performance. We partner with many of the UK’s largest and most forward‑thinking employers to deliver practical, impactful learning that aligns with real business priorities.

With a fast‑growing, entrepreneurial culture, Corndel offers an environment where driven, ambitious people can thrive. We combine high standards, a supportive team ethos, and a commitment to inclusivity to ensure colleagues can do their best work and progress in their careers.

The New Client Acquisition Team targets companies in the private, public and charity sectors, building strategic partnerships with large organisations to develop their employees in line with talent and digital strategies.

The Role

Join us as a Curriculum Developer for Data and play a key role in shaping, developing, and continuously improving our Data and AI apprenticeship programmes.

As part of the Product team, you will help create high-quality learning experiences that help learners build the skills, knowledge, and behaviours they need to succeed in a rapidly evolving data and AI landscape.

You will work flexibly across our Data product portfolio, supporting different programmes depending on business priorities and areas of development. This may include core apprenticeship programmes, programme variants, and tailored client solutions. Your work could involve developing new curriculum, enhancing existing learning journeys, adapting content for different learner or client contexts, and supporting major programme builds.

A key focus of the role will be creating and refining engaging e-learning content and supporting materials, ensuring they are clear, accessible, technically accurate, and aligned to apprenticeship standards and real-world industry practice. Working closely with Product Managers, coaches, subject matter experts, and other Curriculum Developers, you will translate complex Data and AI concepts into practical, meaningful learning experiences.

The role will also include reviewing and quality assuring existing curriculum content. You will evaluate learning materials for accuracy, relevance, consistency, accessibility, and learner experience, identifying opportunities to improve or modernise content as technologies, industry practices, programme requirements, and learner needs evolve.

Continuous improvement will be a core part of your work. You will monitor and respond to learner and coach feedback, review programme performance and content-related queries, identify recurring themes, and make iterative enhancements to the curriculum. You may also use tools such as Jira to track, prioritise, and resolve curriculum issues, helping us maintain a consistently high-quality learning experience across our Data programmes.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, refine, and maintain high-quality curriculum content across Data programmes, including e-learning materials, activities, assessments, and supporting resources.

  • Support the development of new programmes, programme variants, and bespoke or client-specific learning solutions in response to business priorities.

  • Review and quality assure existing curriculum content, identifying opportunities to improve accuracy, accessibility, consistency, relevance, and learner experience.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers, coaches, Curriculum Developers, and subject matter experts to ensure content is engaging, technically accurate, and aligned with programme requirements.

  • Translate complex Data and AI concepts into clear, practical, and accessible learning experiences for learners with a range of backgrounds and experience levels.

  • Continuously improve curriculum by analysing feedback from learners, coaches, and stakeholders and implementing appropriate iterative enhancements.

  • Monitor curriculum-related queries and issues, identifying recurring themes and using these insights to inform improvements.

  • Use tools such as Jira to log, track, prioritise, and resolve curriculum-related work and content issues.

  • Keep learning content current with developments in data, analytics, artificial intelligence, tools, technologies, and industry practice.

  • Support curriculum quality assurance processes and maintain consistently high standards across learning materials and programmes.

  • Identify opportunities to enhance learner engagement, progression, and outcomes through improvements to content, activities, and learning design.

  • Ensure learning content is appropriately aligned to relevant apprenticeship standards, assessment requirements, and End-Point Assessment expectations.

About You

You’ll be someone who combines strong technical understanding with an ability to turn complex concepts into clear, engaging learning experiences. You’ll be comfortable working across both Data and AI subject areas, adapting quickly as programme priorities evolve.

Essential

  • Strong knowledge of data analytics concepts and practices, with the ability to explain technical topics clearly and accurately.

  • Good understanding of AI and its practical applications, including how AI tools are used in modern workplaces.

  • Experience developing, reviewing, or improving learning content, training materials, e-learning, or technical educational resources.

  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible, and engaging learning experiences for different audiences.

  • Strong written communication skills and excellent attention to detail.

  • Confidence reviewing technical content for accuracy, clarity, consistency, and relevance.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with Product Managers, subject matter experts, coaches, and other stakeholders.

  • Comfortable managing competing priorities and working flexibly across different programmes or projects.

  • A continuous-improvement mindset, with the ability to use feedback and evidence to identify and implement improvements.

  • Ability to research unfamiliar or emerging technical topics and build sufficient subject knowledge to create high-quality learning content.

Desirable

  • Experience developing curriculum or learning content within Data, Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical field.

  • Experience working within apprenticeships, further education, professional learning, or adult education.

  • Knowledge of apprenticeship standards, KSBs, assessment plans, or End-Point Assessment.

  • Hands-on experience with data tools or languages such as Excel, Power BI, SQL, Tableau, Python, Google Sheets, Looker Studio, or similar.

  • Familiarity with modern AI tools and technologies such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude, or other generative AI platforms.

  • Understanding of topics such as machine learning, generative AI, prompt engineering, AI ethics, responsible AI, or AI governance.

  • Experience using authoring or learning technologies to create digital learning content.

  • Experience working in an Agile, Product, or iterative development environment, including tools such as Jira.

  • Experience in quality assurance or peer reviewing technical learning materials.

Why join Corndel?

  • We're committed to having a fully inclusive, welcoming and safe culture and always striving to improve.

  • We provide an environment that is truly flexible and supportive, somewhere you will have autonomy over your role.

  • We're a leader in our field, with quality and excellence at the heart of what we do.

As part of our commitment to create an inclusive workplace where all colleagues can be their true selves, excel in their roles and progress in their careers, we recognise the importance of embracing the diversity in the working population and making Corndel a fully accessible employer.

As Corndel is a Disability Confident Employer, we make sure that a fair and proportionate number of disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for a job will be offered an interview. If you would like to be considered under this scheme, when submitting your application, please select the appropriate option to let us know that you have a disability. Please note this does not mean that all disabled people are entitled to an interview, in some recruitment situations such as peak times, we might need to limit the overall numbers of interviews we offer.

If you have a disability that might affect any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know about any help or reasonable adjustments you need before any interview or assessment. We’ll work with you to make sure any appropriate support is in place and make the application process a more positive experience.

Corndel is committed to safeguarding and safer recruitment practices, and will undertake pre-employment checks on the successful candidate, including DBS Disclosure.

jobs.excerpt: About CoVet At CoVet, we're building AI-powered tools that help veterinary professionals spend less time on paperwork and more time caring for animals.
jobs.description:
About CoVet

At CoVet, we're building AI-powered tools that help veterinary professionals spend less time on paperwork and more time caring for animals.

Veterinary teams are stretched thin. Long hours, administrative burden, and burnout are challenges across the industry. We're on a mission to change that. Our AI copilot helps veterinary professionals save time, improve workflows, and focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional patient care.

We're a globally distributed team united by a shared mission to support veterinary professionals through thoughtful technology. We move quickly, collaborate openly, and believe great ideas can come from anyone.

If you're excited by the opportunity to shape the future of veterinary medicine while working alongside an ambitious and supportive team, we'd love to meet you.

About the role

We're looking for a hands-on QA Lead to own and evolve our approach to quality across CoVet's web and mobile products.

This role combines strong technical QA expertise with leadership, judgment, and ownership. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, and Design to establish testing standards, identify risks early, coordinate testing efforts, and ensure releases meet a consistently high quality bar.

You'll remain actively involved in testing while providing direction and mentorship to other QA team members. You'll help determine how testing should be approached across features and releases, improve the consistency and effectiveness of our QA processes, and play a key role in shaping our long-term automation strategy.

We're looking for someone who understands not only how to test and automate software, but how to build a scalable quality function. You'll know when manual testing provides the most value, what should be automated, where risk is highest, and how QA can be integrated throughout the development lifecycle rather than operating as a final checkpoint.

Exciting Opportunities in this Role

  • Own and evolve the QA strategy for an AI-powered product used by veterinary professionals around the world.
  • Set testing standards, processes, and best practices across web and mobile applications.
  • Lead release readiness and help Product and Engineering make informed decisions around quality and risk.
  • Mentor and support QA team members, helping strengthen testing methodology, technical skills, and consistency across the team.
  • Shape and execute our automation strategy, including determining what should be automated and how automation should be structured and maintained.
  • Work with modern development workflows and technologies, including Playwright, GitHub Actions, AI-assisted testing, and Agile delivery.
  • Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and Designers throughout the development lifecycle to identify risks before they become defects.
  • Improve visibility into product quality through clear reporting on testing progress, defects, risks, and release readiness.
  • Help build scalable QA practices as our product, engineering team, and customer base continue to grow.

Qualifications

We're more interested in finding the right person than checking every box.

  • 6+ years of professional experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing, including experience operating at a senior or lead level.
  • Experience testing both web and mobile applications.
  • Experience leading QA activities across features, projects, or releases.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor or provide technical direction to other QA professionals.
  • Strong experience working cross-functionally with Product and Engineering teams in an Agile environment.
QA Leadership & Strategy
  • Ability to establish and continuously improve QA standards, processes, and testing practices.
  • Experience developing test strategies and determining appropriate testing coverage based on product risk and business impact.
  • Ability to lead test planning and coordinate QA activities across multiple features or workstreams.
  • Strong judgment around release readiness, defect severity, prioritization, and acceptable levels of risk.
  • Ability to identify quality risks early and influence requirements, design, and implementation before development is complete.
  • Experience mentoring QA team members and reviewing test plans, test cases, and testing approaches.
  • Ability to communicate quality trends, risks, blockers, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Test Design & Methodology
  • Strong command of ISTQB-style test design techniques, including equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis, decision tables, and state transition testing.
  • Ability to design and review structured, executable test cases with clear preconditions, steps, and expected results.
  • Strong understanding of testing types, including static, smoke, regression, exploratory, integration, functional, and end-to-end testing.
  • Deep understanding of the defect lifecycle and effective defect triage practices.
  • Strong understanding of Agile development workflows and how QA can add value throughout each phase of delivery.
  • Experience developing risk-based testing approaches that balance speed, coverage, and product impact.
Automation
  • Hands-on experience with web automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar.
  • Ability to read, write, review, and maintain automated test suites.
  • Strong understanding of automation strategy, including determining what to automate, when to automate it, and when manual testing provides greater value.
  • Experience designing or influencing maintainable automation architecture, including Page Object Models, reusable components, data-driven approaches, stable selectors, and effective wait strategies.
  • Understanding of how automation strategy should apply across both web and mobile applications.
  • Experience incorporating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Mobile automation experience using frameworks such as Appium, Patrol, or Maestro is a plus.
  • We value thoughtful automation

Why Join Us

  • Flexible remote-first work environment
  • Competitive compensation
  • Generous vacation and time-off policies
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth
  • A culture built on trust, collaboration, and impact

Compensation

We believe in paying our team members fairly and competitively. Compensation is determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and local market benchmarks.

As a globally distributed company, salary ranges are localized to reflect the market for comparable roles in a candidate's country or region. We'll discuss compensation expectations and provide transparency around our approach throughout the interview process.

CoVet is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace where everyone can do their best work. If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We're happy to work with you to ensure an accessible and positive candidate experience.

Hiring in the UK ideally for onsite Cambridge or East Coast US for a remote position.

Neat's Business Systems team runs the systems behind how the company sells, bills, and supports its customers — Salesforce, NetSuite, Celigo, and the integrations tying them together — for about 400 people across the business. Operating as a lean team, we manage live production support in parallel with our strategic technology roadmap, without a separate operations layer.

We are transforming our development model to focus on building custom, user-centric solutions—and seeking candidates who thrive in creating innovative, high-impact software. As an early member of this evolving model, you will directly influence our technical architecture, development operations, and long-term engineering strategy.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Business Systems Manager to own the intent layer of our systems roadmap and help stand up the infrastructure that lets us build fast without breaking things — turning ambiguous business asks into structured, buildable specs, and partnering with our Business Systems Software Engineer and platform admins on the DevOps, data quality, and context work behind every release. You'll be a core part of modernizing Neat's quoting, dynamic pricing, and subscription management systems.

Responsibilities

  • Own the business systems intake process, triaging requests from cross-functional stakeholders (Sales Ops, Finance, Channel, Product, Marketing) into a structured, prioritized backlog.

  • Lead agile delivery — sprint planning, backlog grooming, and UAT — translating operational asks into user stories with clear, testable acceptance criteria.

  • Partner with the Business Systems Software Engineer to stand up the infrastructure and DevOps practices — environments, deployment pipelines, testing and rollback — that let a small team ship fast without breaking production.

  • Own data quality across our core systems: audit, clean, and put ongoing checks in place so bad data doesn't undermine automation, reporting, or customer-facing systems.

  • Build and maintain the context libraries that keep the knowledge our engineering work builds from accurate and current.

  • Work day-to-day with the broader Business Systems team — our Salesforce and NetSuite/Celigo admins — to route requests to the right owner, diagnose root cause when data integrity breaks, and confirm specs are grounded in what the platforms can actually do.

  • Translate business asks into specs precise enough that the Business Systems Software Engineer can execute without renegotiating scope mid-build, and sanity-check architecture and data-flow decisions rather than rubber-stamp them.

  • Balance shipping a fast MVP against the long-term roadmap — know when a manual workaround is fine for now and when it isn't.

About You

  • 5+ years in business systems analysis, product management, or revenue operations, with deep hands-on experience in Salesforce and NetSuite.

  • Experience setting up or maturing DevOps practices — environments, CI/CD, release management — in a small or resource-constrained team.

  • Comfortable owning data quality: auditing, cleaning, and building the checks that keep it that way.

  • Platform fluency deep enough to tell a five-minute config fix from a real re-architecture, and to write specs the Business Systems Software Engineer can build from without back-and-forth.

  • Track record turning ambiguous business problems into structured, prioritized backlogs with clear acceptance criteria, and leading agile delivery end to end, including UAT.

  • Real, hands-on experience shipping production work with AI development tools — not someone who's only experimented with them.

  • Working knowledge of subscription/entitlement mechanics — proration, true-forward reconciliation, co-terming — enough to spec requirements and sanity-check engineering work.

  • Comfortable coordinating and building trust across a small cross-functional team — admins, the software developers, and business leadership — including navigating hard conversations when needed.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience in technical product environments.

Peraton's Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA-listed species.

Peraton is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to focus on compliance validation, defect remediation, and production support activities on a federal data integration program.   • Lead defect remediation for Critical and High severity application defects identified during testing, pilot consultations, and government demonstrations
  • Support post-deployment monitoring of system availability, species list accuracy, logic performance, and user-reported issues
  • Implement live consultation feedback into system updates, ensuring iterative improvements are incorporated throughout the production period
  • Contribute to the Production Deployment Report, documenting deployment outcomes and post-deployment monitoring results

  • Extensive experience supporting compliance validation activities on federal regulatory systems
  • Experience developing and executing production migration runbooks and rollback procedures
  • Experience with REST API integration and application-layer monitoring for production federal systems
  • Strong defect remediation and root cause analysis skills
  • Proficiency in Java, Python, or equivalent backend development languages

Preferred Qualifications

Prosper Health is on a mission to make life happier and healthier for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

We deliver specialized mental health services for autistic adults, covered by insurance. We've helped tens of thousands of people receive an autism diagnosis for the first time, work with neurodivergent-affirming therapists, and find belonging through community. Our outcomes meaningfully outperform traditional care for autistic adults, with substantially greater improvements in mood, anxiety, and quality of life.

Prosper is growing 3x year over year and are at mid-double-digit millions in run-rate revenue, with thousands of active clients and 400+ clinicians. We're a high-ownership, mission-driven team, building something that has never existed for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

The Opportunity

We're hiring Licensed Mental Health Therapists (LCSW, LPC, LMHC, LMFT) to provide therapy for autistic and neurodivergent adults via telehealth. You'll join a team dedicated to creating affirming, accessible mental health services for the neurodivergent community.

Our clinicians come from diverse backgrounds and career stages - whether you're passionate about neurodiversity advocacy, seeking flexibility and better work-life balance, or looking to add specialized experience to your existing practice, we offer roles to match your professional goals.

  • Focus on what matters most: Provide exceptional client care while we manage administrative tasks, insurance billing, and client acquisition
  • Enjoy scheduling flexibility: Design your work schedule to accommodate personal needs and maintain optimal work-life balance
  • Scale your practice quickly: Build your caseload with steady client referrals during your first few weeks, with most clinicians reaching their ideal caseload within 4-6 weeks
  • No-show and late cancellation reimbursement: Receive 50% reimbursement for late cancellations and no-shows
  • Grow professionally: Access regular peer consultation, specialized training, and monthly case conferences
  • Neurodiversity-affirming environment: Work alongside clinicians who share your commitment to neurodiversity-affirming approaches
  • Connect with a supportive clinical community: Join weekly drop-ins and engage in a tight-knit clinical community that prevent isolation

We offer two distinct position types to accommodate different career needs and scheduling preferences

Scheduling Availability

  • Set your own schedule, 7 days a week, between 7am and 10pm
  • No required evening, weekend or on-call hours
  • Build your schedule around your life, not the other way around

Full time (Benefits-Eligible)

  • Hours: Provide 25+ hours of weekly availability to build a caseload of 25+ clients
  • Ideal for: Those who seek steady, predictable income that grows with your client base
  • Compensation: Competitive hourly rate paid per session
  • Benefits: Comprehensive benefits package including Medical/Dental/Vision coverage, 401(k) retirement plan and PTO.

Part-Time Position

  • Hours: Provide 15+ hours of weekly availability to build a caseload of 15+ clients
  • Ideal For: Practitioners with existing commitments who want to diversify their practice or add specialized neurodiversity experience to your clinical portfolio
  • Compensation: Competitive hourly rate paid per session

Who We're Looking For

Qualifications:

  • Licensed independent mental health professional (LCSW, LPC, LMHC)
  • Strong clinical skills in evidence-based modalities such as CBT, DBT or ACT
  • Interest in working with autistic or neurodivergent adults
  • Comfort with technology and virtual care platforms (Zoom, EHR, Slack)
  • Excellent communication skills and commitment to client-centered care
  • Telehealth experience preferred but not required

You'll Thrive Here If:

  • You identify with our mission to support the neurodivergent community
  • You're seeking better work-life balance without sacrificing meaningful clinical work
  • You're transitioning from a demanding in-person setting and want more flexibility
  • You want to maintain multiple practice settings and add specialized experience
  • You're passionate about providing affirming care to traditionally underserved populations

Compensation

Our transparent model means your income grows with your client relationships. Unlike traditional salary models, our fee-for-service approach rewards you directly for the sessions you provide. The more sessions you complete, the more your practice thrives – with the security of guaranteed income during no-shows and cancellations.

Join Our Team

Ready to transform lives while advancing your career? Apply today to join Prosper Health's team of dedicated professionals making a real difference for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

Prosper Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including those who identify as neurodivergent, LGBTQ+, or BIPOC.

Competitive W2 rate paid per session. 50% reimbursement for late cancellations/no shows. Paid every 2 weeks for the sessions you provide, no waiting for payment or reimbursement. Benefit Eligible roles available that include Medical/Dental/Vision/401k/PTO

W2 Per Session Rate
$65—$70 USD

More about Prosper Health

  • Our culture is a unique mix of thoughtfulness, kindess, and high-performance. We set ambitious goals and hold ourselves accountable to achieving them.
  • We always ensure that we integrate perspectives from experts in our space, including clinicians and autistic self-advocates.
  • Our team members come from places such as Bain, McKinsey, BCG, FirstHand Health, Rula, SeatGeek, Benchling, and schools like Harvard, MIT, Stanford, Yale, Penn, Dartmouth, Northwestern, Vanderbilt, and more.
  • Here are a few of our favorite operating principles:
    • Clients first - Our job is to solve real problems for our clients. Choose what makes life better for the client, even if it’s harder for us. Never lose sight of the person on the other side.
    • Find a Way - We use ingenuity, scrappiness, and determination to bend the world to accomplish our goals. We’re resourceful and do more with less.
    • Raise the Bar - We grow deliberately, by asking how things can improve and by giving and seeking feedback. We insist on the highest standards and keep pushing them higher.
    • Be a Good Person - Be kind, be honest, and make it fun to work here. Tell the truth even when it’s uncomfortable. Treat people with respect and go out of your way to do nice things for your teammates.

jobs.excerpt: Hi, We’re Franki Going out should feel good, not expensive.
jobs.description:
Hi, We’re Franki

Going out should feel good, not expensive. Franki helps people discover great restaurants, get cash back just for going, and earn even more for sharing. We're building a smarter way to eat, drink, and explore your city, helping local restaurants thrive and making the experience more rewarding for everyone. We're a fast-moving, high-ownership team that values creativity and execution. You'll work on real problems for local businesses alongside people who care about building useful products. You bring the product judgment and the willingness to do the work. We'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Franki is looking for a Product Manager to own our B2B merchant platform end to end. You'll build the products that help hospitality businesses join Franki, manage cashback offers, verify transactions, understand their results, and manage billing. Your focus: turning a better merchant experience into stronger acquisition, retention, and revenue.

As Franki's first dedicated B2B Product Manager, you'll report to the Chief Operating Officer and work directly with Engineering, Design, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and partnerships. This is an individual-contributor role with no direct reports, significant autonomy, and ownership from discovery through delivery and measurement.

This is a strategic role for someone who enjoys being hands-on. You'll set the roadmap and write every engineering ticket, own the merchant request and bug queue, join merchant calls, and build or specify the internal tools that make operations more efficient. You'll be as comfortable resolving a merchant issue as deciding what we should build next.

What you'll do:

  • Own the B2B roadmap across Franki+, self-serve onboarding, merchant dashboards, analytics, offer management, billing, and POS integrations. Agree on priorities with the COO quarterly and review them monthly.
  • Run discovery with merchants, Sales, and Customer Success. Size problems, make explicit tradeoffs, and turn recurring requests into scalable product improvements.
  • Write product specifications, user stories, every B2B engineering ticket, and testable acceptance criteria. Own the backlog and partner with Design and Engineering on usability, technical scope, and sequencing.
  • Lead releases from acceptance testing through launch, release notes, and Sales and Customer Success enablement. Instrument every launch, measure results, and improve or retire features that miss their intended outcomes.
  • Improve conversion from sign-up to first live offer, reduce product-driven merchant churn, and grow Franki+ adoption and revenue per account. Recommend packaging and upgrade improvements; final pricing decisions remain with leadership.
  • Own all product requests routed by Sales and every B2B bug from triage to resolution. Reproduce issues, prioritize by impact, run weekly triage, and set and meet response and resolution service levels with Sales and Customer Success.
  • Join merchant calls as the product voice, including escalations. Diagnose problems, set honest expectations, validate solutions, and follow up in writing with merchants and internal teams.
  • Own the merchant experience for POS connections and transaction verification, including connection status and failure recovery. Work with Engineering and Finance on billing, payment-method management, and related product workflows.
  • Build or specify internal tools, admin experiences, and no-code or AI-assisted automations that reduce manual work and errors. Retain human review for automations touching authentication, payments, account access, or card-linked verification.
  • Partner with the COO and partnerships team on API and partner integrations, from requirements and engineering tickets to launch support, while balancing integration work against the core roadmap.
  • Define metric baselines and report monthly on acquisition, retention, gross merchandise value (GMV), recurring revenue, and operational efficiency, with clear drivers, risks, and recommended actions.

You're a good fit if you have...

  • Required: B2B product management experience serving local restaurants or hospitality merchants, such as restaurant technology, hospitality SaaS, or local-merchant platforms.
  • Startup or growth-stage product experience, or 3–5+ years or more of product management experience, with demonstrated ownership of a roadmap through shipped features and measured results.
  • Strong product craft: discovery, problem sizing, prioritization, clear specifications, engineering tickets, acceptance criteria, and release management. You're comfortable working in Jira and Confluence and reviewing Figma prototypes.
  • Experience shipping API, integration, or POS-connected products. You understand REST APIs, webhooks, connection flows, transaction matching, and failure cases such as refunds, voids, and partial payments.
  • Working knowledge of subscription billing, invoicing, payment-method management, and disputes as product experiences, plus the ability to define metrics, analyze funnels and cohorts, and use SQL and dashboards to guide decisions.
  • Direct merchant-facing experience, including difficult conversations and escalations. You understand restaurant operators' day-to-day constraints and can manage request intake, severity, and service levels using tools such as Intercom and Salesforce.
  • Clear written communication and the ability to align Engineering, Design, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance. You explain decisions, raise risks early, and follow through without a coordination layer.
  • A high degree of ownership and comfort balancing long-term priorities with a live merchant queue. You're resourceful with internal tools and automation and know when a workflow needs human review.
  • A bachelor's degree in business, computer science, engineering, economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Bonus points if you have...

  • Experience delivering POS integrations with systems such as Square, Toast, or Clover.
  • Experience with payments integrations or card-linked offers.
  • Experience building loyalty or rewards products.
  • Experience working on multi-sided marketplaces.
  • Experience supporting sales-led and self-serve customer journeys within the same product.
  • Hands-on SQL experience independently investigating funnel, retention, and revenue questions.

Why Join Franki?

  • Be Franki's first dedicated B2B Product Manager, with ownership of an entire merchant platform rather than a narrow feature area.
  • See the impact of your work in the businesses you serve and in merchant acquisition, retention, and revenue.
  • Work directly with the COO and cross-functional teams, with the autonomy to shape priorities and the responsibility to deliver.
  • Build both customer-facing products and the internal tools that help Franki scale, in a team that values ownership, inclusion, and mutual respect.

Perks & Benefits

  • Remote work: Our team works remotely across the US but primarily PST time zone; we travel together several times a year for company kick-offs and mid-year meetings.
  • PTO: 15 days per year, which includes a Franki holiday shutdown between December 25 - 31.
  • Holidays: We recognize 11 public holidays per year.
  • Medical, Dental & Vision: We cover 100% of Medical, Vision, and Dental insurance costs for employees.
  • 401(k)
  • Equipment: Computer & technology equipment applicable to your role.

jobs.excerpt: Type: Full-Time Location: Orange County, CA preferred, open to Remote or Hybrid Reports to: VP of Finance ABOUT EJAMeJam is a consumer products company that has built, scaled, and exited multiple brands.
jobs.description:
Type: Full-Time

Location: Orange County, CA preferred, open to Remote or Hybrid

Reports to: VP of Finance

ABOUT EJAM

eJam is a consumer products company that has built, scaled, and exited multiple brands. Our portfolio includes category leaders ranked at the top of Amazon, carried in major retailers nationwide, and sold across DTC, marketplaces, and every channel in between.

We're not a startup hoping something works. We're a team that has done it repeatedly: taken products from zero to eight figures, landed them on retail shelves nationwide, and built real brands that consumers love. We operate like a holding company with the speed of a startup: small teams with real ownership and accountability.

This is the place where you'll see the entire machine, sourcing, product development, packaging, manufacturing, compliance, marketing, marketplace strategy, retail, all under one roof. If you want to be a part of building and shipping consumer products at scale, there is no better place than this.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a combined FP&A and treasury role. You will own the reporting and models leadership uses to run the business, and you will own the cash side of the house, the daily position, the short term forecast and the reporting that supports our credit facilities. It is a broad seat with real visibility, reporting directly to the VP of Finance and working alongside the Accounting Supervisor and the brand leads. If you want to see how the money is made and how it moves, in one role, this is that job.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Financial planning and analysis

  • Prepare and refresh recurring management reporting, including monthly P&L packages, KPI dashboards and brand level performance summaries.
  • Build and maintain financial models in Excel covering revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, operating expense and headcount.
  • Perform budget versus actual and period over period variance analysis, and write clear commentary explaining what actually drove the result.
  • Support the annual budget and the rolling forecast, gathering and challenging inputs from brand and functional owners.
  • Analyze product, channel and brand profitability, combining COGS and inventory data from Cin7 with financials from QuickBooks Online.
  • Track marketing efficiency alongside the brand teams, connecting spend to contribution margin rather than revenue alone.
  • Analyze vendor and operating spend trends in Ramp, and flag where cost is running ahead of plan early enough to act.
  • Partner with accounting so reporting ties to the closed books, and help investigate results that do not look right.
  • Build ad hoc analysis for the VP of Finance and brand leadership, turning messy data into a clear, defensible recommendation.

Treasury and cash management

  • Prepare the daily cash on hand and available credit report across all bank accounts, entities and brands.
  • Own the rolling thirteen week cash forecast, updating receipts, disbursements and financing activity as new information arrives.
  • Track expected collections using A/R data from SAI, and expected disbursements using A/P and card data from Ramp.
  • Prepare and route funding transfers between entities and accounts, and monitor balances against target minimums.
  • Reconcile bank activity daily, investigate unidentified deposits, returns and exceptions, and escalate quickly.
  • Support borrowing base reporting, covenant tracking and lender reporting packages under the group's credit facilities.
  • Monitor merchant processor and marketplace settlements, and tie payouts back to the general ledger in QuickBooks Online.
  • Maintain bank administration records, including account documentation, user access and payment approval matrices.
  • Coordinate with payroll so wage, contractor and benefit obligations are funded on time through Deel.

Across both

  • Use Claude to accelerate data cleanup, reconciliation, model documentation and first-draft analysis, then verify the output before it goes out.
  • Replace manual steps with repeatable templates, so recurring reporting gets faster and less fragile each cycle.
  • Document what you build, so the report survives a vacation and does not live only in your head.

SYSTEMS YOU WILL WORK IN

eJam's systems of record are QuickBooks Online (financials), Ramp (accounts payable and corporate cards), SAI (accounts receivable), Deel (PEO and HRIS) and Cin7 (inventory and product COGS), alongside our bank and lender portals. Microsoft Excel is the everyday modeling and reporting tool, and AI, primarily Claude, is part of how this team works rather than an optional extra.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • First thirty days, you can produce the daily cash and credit report and the monthly management reporting package independently, and you know where each number comes from.
  • First ninety days, you own the rolling thirteen week cash forecast, and your variance commentary is what leadership reads first.
  • First six months, at least two recurring reports run materially faster than they did before you arrived, and you are surfacing issues to the VP of Finance before he has to ask about them.

COMPENSATION

The salary range for this role is $80,000 to $100,000 per year. Placement within the range depends on experience, skill set and location. eJam is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law.

Requirements

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Three to seven years of experience in FP&A, financial analysis, treasury, or a comparable analytical finance role.
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics or a related field.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data cleanup and models another person can follow.
  • Solid command of the three financial statements and how operating and cash decisions flow through them.
  • Experience building or maintaining a cash forecast, or a genuine appetite to own one.
  • Experience with QuickBooks Online or a comparable accounting system.
  • Comfort using AI tools, primarily Claude, as a working partner, with the judgment to check the output before relying on it.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain a number to someone who does not work in finance.
  • High accuracy, strong ownership, and discretion with confidential financial information.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Direct-to-consumer ecommerce, consumer packaged goods or retail experience.

We partner closely with product engineering, platform, risk, compliance, and application teams to design, automate, and operationalize scalable security controls, building reusable tooling and guardrails that make secure application deployments the default across AWS environments. Rather than operating as a reactive review function, we implement preventive and detective controls that reduce systemic risk while enabling teams to move quickly. Our work spans multi-account cloud architecture, identity and access management, network segmentation, automation, detection engineering, and compliance alignment. We focus on scalable, repeatable solutions that strengthen security posture across the enterprise.

About the Opportunity

As a Senior Security Engineer, you will play a critical role in strengthening the cloud security foundation that supports College Board’s enterprise platforms and services. This position focuses on building and scaling automated, preventive security controls that reduce systemic risk while enabling engineering teams to deliver quickly and confidently. You will work across cloud environments to expand automated guardrails, improve external exposure management, and reduce high-risk misconfigurations through enforceable, enterprise-wide controls. This role emphasizes secure-by-default architecture, infrastructure automation, and measurable risk reduction, ensuring security controls are consistently applied as the organization scales. In partnership with Cloud Engineering, Product Security, and Cyber Operations, you will enhance vulnerability management workflows, increase automation across intake and response processes, and strengthen detection and triage capabilities. You will help drive improved remediation velocity, clearer security posture visibility, and more efficient security operations through engineering-led solutions.

You will also contribute to the resilience and reliability of critical security platforms, ensuring continuity of monitoring and posture management capabilities while supporting modernization efforts. Success in this role means delivering durable, scalable security outcomes: stronger preventive coverage, reduced exposure windows, improved operational efficiency, and measurable improvements in enterprise security posture.

In this role, you will:

Strengthen Cloud Guardrails and Preventive Controls (40%)

  • Design, implement, and operationalize automated preventive and detective guardrails across enterprise cloud environments.

  • Build and enforce enterprise-wide controls that prevent or automatically remediate high-risk misconfigurations.

  • Improve protection coverage for internet-facing systems by validating asset inventories and expanding enforcement mechanisms.

  • Continuously evaluate control effectiveness through telemetry, compliance validation, and risk trend analysis.

  • Partner with cloud platform teams to embed secure-by-default infrastructure patterns into reusable modules and deployment workflows.

Advance Vulnerability Management and Security Automation (35%)

  • Enhance vulnerability management processes to improve prioritization, remediation velocity, and cross-team accountability.

  • Increase automation across vulnerability intake, enrichment, ticketing, and response workflows to reduce manual triage burden.

  • Design and deliver engineering solutions that improve detection quality and response speed in collaboration with Cyber Operations.

  • Translate security requirements into scalable technical implementations using infrastructure-as-code and automation frameworks.

  • Measure and report on workflow efficiency and risk reduction outcomes using operational metrics.

Improve Security Posture Visibility and Platform Resilience (25%)

  • Implement standardized, automated security checks across prioritized security domains to strengthen baseline posture.

  • Enable measurable security maturity tracking through telemetry-backed reporting and posture metrics.

  • Support continuity of cloud security monitoring and posture management during tooling transitions or modernization efforts.

  • Strengthen reliability, scalability, and resilience of critical security platforms to reduce operational risk.

  • Contribute to documentation, engineering standards, and continuous improvement practices that promote long-term maintainability.

About you, you have:

  • 5+ years of experience in security engineering, cloud security, or security architecture, with demonstrated ownership of initiatives that scale across multiple teams and environments.

  • Designed and secured cloud-native architectures, including multi-account AWS environments, microservices, serverless workloads, and API-driven systems.

  • Have deep experience with AWS security fundamentals, including IAM strategy (least privilege, cross-account access, federation), KMS, Secrets Manager, S3, logging/monitoring, and preventive guardrails using Organizations and SCPs.

  • Implemented security controls using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK) and support policy-as-code approaches to enforce standards at scale.

  • Understand secure system design across multi-tier architectures and can perform threat modeling to identify systemic risks before they reach production.

  • Experienced in securing Linux-based systems and cloud infrastructure, with practical expertise in hardening, logging, identity design, and network segmentation.

  • Translate regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., FERPA, PCI DSS, SOC 2, NIST) into practical technical controls and automated evidence collection.

  • Build automation to reduce manual security work, leveraging scripting and cloud APIs to create repeatable, measurable security improvements.

  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving environments where standards and tooling evolve, and you proactively define guardrails rather than waiting for direction.

  • Influence engineering and product stakeholders by balancing delivery velocity with risk reduction, presenting trade-offs clearly and driving alignment on secure design decisions.

  • Communicate complex security concepts in practical terms, mentor engineers, and contribute to hiring and technical evaluation processes.

  • Relevant certifications (e.g., AWS Security Specialty, CISSP, CCSP) are a plus, but hands-on engineering experience and demonstrable impact matter most.

  • Ability to travel 3–5 times per year to College Board offices.

  • Authorization to work in the United States.

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work

  • Authorization to work in the United States for any employer

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and a comfort learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.

  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal

  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.

  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.

  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success.

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days. Please keep in mind that College Board offices will be closed November 27th – November 28th and December 25th – January 2nd so it is better to apply sooner than later.

  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than just a paycheck—we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation, grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $153,000 - $166,000

  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.

  • We aim to make our best offer upfront—rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.

  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

Project Manager (eCOA Manager) remote in Argentina

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

Job Summary:

Provides customer-focused management of Clinical Surveillance & Training (CST) scoped services to support scientific integrity and data quality in clinical trials.

Duties also include liaising with customers, vendors and/or investigative sites to manage projects start-up to final deliverables to the customer. Upon displaying proficiency, a CST Project Manager II may be awarded the opportunity to function at the CST Sr. Project Manager level.

Core Responsibilities:

• Working under the limited guidance and mentorship of the CST Director BU Ops, Management (Line Manager) or designee:

  • Function as a representative of the Clinical Surveillance & Training (CST) team on small to large-sized studies or programs, interact with other functional groups, vendors, license holders, Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and Sponsors. May serve as a Project Lead in CST stand-alone projects and serves as a Functional Lead in full scope or multiple protocol projects.
  • Manage CST deliverables pertaining to scoped services vendors (i.e., Rater Training vendors), scale license holders and/or KOLs.
    • Manage all aspects of license procurement, scale translation requirements, and paper scale worksheet development.
    • Manage creation of all CST service-related documentation and templates. This may include managing development and testing of the CST Study Training and Engagement Portal (STEP) to meet study-specific Rater Training needs.
    • Manage all aspects of CST services to ensure quality and timely delivery and implementation.
  • Develop and maintain the study-specific CST plan in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions (WIs).
  • Contribute to relevant functional project plans to ensure alignment with the CST plan.
  • Provide regular and timely status updates to internal and Sponsor project teams regarding CST scoped services, including risks to delivery such as timeline delays and serve as a central point of contact for CST-related project issues and solicit support from LM or CST SMEs, as required.
  • Create and maintain CST metric reports for scoped services, for delivery to client.
  • Attend Trusted Process, internal and Sponsor meetings as a lead CST representative to discuss CST strategy, address CST-related agenda topics, and provide status reports.
  • Ensure CST project documentation is maintained on an ongoing basis and ensure required documentation is filed completely and accurately in the Trial Master File (TMF).
  • Identify risks and develop mitigation plan as required.
  • Participate in Sponsor, internal or agency audits and inspections, as required.
  • Responsible for management of CST scope, including identification of CST out of scope activities and overburn, including revenue recognition (if delegated this task by study lead or if serving as a Project lead in stand-alone study), invoice management (tracking and confirmation of payment), and/or KOL contract and management, etc. May participate in internal financial review meetings to review CST overburn or financial risk, as needed.
  • Plan, manage, and request CST resources (e.g., CST Project Specialist, CST Clinical Scientist, CST Assessment Scientist, etc) and provide CST resource updates for assigned projects.
  • Train and mentor internal team members.

Qualification:

• Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) level of qualification in Life Sciences, Medicine, Pharmacy, Nursing or related field equivalent preferred.

• Prior experience in study coordination, contract research organization (CRO), pharmaceutical, biotechnology or rater training vendor company preferred.

• Excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal skills, both written and spoken, with an ability to inform, influence, convince and persuade.

• Good organizational, planning, customer service, and time management skills with the ability to multitask under tight deadlines while providing attention to detail. Ability to manage time and work independently.

• High level of competency in English language.

• Proficiency with MS Office Applications.

• Strong knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP)/ International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements.

• Ability to travel as necessary (up to 25%).

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Additional Information

jobs.description:
Position Type: Full-Time
Location: Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive and results-driven Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day client operations and implementation activities. This role is responsible for turning business decisions and recommendations into clear action plans, coordinating stakeholders, maintaining operational documentation and ensuring projects and client engagements move forward on schedule. The ideal candidate is an independent operator who can manage multiple priorities, communicate confidently with U.S.-based clients, identify blockers, and drive work to completion without requiring constant supervision.

Key Responsibilities:

Operations & Implementation Management

  • Own the day-to-day execution of implementation plans across multiple client engagements.
  • Translate business decisions and recommendations into clear tasks, owners, deadlines and deliverables.
  • Track project milestones and ensure commitments are completed on time.
  • Coordinate with clients, internal teams and stakeholders to keep initiatives moving.
  • Identify operational gaps and recommend practical solutions.

Project Tracking & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate project plans, implementation trackers, and client documentation.
  • Keep project status, deadlines and action items up to date.
  • Ensure important information and commitments are properly documented.
  • Maintain clear visibility into project progress and outstanding items.

Client Communication & Coordination

  • Communicate directly and professionally with client owners, managers, and team members.
  • Prepare agendas, materials and status updates for client meetings.
  • Capture decisions, commitments and action items during meetings.
  • Follow up with stakeholders until assigned tasks are completed.
  • Build strong professional relationships while maintaining accountability.

Operational Documentation

  • Create and maintain SOPs, process documentation, and process maps.
  • Develop KPI scorecards, accountability tools, and operational trackers.
  • Organize information in a clear and structured format.
  • Help client teams establish more consistent and efficient workflows.

Blocker Management & Problem Solving

  • Proactively identify delays, risks, and operational blockers.
  • Resolve issues independently whenever possible.
  • Escalate complex issues with the appropriate context and recommended solutions.
  • Ensure potential problems are communicated early rather than after they impact delivery.

Required Experience & Skills:

Must-Have

  • 3+ years of experience in Operations, Project Management, Implementation, Client Success, Business Operations, or a related field.
  • Proven experience owning projects or initiatives through completion.
  • Experience supporting U.S based clients or companies.
  • Excellent written and spoken professional English.
  • Strong project and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong follow-up and stakeholder management skills.
  • Confidence communicating with senior stakeholders and holding people accountable professionally.
  • Experience working with spreadsheets, project management tools, CRM systems, or documentation platforms.
  • Ability to learn and adapt to new software and workflows quickly.
  • Strong problem-solving, judgment, and decision-making skills.

What Makes You a Strong Fit:

  • You take ownership of outcomes, not just assigned tasks.
  • You can understand a goal, determine what needs to happen, and organize the work without step-by-step direction.
  • You proactively communicate when something is delayed, unclear, or at risk.
  • You are comfortable following up with senior stakeholders and keeping projects moving.
  • You maintain clean documentation, accurate trackers, and reliable follow-through.
  • You can adapt your communication style when working with founders, clients, managers, and frontline employees.
  • You are comfortable working in an ambiguous environment and finding practical solutions.
  • You take pride in operational excellence and consistently look for ways to improve processes.

Typical Day:

Your day will begin by reviewing active client projects and implementation trackers to identify priorities, upcoming milestones, and potential blockers. You may prepare for client meetings, provide status updates, coordinate with stakeholders, and follow up on outstanding action items.

Throughout the day, you may also create an SOP, develop a KPI scorecard, update project documentation, or help resolve an operational issue for a client. You will regularly communicate with U.S.-based clients and internal stakeholders to ensure commitments stay on track.

You will close the day by updating project trackers, documenting progress, identifying any risks or blockers, and ensuring priorities are clearly defined for the next day.

  1. Initial Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Offer Stage

This role goes beyond campaign execution — you will be responsible for defining UA strategy, driving profitable growth, and shaping the product experience through close collaboration with Product, Data, and Engineering teams.

You will lead web and web-to-app acquisition across key channels, ensuring we not only scale efficiently but also improve the quality of users through better funnels, onboarding, and monetization strategies. This role requires someone who can connect performance marketing with product thinking — identifying opportunities, advocating for changes, and driving cross-functional initiatives that unlock new growth.

If you have experience in subscription-based products and thrive at the intersection of marketing, data, and product, this role is for you.

Expectations | Duties

    • Own UA performance end-to-end for assigned products, including strategy, execution, and scaling across web and web-to-app funnels
    • Drive profitable growth, optimizing toward long-term metrics (LTV, D30/D120 ROAS), not just short-term CPA

    • Design and execute testing strategies across channels, creatives, funnels, and pricing models
    • Scale and optimize key channels (Meta, Google, and emerging platforms), while continuously exploring and launching new acquisition channels
    • Lead creative strategy in collaboration with in-house teams, ensuring high testing velocity and strong performance insights
    • Improve tracking, attribution, and data quality, working with Data and Engineering on initiatives such as CAPI, event mapping, and signal optimization
    • Own and deliver cross-functional projects, such as new market launches, funnel iterations, or new channel onboarding
    • Continuously identify inefficiencies and opportunities, and turn them into clear, actionable growth initiatives

Requirements


Qualifications

    • 5+ years in user acquisition / growth, managing substantial budgets in subscription-based apps, consumer products, or high-scale e-commerce
    • Proven experience owning performance for a product or business line, not just executing campaigns
    • Strong understanding of web and web-to-app funnels, including conversion optimization, paywalls, and subscription models
    • Experience working cross-functionally with Product and Engineering, influencing roadmap decisions with data and insights
    • Deep expertise across Meta, Google (Search, Display, YouTube), and at least one additional paid channel (TikTok, Pinterest, Snap, etc.)

    • Strong ownership mentality, with a proactive approach to identifying and solving problems

What We’re Really Looking For

  • Someone who can connect UA performance with product decisions, and confidently push for new directions
  • A growth owner, not just a channel manager

Benefits

About Us

An award-winning health, wellness, & coaching company that creates apps which fall the top ten internationally. Our science-based approach sits squarely in the tech-for-good lane, helping people live their best lives. Everyone who has joined this company is committed to using evidence-based research to find the absolute best ways to change lives for the better.

Our History

Three co-founders created the Fabulous app: Sami, Amine, and Taylor. Growing up in Tunisia, Sami and Amine were only 16 when they met. With their early iteration, they reached out to Taylor, an award-winning designer in Malaysia. Their vision was welcomed into an incubation lab for startups at Duke University led by world-renowned Behavioral Economics Professor Dan Ariely. Our Chief Storyteller Jaz co-founded the Introductory Psychology program at Stanford University.

Our Approach

We use a behavioral economics lens to help individuals find that 'on switch' inside them to achieve their fullest potential. What has emerged is a system that transforms tiny habits into profound long-term changes. A world in which people with ADHD thrive. A method for gratitude to reach through difficulty. A sanctuary to seek out your true purpose. A fountain of knowledge. A space for rest and self compassion.

Our Mission

Help every individual discover the wonderful person inside themselves by creating: beautiful, evidence-based, life-changing products.

Our Environment

The first thing that sets us apart is that we’re not a place at all. While we’re a remote company, it’s not unusual to feel you know your teammates better than those you’ve shared an office with in the past. Ours is a professionally nourishing environment that is flexible and fully remote. Team members enjoy in house challenges and Slack event and work across a variety of tools. Meetings are kept to a minimum and deep work is encouraged.

Our Awards

  • Apple Best Apps of 2018
  • Editor’s app choice in more than 30 countries
  • Winner of Google’s Material Design Award
  • Best App Finalist in Google Play Awards
  • Consistently ranking in the top ten Health & Fitness apps across platforms
  • Backed by Facebook Startup Lab and Microsoft Venture

Our Norms

Ownership: Be the CEO of your tasks. No one is watching over your shoulder. Be the proof.

Open Communication: Constructive ideas are always flying across time zones.

Deep Work: Disconnect. Find your flow. Become industrious. It’s about the work here.

Always Offer Context: Sharing rationale works wonders in asynchronous conversations.

Impeccable Agreement: Promise, then follow through. Everyone relies on everyone.

Egos are checked at the door. Those who join our workforce place themselves in service of our members.

Our Values

#collaboration #craftsmanship #feedback #respect #responsibility #simplicity #speed

Our Future

To this day, over 30 million people have started their journey to better themselves with our apps. We are creating a generation of change-makers, with the same drive to help others, each in their own way.

Our Invitation

At Fabulous, every team member is a sculptor in their own right. Together, we help millions of users step out of their block of stone and step into the fullest version of their life through behavioral science. Tell us what drives you; if you were to pick up your tools, what would you contribution look like?

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: Who are Tyk, and what do we do?  The Tyk AI and API Management platform is helping to drive the connected world and power new products and services.
jobs.description:
Who are Tyk, and what do we do?
The Tyk AI and API Management platform is helping to drive the connected world and power new products and services. We’re changing the way that organisations connect any number of their systems and services. Whether internal, external, public or highly encrypted systems, Tyk helps businesses drive value across the retail, finance, telecoms, healthcare, or media industries (to name just a few!)

If you’ve banked online, used an app to check the news, or perhaps even driven a connected car, API’s, and by extension, Tyk, make that possible. Founded in 2015 with offices in London - UK, London - Ontario, Atlanta and Singapore, we have many thousands of users of our B2B platform across the globe. Brands using Tyk range from Lotte, Bell, T Mobile, to RBS, Capital One and Vinci. We have a varied user base hailing from every continent – even Antarctica.

Our Mission

Tyk is on a mission to connect every system in the world. We’ve started by building an API Management platform.

Total flexibility, default remote, radical responsibility

We offer unlimited paid holidays and remote working from anywhere in the world, for everyone, Why? Tyk was founded on the principle of offering flexibility and autonomy to our employees, we believe this allows our employees to achieve their best results. It also means we can build the best possible team, location and working hours are no barrier.

If this sounds like an environment that you believe could work for you then read on to find out more.

Why this role, why now

Tyk spent a decade becoming essential infrastructure for some of the world's biggest companies. We're now doing the same thing for the AI era — and we want someone to help us move marketing through that shift. It's a rare moment: a profitable, established company moving fast into new territory, with a small enough team that you'll shape the direction, not just execute it.

Requirements

Here’s what you’ll be getting up to:

This is a doing role. You’ll own initiatives end-to-end - planning them and then executing them yourself, with AI as a force multiplier.

  • Own campaigns and launches end-to-end. Write the brief, build the assets and copy, ship the campaign or launch, and report on how it did - you don’t hand any part of that off to someone else or an agency.
  • Run events from first invite to final follow-up. Own the details of owned, sponsored and community events - logistics, outreach, on-the-day readiness, and the follow-up sequence that turns attendees into pipeline.
  • Use AI as a force multiplier, not a novelty. Build tools like Claude or ChatGPT into your day-to-day - research, first drafts, campaign builds, reporting - so you can output like a bigger team, ship like an engineer, and bring the rest of the marketing team along with you.
  • Turn a priority into a plan with your name on it. Take “we should do X” and turn it into a scoped plan - timeline, owner, success metric - then execute it yourself rather than delegating the “how.”
  • Keep GTM moving across Marketing, Sales and Product. Chase the people, approvals and information you need across teams so initiatives don’t stall, and make sure what you ship lands with real commercial impact, not just activity.
  • Report on what worked. Track the metrics that actually show impact for each initiative (pipeline influenced, cost, conversion, attendance - whatever fits), share the results even when they’re not flattering, and use them to decide what to do next.

Here’s what we’re looking for:

  • 2–3 years’ experience as a marketing manager, growth marketer or similar - background matters less than what you’ve built and how you think. B2B SaaS experience is a plus, not a requirement; agency background is welcome, especially if you’ve built things from scratch for multiple clients.
  • A builder, not just a contributor. You’ve made something from scratch - a campaign, a launch, a side project, a small business - and you can point to it and say “I built that.”
  • A strategic executor. You can zoom out to see the bigger picture, then zoom back in and do the work yourself, rather than handing the “how” to someone else.
  • Commercially minded. You think in pipeline and revenue, not just opens and impressions, and you can talk through a deal or a campaign you helped move forward.
  • A self-starter. You manage competing priorities and deadlines without being managed, and you raise problems before they become fire drills.
  • Genuinely into AI. You already use tools like Claude or ChatGPT in your own work, and you have real opinions about where AI is taking marketing - not just enthusiasm for the idea of it.
  • Hungry for ownership. You’re at the point in your career where you want real responsibility, and you’re looking for a team small enough that you get it fast.
  • Comfortable with - or quick to pick up - Monday.com and HubSpot. You don’t need hand-holding on the basics of project management or marketing ops tools.

Is this right for you?

This role is for you if…

  • You love building and shipping things yourself, and want a lot of ownership
  • You’re excited by the idea of helping shape an AI-first marketing team from the front
  • You thrive in a small, senior team where everyone does the work

It’s probably not for you if…

  • You’re mainly looking to manage a team or oversee others’ work
  • You prefer a big, structured organisation with lots of specialists to delegate to
  • You want to focus on strategy and planning rather than execution

Benefits

Here’s why you should join us:

  • Everyone has unlimited paid holidays.
  • We have total flexibility in hours, as we believe creativity flows better when our people are given freedom to decide when they are most productive. Everyone is unique after all.
  • Employee share scheme
  • Generous maternity and paternity leave
  • Volunteering Days
  • Company retreats
  • Employee Wellbeing platform

We all share the same vision - we value authenticity, respect, responsibility, independence, honesty, diversity and inclusion and most importantly treating others how you wish to be treated. We look for like-minded people who bring their personalities to work everyday, strive to achieve their personal goals and who are willing to challenge the way we do things, why? - to make what we do even better!

Our values tell the story of Tyk - here’s how:

  • It’s ok to screw up!

We’ve found that it’s often the ‘stupid’ or unexpected ideas that turn out to be the successful ones - so try it, at least we can say we have!

  • The only stupid idea, is the untested one!

It’s in our DNA - starting a business with founders 12 hours apart, giving our gateway away for free - sure, we did that, and we’d do it again!

  • Trust starts with you - make it count!

Trust is a two-way street - instil it from day one!

  • Assume best intent!

We have each other’s back - we’re all on the same team. Think before you speak or act.

  • Make things better!

Always try to leave things better than when you found them - change is constant, inevitable and embraced! Be that change we want to see.

What’s it like to work here?! check it out:

Compensation ranges are subject to change at the Company's discretion and as permitted by applicable law.

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, energy efficiency and specialized field services. Calix is a cloud and software platform company focused on enabling broadband service providers of all sizes to simplify operations, excite subscribers, and grow value.
