We are committed to innovation, customer success, and creating a culture where every team member can thrive.

Our team is growing, and we're looking for a Director, Advocacy Operations & Enterprise Incident Management to lead a newly unified advocacy organization with a single mandate: making our customers successful, both directly and through the partners who serve them.

The Director of Advocacy Operations & Enterprise Incident Management leads the organization responsible for protecting customer experience and business operations during periods of operational risk or disruption. This leader oversees the teams responsible for enterprise incident command, executive escalations, critical account recovery, customer action plans, and operational governance. The remit spans all classes of incident: product and platform outages, cyber security events, physical site and facilities emergencies, business continuity disruptions, and third-party or supply-chain failures.

The role establishes the operating model, develops leadership talent, and drives cross-functional accountability across Success, Support, Product, Engineering, Security, IT, Services, Legal, Facilities, Corporate Communications, and Sales to ensure customer and business issues are resolved quickly and systemic problems are eliminated.

The Director shall develop a team of managers, program leaders, and operational specialists responsible for creating a high-performance culture focused on customer advocacy, operational rigor, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Incident Management

  • Own enterprise incident management processes and governance and lead the team of Incident Managers

  • Serve as the enterprise incident command function for all classes of incident, regardless of the function in which the incident originates.

  • Quarterback the incident bridge: activate the response, convene the right responders at the right level of seniority, assign incident roles including commander, scribe, communications lead, and resolver owner, and drive the bridge to decisions, actions, and closure.

  • Maintain the activation model, on-call rosters, and escalation trees that ensure the correct individuals join the bridge within defined response times.

  • Establish a unified severity taxonomy, response frameworks, communication standards, and executive reporting that apply consistently across incident types, so that a given severity level means the same thing whether the event is an outage, a security breach, or a site evacuation.

  • Drive customer-facing coordination during critical service events.

  • Coordinate incident communications with Corporate Communications, Legal, and Support across internal, customer, and, where required, regulatory audiences.

  • Establish severity definitions, response frameworks, communication standards, and executive reporting.

  • Drive post-incident reviews and corrective action plans.

Executive Escalations

  • Manage executive-level customer escalations from initiation through resolution.

  • Act as the single operational owner coordinating cross-functional response teams.

  • Ensure executives have clear visibility into customer impact, recovery actions, and commitments.

Operational Excellence

  • Develop standardized playbooks, workflows, and operating rhythms.

  • Implement reporting to identify systemic causes of escalations and incidents.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce recurring issues.

Business Continuity and Crisis Readiness

  • Own the enterprise incident response playbooks for each incident class, developed jointly with the accountable functional owner.

  • Run tabletop exercises and simulations across incident classes on a defined annual cycle, and convert the findings into playbook and readiness improvements.

  • Maintain the readiness of the command structure, including rosters, contact trees, bridge infrastructure, and incident tooling.

  • Interface with the crisis management team and executive staff during high-severity events.

Operational Excellence

  • Develop standardized playbooks, workflows, and operating rhythms.

  • Implement reporting to identify systemic causes of escalations and incidents.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce recurring issues.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Customer Success, Support, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Renewal teams.

  • Influence prioritization of systemic customer-impacting issues.

  • Escalate organizational barriers preventingtimely customer resolution.

Measures of Success

  • Reduction in repeat incidents.

  • Reduction in executive escalations.

  • Time to resolution for critical incidents.

  • Time to executive response.

  • Time to bridge activation, and time to full assembly of the required responders at the required seniority.

  • Incident command coverage: the percentage of qualifying incidents run under the formal command model.

  • Communications timeliness against severity-defined service levels, across internal, customer, and regulatory audiences.

  • Exercise and tabletop completion rate across incident classes.

  • Percentage of critical accounts successfully recovered.

  • Customer satisfaction following escalation resolution.

  • Corrective action completion rate.

  • Reduction in escalations attributable to preventable operational issues.

Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in Customer Success, Support, Customer Operations, Incident Management, Escalations, or related customer-facing functions.

  • 5+ years leading managers and building high-performing teams in a SaaS, technology, telecommunications, or subscription business environment.

  • Proven success leading executive escalations, major incidents, customer recovery programs, and cross-functional operational teams.

  • Experience building scalable operating models, governance frameworks, KPIs, and executive reporting.

  • Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, develop, and retain leaders while building succession plans and leadership bench strength.

  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence Product, Engineering, Sales, Success, and Support leaders.

  • Ability to balance customer advocacy, employee development, and business outcomes in high-pressure environments.

  • Experience with Salesforce, customer success platforms, service management tools, and operational analytics preferred.

  • Track record of improving organizational performance, employee engagement, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence.

About Solen Software Group

Solen Software Group is an investment and operating company that acquires and operates proven software businesses with significant growth potential across a variety of vertical markets, enabling each to become a market leader in its niche. Solen's portfolio spans Human Resource Technology, Fleet Telematics, Asset Management, E-Health, Document Management, and other innovative software solutions. We are at the beginning of a decades-long journey, and every decision we make reflects that long time horizon.

About the Role

We are looking for a Payroll Transformation Specialist to support payroll operations, integrations, and process improvement across Solen and its portfolio companies. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving payroll challenges, working with data, and building reliable processes. You do not need to be an expert in every country. What matters is that you are curious, organized, and happy to figure out the answers.

Key Responsibilities

Payroll Operations and Integration

  • Support payroll integration for newly acquired companies.
  • Coordinate payroll implementations, provider transitions, testing, and go-live activities.
  • Collect, validate, and reconcile employee and payroll data.
  • Review payroll inputs and outputs for accuracy and completeness.

Compliance and Controls

  • Identify and escalate compliance or employee-impacting risks promptly.

Systems and Process Improvement

  • Document payroll processes and develop standard procedures, templates, and controls.
  • Support payroll system configuration, testing, data cleanup, and reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify and automate manual work.
  • Track implementation milestones, deadlines, risks, and outstanding decisions.
  • Help standardize payroll practices while accounting for local requirements.

Key Requirements:

  • 2-5 years of experience in payroll administration, implementation, HR operations, accounting support, or a related area.

  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.
  • Experience supporting acquisitions, payroll conversions, or a global workforce.
  • Excellent organization, analytical ability, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to investigate discrepancies and clearly communicate findings.
  • Comfort working across multiple companies, countries, currencies, and time zones.
  • Sound judgment when handling confidential payroll information.
  • A practical, responsive, and service-minded approach.

Helpful, but Not Required

  • Exposure to payroll in Brazil, Portugal, Canada, the UK, or the United States.
  • Experience with Deel, Rippling, Multiplier, Paylocity, Paychex, TriNet, or similar platforms.
  • Payroll certification or relevant coursework.

Solen-isms (How We Operate)

  • Ownership Mindset: We own the mission. We don't wait to be told. We lead, fix, and build as if it were ours. When problems arise, we run toward them, not away.
  • Benchmark to Best: We seek out excellence. We measure ourselves against the best and adapt quickly, always looking for the edge that moves us forward.
  • Openly Self-Critical: Leaders go first: they surface their misses early, ask for direct feedback, and turn “game film” into better decisions and better systems.
  • Disagree & Commit: Leaders disagree openly and constructively, regardless of title or tenure, because truth is how we avoid bureaucracy and benchmark to best.
  • Figureitoutiveness: Embracing challenges, fostering growth, and taking initiative, leaders thrive on hard work and high failure tolerance.
  • Mutual Elevation: Committed to growth, elevating teams, developing future leaders, and removing barriers to mastery and joy.
  • Learn-it-alls: Learn-it-alls, not know-it-alls, embracing failure as part of growth and progress.
  • Pioneering: Pioneering driven by opportunity, using first principles thinking and unbound by tradition or rules.
  • Will to Win: Leaders relentlessly pursue potential, reject mediocrity, and get what they tolerate.
  • Dialectical: We learn through conversation. We ask, listen, question, and evolve — valuing disagreement as a tool for alignment and deeper understanding.
  • Frugality: Achieving more with less, focusing on quality, long-term value, and company-wide responsibility.
  • Candor: We communicate with integrity, transparency, and respect in all conversations.
  • Kaizen: Kaizen is continuous improvement as a way of life. Leaders make hundreds of small upgrades that compound, turning lessons into standards and standards into durable systems.

Recruitment Disclaimer
Solen Software Group will never request payment, banking information, or other sensitive personal or financial details during any stage of the recruitment process. All official communication will come from a verified @solensoftwaregroup.com email address. Any outreach outside these standards should be disregarded and reported through our official channels.

The Subrogation Recovery Specialist is responsible for analyzing and recovering dollars related to an accident, injury, or illness in which another party is responsible. The Subrogation Recovery Specialist must work with attorneys, other health carriers, adjustors and more to both accelerate and maximize settlement amounts which will lead to savings for our clients. This position requires a combination of both oral and written communication skills combined with the ability to proficiently review healthcare claims and case documentation to deliver value and maintain a high standard of quality.

  • Conduct all case document review and updates as needed.
  • Confirm and validate third party liability and, probate and beneficiary asset research.
  • Interact professionally (i.e., on incoming and outgoing calls and correspondence) with attorneys, insurance adjusters, medical providers, court staff, recipients and family members and client.
  • Prepare required correspondence, liens, claims and other related documents to progress the case to recovery.
  • Negotiate and compromise claim/lien settlement amounts per contract guidelines.
  • Process all claim/lien disputes and review claims with attorneys and other stakeholders.
  • Conduct outgoing periodic follow-up on case status and payment.
  • Perform basic and advanced levels of document review to identify current case status, legal research, and case management, and ensure case progress through the workflow.
  • Prioritize case events and critical case payment/recovery issues, while meeting, various internal and legal deadlines that are revenue impacting.
  • Compile, analyze, and make conclusions about case information and status from multiple sources.
  • Meet department objective standards for Customer Service.

WE EXPECT FROM YOU:

  • Minimum 5 years administering Microsoft and VDI infrastructure.
  • Hands-on participation in at least one completed Active Directory domain or forest migration, including migrating objects between domains and forests with minimal downtime.

  • Active Directory: multi-domain AD DS - domains, forests, trusts, replication, FSMO, DFS, GPO, delegation, Kerberos/NTLM, auditing, and deploying new DCs.

  • PKI: AD CS - templates, auto-enrolment, revocation, renewal, TLS lifecycle.

  • Google Workspace / GCP: Workspace tenants — domains, groups, SSO/OAuth, domain-wide delegation, admin and billing, GWS backup; GCP projects.

  • AWS, Azure, or GCP experience.

  • SAN/iSCSI block storage administration

  • ITIL Foundation or another service management certification.

WHAT DO WE OFFER:

  • Vacation 28 calendar days per year;

This can be spent on self-purchase of health insurance or on doctor’s fees for yourself and close relatives (spouse, children);

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Pathology Sr. Director

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. Amgen is seeking a Pathology Senior Director, within the Discovery and Toxicologic Pathology of Translational Safety Regulatory Science function. The role has a focus digital pathology to accelerate the execution of computational pathology workflows inclusive of AI/ML model development discovery programs.

This role is responsible for ensuring the reliable execution of computational pathology workflows, including FAIR data curation, quality control, and analysis activities. The position plays a key role in ensuring that imaging data, metadata, annotations, and analysis outputs are fit for purpose for AI development and scientific biologic conviction.

The ideal pathologist candidate will have experience managing and interpreting pathology datasets and the ability to coordinate effectively across diverse stakeholders in a dynamic research environment consisting of pathology laboratory scientists, pathologists, bioinformatics, data science, translational sciences, and therapeutic area teams.

In addition, the candidate will also function as a project pathologist and be responsible for supporting the advancement of our pipeline by designing, executing, and interpreting toxicology studies, assessing safety risks, and contributing to project strategy across all phases of Research and Development, as well as for marketed products.   • Stay informed about emerging data management practices, digital pathology technologies, and AI data standards.

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part-time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health

“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

jobs.excerpt: Role PurposeThe Head of Information Security & Enterprise Risk Management is a senior executive responsible for designing, governing, and continuously strengthening an enterprise-wide cyber security, information risk, and technology risk framework across a complex, multi-business, multi-technology environment.
jobs.description:
Role Purpose

The Head of Information Security & Enterprise Risk Management is a senior executive responsible for designing, governing, and continuously strengthening an enterprise-wide cyber security, information risk, and technology risk framework across a complex, multi-business, multi-technology environment.

This role requires deep specialization in advanced cyber security architecture, global regulatory compliance, and large-scale risk governance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Enterprise Information Security Leadership

  • Design and own the enterprise-wide information security strategy, aligned with global standards (ISO, NIST, COBIT) and evolving threat landscapes
  • Establish and govern security architecture across on-premise, cloud, hybrid, OT, and IoT environments
  • Act as the final authority on cyber risk acceptance, escalation, and mitigation

2. Cyber Risk & Threat Management

  • Lead advanced cyber threat intelligence, attack simulation, and incident response programs
  • Oversee Security Operations Center (SOC) models, including SIEM, SOAR, threat hunting, and forensic investigations
  • Lead crisis response for major cyber incidents, ransomware events, or data breaches

3. Enterprise Risk Management (Technology & Digital Risk)

  • Integrate technology risk, cyber risk, data risk, and third-party risk into the broader ERM framework
  • Conduct quantitative cyber risk assessments (e.g., FAIR methodology)
  • Present risk scenarios and financial impact modeling to the Board and Executive Committee

4. Regulatory, Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure compliance with global and cross-border regulations, including:
    • GDPR, ISO 27001/27701
    • NIST CSF, PCI-DSS
    • Industry-specific cyber regulations (financial, infrastructure, utilities, real estate, etc.)
  • Lead internal and external audits related to information security and technology risk
  • Serve as the primary regulatory and auditor counterpart for cyber and IT risk matters

5. Third-Party & Supply Chain Risk

  • Establish governance for vendor cyber risk, cloud service providers, MSPs, and offshore partners
  • Oversee due diligence, contract security clauses, and continuous monitoring programs

6. Leadership & Capability Building

  • Build and mentor a highly specialized security and risk team (security architects, GRC experts, SOC analysts)
  • Develop long-term cyber capability uplift programs
  • Serve as trusted advisor to CEO, Board, and Group Executives

Required Qualifications (Highly Specialized)

Education

  • Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or Engineering
  • Masters Degree in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, Risk Management, or related field (strongly preferred)

Mandatory Global Certifications

Candidates must possess multiple of the following:

  • CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
  • CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)
  • CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor)
  • CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control)
  • ISO 27001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor
  • Cloud Security Certifications (CCSP, AWS/Azure Security Specializations)

Experience Requirements

  • 15+ years of progressive experience in:
    • Information Security
    • Cyber Risk Management
    • Enterprise Technology Risk
  • Minimum 7–10 years in a regional or global leadership role
  • Proven leadership across large, complex organizations (multi-entity, multi-system, multi-jurisdiction)

The role requires hands-on experience in:

  • Designing enterprise-scale cyber security programs across:
    • Cloud, on-premise, hybrid, OT, and legacy systems
  • Leading major cyber incident response at enterprise or regional level
  • Implementing global security frameworks across multiple countries
  • Presenting cyber risk in financial and strategic terms to Boards
  • Managing cross-border data privacy and regulatory compliance

Behavioral & Leadership Competencies

  • Board-level gravitas and executive presence
  • Ability to translate deep technical risk into business language
  • Strong crisis leadership and decision-making under pressure
  • Proven mentor and builder of local capability

Job Title: Network Engineer

Reports to: Manager of Cloud Operations

Job Summary

The Infrastructure Services team provides systems engineering and operational support for network-based server and software. The Network Engineer designs, manages, and administers networks and systems, including servers (physical and virtual). Responsibilities include assessment, design, implementation, configuration, documentation, coordination, control, maintenance, troubleshooting, security, usage monitoring, and the development of specialized procedures for systems. This role is also responsible for capacity planning, tuning, system monitoring, system performance, and problem resolution across all aspects of the infrastructure.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, maintain, and manage network devices (including firewalls, switches, wireless), servers, and their associated operating systems.
  • Evaluate and recommend procurement of network devices, servers, peripheral equipment, and systems monitoring/alerting software.
  • Investigate problems, identify their source, determine possible solutions, test, and implement solutions.
  • Guide complex issues from identification to resolution across different departments, clients, employees, and systems.
  • Troubleshoot networks, systems, and applications to identify and correct malfunctions and other operational difficulties.
  • Investigate, recommend, and install enhancements and operating procedures that optimize network/system availability.
  • Document system problems and resolutions for future reference.
  • Participate in and contribute to the planning and execution of business continuity and disaster recovery capabilities.
  • Contribute meaningfully to organizational processes, teams, and products.
  • Adhere to organizational processes and procedures.
  • Work independently while also collaborating effectively as a team member.
  • Exhibit initiative and drive to complete tasks promptly, while adapting to change management processes with proper planning.
  • Communicate effectively with clients, internal teams, and leadership.
  • Demonstrate leadership qualities and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
  • Complete special projects or other duties as assigned.
  • Availability for occasional off-hour, evening, weekend, and overtime work is required.
  • Participation in a cyclic on-call rotation and carrying an on-call phone is required.
  • Occasional travel to remote data centers within the United States is required.
  • Assist in the migration of on-premises systems to AWS.
  • Design and implement AWS architecture solutions that meet business requirements, including potential use of Infrastructure as Code.
  • Set up and manage monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions using AWS CloudWatch, AWS Config, and third-party tools.
  • Ensure cloud infrastructure complies with security standards and best practices.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to AWS infrastructure and applications.
  • Experience with the use of VMware ESXi, vCenter, and vSphere.
  • Palo Alto Firewall administration.
  • Experience with Cisco devices, including Nexus core switches and perimeter defense mechanisms. Cisco certification is a plus.
  • Knowledge of TCP/IP-based LANs, VLANs, iSCSI and Fiber Channel SANs, and VPNs.
  • Familiarity with current Red Hat/CentOS Linux operating systems is a plus.
  • Experience in systems monitoring and management in a high-availability data center environment.
  • Understanding of federal IT standards, guidelines, and programs such as NIST, DISA, and DIACAP/RMF.
  • Experience optimizing cloud resources for performance and cost efficiency.
  • Experience implementing AWS IAM policies and securing AWS environments is a plus.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, and Ansible is a plus.
  • Experience with vulnerability management programs and patch management.
  • Ability to think and act independently to resolve complex systems issues.
  • Ability to provide technical and professional leadership, guidance, and training to others.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience with designing, implementing, maintaining, scaling, and capacity management.
  • Bachelors degree from an accredited college or university in a related field or equivalent work experience.
  • Two or more industry-standard job-related certifications are preferred.
  • Ability to stand and sit for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to lift up to 10 lbs.

Ces produits fournissent des valeurs de glucose précises et fiables et aident les patients ainsi que les professionnels de santé à mieux gérer le diabète.

Sa mission principale consiste à fournir une expertise médico-scientifique en diabétologie et à assurer des formations médicales de haute qualité sur les technologies de surveillance du glucose par capteur (FreeStyle Libre™) en Suisse.

L’objectif central du poste est de soutenir les équipes de traitement du diabète afin qu’elles puissent tirer pleinement parti des systèmes CGM pour leurs populations de patients. Le rôle inclut également la transmission crédible d’informations scientifiques ainsi que le dialogue professionnel avec les acteurs de santé dans la zone géographique attribuée.

Le poste requiert une collaboration étroite et conforme avec les équipes commerciales, tout en garantissant une indépendance médicale totale et une intégrité scientifique maximale.

  • Planifier, coordonner et animer des programmes internes de formation et de perfectionnement sur des sujets médico-scientifiques

  • Développer et entretenir un réseau comprenant sociétés savantes, leaders d’opinion (KOLs), médecins et autres professionnel·le·s de santé pertinents
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Medical Affairs d’ADC en DACH, EMEAP et au niveau global
  • Organiser des programmes médico-scientifiques pour des congrès locaux, y compris la réalisation de présentations spécialisées
  • Soutenir la sélection et la mise en œuvre d’éléments et d’événements spécifiques de la FreeStyle Academy™

  • Expérience dans l’industrie pharmaceutique ou des dispositifs médicaux

  • Ausgeprägte Team‑ und Stakeholder‑Orientierung, verbunden mit einem hohen Maß an Eigeninitiative, Energie und Gestaltungswillen

You will investigate and maintain property claims, secure information, review coverages, complete field inspections, and settle claims. You will occasionally handle desk claims. This is a fully remote/work from home role where you will spend 80% of your time in the field. On occasion you may be asked to travel to an office location for in person engagement activities such as team meetings, training and culture events. Relocation support offered for eligible candidates. You will report to the Property Claim Manager. A company fleet vehicle is provided with the position and there's an option to use the vehicle for personal use.

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.

deine mission bei ]init[

Als Senior Lead Consultant – Verteidigung & Resilienz (all genders) berätst du unsere Kunden im Umfeld von privaten Verteidigungsunternehmen und sicherheitsnahen öffentlichen Auftraggebern. Du verbindest dein tiefes Verständnis für militärische und behördliche Anforderungen mit deiner Expertise in modernen IT- und Digitalisierungsthemen. Dabei entwickelst du gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden zukunftsfähige resiliente Strategien, Zielbilder und Lösungen – von der Analyse komplexer Herausforderungen bis zur konkreten Umsetzung.

Du bewegst dich sicher an der Schnittstelle zwischen Fachlichkeit, Technologie und Organisation und verstehst es, komplexe technische Zusammenhänge in einen konkreten militärischen oder behördlichen Nutzen zu übersetzen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren Kunden, interdisziplinären Teams und Partnern zusammen und gestaltest aktiv die Weiterentwicklung unserer Leistungen im Bereich Verteidigung & Resilienz.

das gibt es zu tun

  • Du berätst private und öffentliche Kunden aus dem Verteidigungs- und Sicherheitsumfeld bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von hochsicheren Digitalisierungs- und Transformationsvorhaben· Du analysierst komplexe fachliche, organisatorische und technologische Herausforderungen und entwickelst daraus belastbare Lösungsansätze und Zielbilder
  • Du übersetzt militärische Fähigkeiten, operative Anforderungen und strategische Ziele in konkrete digitale Lösungen und technologische Architekturen
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden Strategien, Roadmaps und Konzepte für die Digitalisierung sicherheitsrelevanter Prozesse und Strukturen
  • Du begleitest Projekte von der strategischen Konzeption über die fachliche Ausgestaltung bis hin zur Umsetzung und stellst dabei den konkreten Kundennutzen sicher
  • Du führst Workshops mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern durch und bringst fachliche, technologische und strategische Perspektiven zusammen
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Expert:innen aus Entwicklung, Architektur und Delivery zusammen und übernimmst Verantwortung für die fachliche Qualität der Ergebnisse
  • Du beobachtest technologische und sicherheitspolitische Entwicklungen und leitest daraus relevante Impulse für unsere Kunden und unser Leistungsportfolio ab

das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Beratung, Konzeption oder Steuerung komplexer Digitalisierungs- und IT-Projekte – idealerweise im Verteidigungs-, Sicherheits- oder behördlichen Umfeld
  • Fundiertes Verständnis militärischer Fähigkeitslogiken und kapazitätsorientierter Planung sowie die Fähigkeit, daraus Anforderungen an moderne digitale Lösungen abzuleiten
  • Gutes Verständnis für die Digitalisierung von Führungs- und Einsatzprozessen sowie für Führungsinformationssysteme und deren Integration in bestehende Systemlandschaften
  • Kenntnisse relevanter Technologien und Lösungsansätze in den Bereichen Cybersecurity, Resilienz, Cloud- und Plattformlösungen sowie sichere Kommunikation und Netze
  • Verständnis für Einsatzmöglichkeiten von Drohnen, Sensorik und unbemannten Systemen sowie für das Potenzial von Künstlicher Intelligenz und Datenräumen im militärischen und behördlichen Umfeld
  • Die Fähigkeit, technologische Entwicklungen und komplexe IT-Leistungen in konkrete militärische bzw. behördliche Anforderungen, Anwendungsszenarien und Nutzenpotenziale zu übersetzen
  • Sicheres Auftreten in Kundenworkshops, auf Managementebene und in interdisziplinären Teams sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte adressatengerecht aufzubereiten
  • Hohe Eigeninitiative, strategisches Denken und die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung für Themen, Kunden und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Beratungsportfolios zu übernehmen
  • Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands und Europa je nach Kundenterminlage
  • Plus: eigener Hintergrund durch geleisteten Dienst in der Bundeswehr oder enge berufliche Berührungspunkte mit der Truppe/Organisation
  • Plus: Berührungspunkte mit Themen wie VS-NfD/Geheimschutz, Sicherheitsüberprüfungen (SÜG) oder vergleichbare Arbeit in regulierten Umfeldern
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit

das bieten wir dir

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.
  • Work with us: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten - immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten.
  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings, Zertifizierungen und bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Ride with us: JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein.
  • Start with us: Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen.

werde teil des teams

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft - in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.
Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit sind für uns selbstverständlich. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung und Gleichstellung begrüßen wir ausdrücklich.

Da uns und unseren Kund:innen Sicherheit wichtig ist, kann je nach Position nach einer Zusage eine vertrauliche Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich sein.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewThe Engagement and Ownership Culture Senior Manager is a key leadership role responsible for shaping and executing Cotiviti’s strategic vision for broad-based employee ownership through the Prosperiti program and driving enterprise-wide engagement.
jobs.description:
Overview

The Engagement and Ownership Culture Senior Manager is a key leadership role responsible for shaping and executing Cotiviti’s strategic vision for broad-based employee ownership through the Prosperiti program and driving enterprise-wide engagement. This position champions the ownership mindset, operationalizes the four Prosperiti pillars (Own It, Track It, Boost It, Dream It), leads education and communications, and owns the enterprise engagement program. The Senior Manager collaborates with senior business leaders, HR, and other stakeholders to design and implement innovative initiatives, foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement, and provide thought leadership across the enterprise.

Responsibilities

Champion Cotiviti’s Ownership Mindset:

  • Lead initiatives that reinforce Cotiviti’s ownership culture, including accountability, proactiveness, customer focus, collaboration, excellence, openness, entrepreneurial spirit, financial awareness, resilience, and adaptability.

Operationalize the Four Pillars of Prosperiti:

  • Design and implement programming to support Own It, Track It, Boost It, and Dream It.
  • Oversee the Boost It Idea Challenge, including technology enhancements, reporting improvements, and reviewer team coordination.
  • Ensure transparent sharing of progress against business priorities through regular communications and events.
  • Refine and expand methods for employee feedback and idea submission.

Support Prosperiti-related Education:

  • Coordinate and deliver education and training on the Prosperiti program for new hires, managers, and employees requiring refreshers, ensuring ongoing understanding and engagement with ownership principles.

Drive Strategic Communications and Engagement:

  • Prepare impactful materials for board and executive discussions, translating Prosperiti program outcomes into strategic insights.
  • Lead storytelling and recognition initiatives to highlight ownership success stories and best practices.
  • Drive enterprise-wide engagement campaigns to increase awareness and contribution to Prosperiti.

Own and Administer the Enterprise Engagement Program:

  • Lead the planning, execution, and analysis of enterprise-wide engagement surveys (e.g., Glint), ensuring robust participation and accurate data collection.
  • Analyze survey results to identify key trends, strengths, and opportunities; synthesize findings into clear recommendations and drive enterprise-level action planning.

Facilitate Team Effectiveness Sessions:

  • Design and deliver team effectiveness workshops and interventions, supporting leaders and teams in building trust, collaboration, and high performance across the organization.

Partner with Leaders to Improve Engagement and Team Dynamics:

  • Collaborate with business and HR leaders to address engagement opportunities, implement targeted solutions, and monitor progress against action plans.

Establish and Monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • Define and track KPIs to assess the effectiveness of Prosperiti and engagement programs and initiatives.

Collaborate with Key Stakeholders:

  • Work closely with HR, Communications, Marketing, and business leaders to align Prosperiti and engagement efforts with talent, organizational effectiveness, and enterprise strategies.

Drive a Culture of Continuous Improvement:

  • Foster a learning and development mindset throughout the organization, leveraging ownership principles to drive innovation and operational excellence.

Lead and Oversee Cross-Functional Projects:

  • Ensure timely completion and successful outcomes for Prosperiti and engagement-related initiatives.

Analyze and Communicate Data Insights:

  • Distill qualitative and quantitative data into actionable insights for senior leaders and stakeholders.

Evaluate Strategies and Programs:

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to measure achievement of established goals and recommend improvements.

Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.

Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.

Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

Education & Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Organizational Development, HumanResources, or a related field.• At least 7 years of experience in program management, employee engagement,organizational development, or a related field.

Technical & Professional Skills:

• Strong knowledge of ownership culture principles, employee engagement strategies, andperformance improvement techniques.• Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing enterprise-wide programs andinitiatives.• Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projectssimultaneously and meet deadlines.• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office products including, but not limited to, Word, Excel,PowerPoint.

Leadership & Communication:

• Strong leadership and influencing skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively withstakeholders at all levels of the organization.• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively conveycomplex information and influence others.• Proven ability to coach and mentor leaders and managers to enhance their effectivenessand drive organizational change.• Strong executive presence, ability to work with senior leaders and executive team.

Analytical & Problem-Solving:

• Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complexorganizational issues and develop innovative solutions.• Demonstrated ability to analyze qualitative and quantitative data, proficient in distilling datainto important insights for senior leaders and colleagues with guidance on action planning.

Other Skills & Attributes:

• Strong business acumen and the ability to align Prosperiti efforts with strategic businessgoals.• Familiarity with HR practices and policies, including talent management, performancemanagement, and employee engagement.• Ability to immediately establish credibility with colleagues, managers, senior executivesand build relationships yet retain ability to execute autonomously.• Strong work ethic, client focused; willingness to take ownership for wide-rangingresponsibilities; creative thinker on how to provide the highest level of service and optimaloutcome.• Flexibility to work efficiently with global team members across time zones.• Highly collaborative and consultative approach with the ability to quickly build strong andtrusted relationships across all different levels and business functions.

Cognitive / Mental Requirements:

• Proven ability to coach and mentor leaders and managers to enhance their effectiveness anddrive organizational change.• Comfortable and effective working with senior-level stakeholders across the organization.• Skilled at synthesizing qualitative and quantitative data into insights with actionablerecommendations.• Highly collaborative and consultative with the ability to build trusted relationships at all levels.• Strong work ethic and ownership mindset; able to execute independently while contributing tobroader team objectives.• Creative and strategic thinker who balances service orientation with strong execution discipline.• Strong program management expertise with solid experience creating innovative and connectedcareer development strategies that enable a team-based global workforce.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

• Flexibility to collaborate with global team members across time zones.• Ability to travel as needed.• Ability to remain in a stationary position (sitting or standing) for prolonged periods.• Frequent use of hands and fingers for keyboard and computer use.• Must have a secure, dedicated work area.• Must have high-speed internet access and maintain home office setup• Must be able to provide high-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup andmaintenance.

Base compensation ranges from $106,000 to $157,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

Since this job will be based remotely, all interviews will be conducted virtually.

Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 11/18/2026, but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

jobs.description:
Job Title

Contractor Engineering Content Developer - PE Mechanical HVAC

Job Description

About Us

Kaplan is one of the world’s largest and most diverse education providers. With 80+ years of history, Kaplan has been a beacon for expanding educational access and a leader in instructional innovation.

Role

We are seeking remote Subject Matter Experts with a PE in Mechanical Engineering (HVAC focus) to join Kaplan's engineering team in updating our material to prepare students for the Principles of Practice of Engineering (PE) examination, specifically the Mechanical HVAC discipline. This role will focus on revising our review manual, practice problem books, practice exams, and quiz bank to align with the new PE Mechanical HVAC exam specifications taking effect in October 2025. This is a remote contract (1099) opportunity with flexible hours (up to 20 per week).

Responsibilities

The responsibilities of the Contractor may include:

  • Reviewing and updating quiz questions and practice exam questions in the style of NCEES examinations to reflect the upcoming exam changes.

  • Revising and editing content within the mechanical/HVAC engineering discipline for the PE exam, ensuring accuracy and relevance to the new specifications.

  • Collaborating with our team to ensure all materials are up-to-date and comprehensive for the October 2025 exam changes.

  • Potentially contributing to suggested study plans and providing feedback on customer expectations for study and preparation related to the Mechanical HVAC exam.

  • Performing quality assurance reviews and technical reviews of updated content.

Skill Requirements

The candidate must:

  • Have excellent command of the English language - both verbal and written.

  • Possess an active PE Certification issued by NCEES in Mechanical Engineering with a focus or experience in HVAC.

  • Have strong familiarity with the content covered in the PE Mechanical HVAC exam.

  • Have exceptional attention to detail, organization skills, and time management skills, especially regarding upcoming deadlines for content updates.

  • Provide prompt and responsive communication, mostly by email. Occasional video chat meetings during business hours may be required.

  • Be highly motivated and take initiative proactively in identifying areas for content updates.

  • Be receptive to feedback, meet deadlines, and take accountability for deliverables.

Preferred Skills

  • Have experience developing or reviewing educational content, especially for engineering exams in the HVAC discipline.

  • Have prior experience with curriculum development or technical writing related to mechanical engineering or HVAC topics.

  • Have familiarity with the upcoming changes to the PE Mechanical HVAC exam specifications.

  • Have experience tutoring/mentoring/educating engineering students or colleagues in mechanical engineering or HVAC.

  • Have experience creating multiple-choice questions, study materials, PowerPoint presentations, or other similar content in the engineering field.

Hours & Employment

This is a contract (1099) position. Projects will be assigned via separate contracts with discrete schedules and deliverables related to the update of our PE Mechanical HVAC exam preparation materials. There is no set working schedule or hours other than project deadlines as assigned.

Equipment Required

Contractors must supply their own equipment and must have installed:

  • Microsoft Word

  • Adobe Reader or Professional

  • MathType

Pay is per project based on contractor availability and experience, typically equivalent to $25-$50 per hour.

Location

Remote/Nationwide, USA

Additional Locations

Employee Type

Contingent Worker

Job Functional Area

Other Admin Staff

Business Unit

Diversity & Inclusion Statement:

Kaplan is committed to cultivating an inclusive workplace that values diversity, promotes equity, and integrates inclusivity into all aspects of our operations. We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status, nationality, or sex. We believe that diversity strengthens our organization, fuels innovation, and improves our ability to serve our students, customers, and communities. Learn more about our culturehere.

Kaplan considers qualified applicants for employment even if applicants have an arrest or conviction in their background check records. Kaplan complies with related background check regulations, including but not limited to, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. There are various positions where certain convictions may disqualify applicants, such as those positions requiring interaction with minors, financial records, or other sensitive and/or confidential information.

Kaplan is a drug-free workplace and complies with applicable laws.

jobs.excerpt: You will be a practitioner on our telehealth platform 'Intellect', where your role is to support our clients' mental health and personal growth based on the individual needs and goals.
jobs.description:
You will be a practitioner on our telehealth platform 'Intellect', where your role is to support our clients' mental health and personal growth based on the individual needs and goals. This is delivered primarily through scheduled 60-minute video sessions on our platform.

This is a freelance remote role with the flexibility to decide your business hours. Local candidates are preferred but others can still be considered. This role is a great opportunity to supplement your current job or private practice.

We're seeking to partner with Clinical Psychologists and Counsellors to be part of a community working collaboratively to bring greater mental health access to the public to provide mental health coaching

What You'll Do

  • Provide 1-on-1 telehealth/or onsite mental health support for Intellect’s clients
  • Focus on clinical cases such as depression, anxiety, trauma, schizophrenia, eating disorders, addiction etc.
  • Collaboratively work with the internal clinical team by suggesting improvements to the program and the platform

Requirements

    • Has an active International Coaching Federation Certification OR a Master / Postgraduate Diploma training in Counselling / Clinical Psychology
    • Skilled in coaching techniques and/or evidence-based approaches (e.g. Cognitive Behavioural Therapy, Motivational Interviewing, DBT, SFBT, etc.)
    • ICF Coaches must have at least 200 coaching hours
    • Counsellors and Clinical Psychologists must have at least 300 clinical hours post graduation
    • Candidate must be proficient in English and local language
    • Candidates with prior experience in EAP, counselling working adults or coaching managerial roles are prioritized

Job Description:

Data Analytics Manager

The Data Analytics Manager will lead a remote, cross-functional team of data analysts, systems analysts, and data scientists delivering analytics products, data systems, dashboards, and decision-support tools for federal programs, including initiatives serving refugee, immigrant, and social service populations.

This role combines technical project management, analytics leadership, stakeholder engagement, and systems oversight. The manager will guide the development of modern data platforms and products, support automation and advanced visualization, promote predictive and proactive decision-making, and ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with high quality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage delivery of data and analytics projects, including dashboards, data products, reports, documentation, platform enhancements, and system upgrades.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, resource plans, deliverable schedules, and risk and issue logs.
  • Advise clients and stakeholders on priorities, tradeoffs, resource needs, and delivery timelines.
  • Serve as the primary technical liaison for data, analytics, and reporting initiatives.
  • Lead requirements-gathering sessions, present findings, and review deliverables with senior stakeholders.
  • Translate business, operational, and policy questions into effective analytical approaches and data products.
  • Oversee the design and deployment of Tableau and/or Power BI dashboards that provide actionable insights and support self-service analytics.
  • Lead scalable data preparation, integration, and automation efforts using tools such as SQL, R, Python, Tableau Prep, ETL/ELT tools, and Databricks.
  • Guide the use of statistical methods, modeling techniques, geospatial analysis, and advanced visualization to answer complex program questions.
  • Validate models, metrics, and analytical approaches to ensure accuracy and relevance.
  • Foster innovation by piloting new tools, modernizing workflows, and promoting continuous improvement.
  • Lead and mentor a geographically distributed team of senior analysts and data scientists.
  • Provide technical direction, performance guidance, and support for staff development.
  • Promote strong practices in data intake, validation, analysis, visualization, documentation, and dissemination.
  • Ensure rigorous quality assurance for dashboards, datasets, reports, and technical documentation.
  • Oversee metadata, data dictionaries, and reference documentation to support data governance, transparency, and reuse.
  • Coordinate recurring leadership reporting, cross-program analyses, and urgent or ad hoc data requests.
  • Stay current on emerging analytics, visualization, and data platform tools and recommend adoption where appropriate.

Required Education

Bachelor’s degree in a technical, quantitative, or related field, such as Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Economics, or Public Policy with a quantitative focus.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience interpreting and analyzing quantitative and qualitative data in complex environments.
  • 3+ years managing data, analytics, business intelligence, product, or technical projects; Agile or iterative delivery experience preferred.
  • 3+ years of supervisory, team lead, project management, program management, or product management experience.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with remote, cross-functional teams.
  • U.S. Citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced SQL and proficiency in at least one scripting or statistical language, such as R or Python.
  • Deep Tableau experience required; Power BI experience preferred.
  • Experience designing and deploying interactive dashboards and self-service analytics solutions.
  • Strong understanding of relational and non-relational databases and modern data modeling.
  • Experience with Databricks.
  • Applied experience with statistical analysis and modeling in policy, program, or operational decision-support settings.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT, data preparation, and production or enterprise data workflows.
  • Experience with geospatial data, mapping, or spatial analysis preferred.
  • Proficiency with Agile collaboration and tracking tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Familiarity with cloud environments, including AWS, preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting federal programs, especially programs involving refugee, immigrant, or social service populations.
  • Experience working as a contractor or consultant in a federal government environment.

Location: Remote, Eastern Time

Clearance: U.S. Citizenship required; ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance

Work Environment

This is a fully remote position aligned to Eastern Time. Occasional extended hours or weekend work may be required to support mission-critical needs. The role requires close collaboration with federal stakeholders, internal technical teams, and partner organizations supporting high-priority analytics and data systems.

The likely salary range for this position is $119,000 - $161,000. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

40

Total Rewards at GDIT:

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. The GDIT Paid Family Leave program provides a total of up to 160 hours of paid leave in a rolling 12 month period for eligible employees. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.

Our Identity Verification Process:

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during virtual interviews. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. By proceeding, you authorize the collection, processing, and use of your biometric data for identity verification and security purposes.

We are GDIT. jobs.description:
Porch Group is a leading vertical software and insurance platform and is positioned to be the best partner to help homebuyers move, maintain, and fully protect their homes. We offer differentiated products and services, with homeowners insurance at the center of this relationship. We differentiate and look to win in the massive and growing homeowners insurance opportunity by 1) providing the best services for homebuyers, 2) led by advantaged underwriting in insurance, 3) to protect the whole home.

As a leader in the home services software-as-a-service (“SaaS”) space, we’ve built deep relationships with approximately 30 thousand companies that are key to the home-buying transaction, such as home inspectors, mortgage companies, and title companies.

In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED.

Job Title: National Account Manager

Location: United States  

Workplace Type: Remote 

The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we’d love for you to be a part of it as ourNational Account Manager.

Homeowners of America, (A Porch Group Company) is a leading provider of homeowners insurance, committed to offering high-quality, comprehensive coverage to our customers. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional customer service and innovative insurance solutions tailored to meet the needs of our policyholders.

What You Will Do As A National Account Manager

  • Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with national and regional agency groups.

  • Serve as the primary liaison between HOA/Porch and our largest agency groups, networks, franchises, and aggregators.

  • Develop and execute tailored account plans to grow product distribution, shelf space, and market share within key accounts.

  • Collaborate with partners to achieve premium growth, agent engagement, and retention goals.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to agency partners, providing solutions to challenges, identifying opportunities for operational improvements, and enhancing partner satisfaction.

  • Monitor industry trends, competitor activity, and market conditions. Provide insights and recommendations to senior leadership to refine strategies and offerings.

  • Work closely with internal teams, including underwriting, marketing, and operations, to ensure seamless execution of strategies and fulfillment of partner needs.

  • Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs), including premium growth, agency performance, and profitability. Use data to inform decision-making and optimize account management strategies.

  • Provide training and resources to agency partners to help them succeed with HOA/Porch products. Support their efforts to onboard and develop sub-agents.

What You Will Bring As A National Account Manager

We're hiring a mid-senior Project Manager (Shopify) on a remote monthly retainer. This is for an agency PM who has managed projects for Shopify store builds and theme development: the kind of PM who works at an agency serving different merchants and brands, building and maintaining Shopify solutions across many client accounts. You'll deal with the end client, manage the internal team, run multiple Shopify projects at once, and bring a solid understanding of how Shopify is structured and how it works. If that matches how you've worked, we want to talk.

About Us

Bolder Apps is a product development studio that partners with US-based startups and established companies to build and scale innovative digital products. We specialize in AI-powered development, full-cycle product creation, and engineering team augmentation. Our mission is simple: build bolder, faster, and smarter.

Our Culture & Values (read before applying)

We move fast. We take ownership. We work with AI, not against it. And we expect everyone to bring ideas, not wait for instructions.

There are no daily checklists, no micromanagement, and no corporate politics. Instead, you'll have autonomy, trust, and a team that's always ready to help you grow. At Bolder Apps, impact matters more than titles, and curiosity matters more than seniority.

If you want a place where you can level up fast and actually see your work making a difference - welcome aboard.

Responsibilities

  • Manage Shopify store build and theme development projects for client merchants and brands, often several at the same time
  • Be the day-to-day owner facing the end client: scope, timelines, status, and hard trade-offs in clear English
  • Manage the internal team (developers, designers, QA) so tickets, priorities, and blockers stay honest
  • Translate merchant and brand goals into phased Shopify work that the team can actually ship
  • Use real Shopify literacy (themes, apps, checkout, content, go-live constraints) to challenge fake estimates and spot launch risk early
  • Run kickoff through launch for store builds and ongoing theme maintenance across different brands
  • Keep US clients updated in writing and on live calls during agreed Eastern Time overlap
  • Use AI tools to draft plans, tickets, status updates, and risk notes, then review the output yourself before it reaches a client
  • Leave clean handoff docs so another PM or engineer can pick up without archaeology

Requirements

  • Agency Shopify PM experience. You have managed projects for Shopify store builds and theme development inside an agency that serves different merchants and brands, not only one internal store.
  • Volume and multi-project. You have run as many Shopify client projects as you can honestly claim, often more than one brand at a time, and kept deadlines honest.
  • End-client ownership. Comfortable dealing directly with merchants, founders, or brand stakeholders. You explain trade-offs without blaming the team.
  • Internal team leadership. You manage developers and designers day to day: clear tickets, clear owners, clear status.
  • Shopify literacy. Solid understanding of how Shopify is structured and how it works (themes vs apps vs checkout, content freezes, launch windows). You do not need to write Liquid, but you know what good Shopify delivery looks like.
  • Delivery tools. Comfortable with Jira, Linear, Notion, Asana, or similar.
  • AI-augmented workflow. You use ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or similar to move faster on plans and communication, and you catch when the draft is wrong for the client.
  • English at C1 or above. Client calls and written updates go out in your voice.
  • US hours overlap. Available through roughly 5 PM EST for live client coordination.
  • Ownership habits. Honest timelines, early blockers, finished launches. No disappearing acts.

Benefits

  • Fully remote and async-friendly, with required overlap through ~5 PM EST for client sessions
  • Monthly retainer structure with recurring Shopify client work for PMs who keep multi-brand launches calm
  • Real autonomy over how you structure delivery and communication. We do not hand you a rigid playbook
  • Direct line to developers, designers, and decision-makers
  • Tooling budget for the PM and AI tools you need to move fast
  • A peer network of product-minded builders across overlapping client projects

  • Program Analytics & Optimization: Establish performance measures and reporting requirements, leveraging patient and operational insights to identify barriers, optimize program effectiveness, and improve patient outcomes over time.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership & Launch Readiness: Partner with Market Access, Patient Access Support Operations, Finance, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Data & Technology teams to ensure compliant implementation, operational readiness, and successful execution of patient support and affordability programs.

Education:

jobs.description:
Sales Development Representative (SDR) – Outbound Sales & Lead Generation | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Department: Sales / Business Development

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a motivated Sales Development Representative (SDR) to generate qualified sales opportunities through proactive outbound prospecting.

You’ll identify potential customers, research decision-makers, start conversations, qualify prospects, and book meetings for the sales team. This is a hands-on outbound sales role for someone comfortable using cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn prospecting, and structured follow-up sequences to build a consistent pipeline.

If you’re confident starting conversations with new prospects, comfortable working toward measurable KPIs, and motivated by generating qualified meetings, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Outbound Prospecting

  • Prospect potential customers through:
    • Cold calling
    • Email outreach
    • LinkedIn
    • Other outbound channels
  • Research target companies and relevant decision-makers
  • Identify prospects who align with the target customer profile
  • Personalize outreach where appropriate to improve engagement
  • Start conversations with potential customers and generate interest
  • Maintain consistent prospecting activity throughout the week
  • Execute structured outreach and follow-up sequences

Lead Qualification

  • Engage prospects to understand their needs and potential fit
  • Qualify opportunities based on factors such as:
    • Need
    • Budget
    • Authority
    • Timing
  • Ask effective discovery and qualification questions
  • Identify genuine sales opportunities before handing them to Account Executives
  • Distinguish between prospects requiring additional nurturing and those ready for a sales conversation
  • Maintain clear qualification notes for the sales team

Appointment Setting

  • Book qualified meetings for Account Executives
  • Clearly communicate the purpose and value of the scheduled conversation
  • Confirm relevant prospect information before handoff
  • Coordinate meeting scheduling between prospects and the sales team
  • Maintain consistent follow-up to reduce missed opportunities
  • Support a smooth transition from prospecting to the next stage of the sales process

CRM & Pipeline Management

  • Maintain accurate prospect and activity records in the CRM
  • Document:
    • Calls
    • Emails
    • LinkedIn outreach
    • Prospect responses
    • Qualification information
    • Follow-up activity
    • Meeting outcomes
  • Keep lead statuses and next steps current
  • Maintain organized prospect records
  • Ensure qualified opportunities are properly handed off
  • Use CRM data to manage daily priorities and follow-up activity

Sales Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing on outreach messaging
  • Share prospect feedback and recurring objections
  • Identify messaging and approaches generating stronger responses
  • Coordinate with Account Executives on qualified opportunities
  • Help improve prospecting and qualification processes
  • Maintain clear communication around prospect handoffs and meeting quality

Requirements

  • 1+ year of experience as an SDR, BDR, Appointment Setter, or in a similar outbound sales role
  • Hands-on experience with outbound prospecting
  • Comfortable making high-volume outbound calls
  • Experience with cold email and LinkedIn prospecting
  • Strong spoken and written English
  • Strong communication and objection-handling skills
  • Experience using CRM and sales engagement platforms
  • Ability to research companies and decision-makers
  • Experience qualifying prospects and booking meetings
  • Strong follow-up and organizational skills
  • Results-driven and comfortable working against measurable KPIs
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours

Ideal Experience & Skills

  • Experience in B2B outbound sales
  • Experience working with U.S.-based prospects or decision-makers
  • Experience executing multi-channel prospecting campaigns
  • Familiarity with structured sales sequences and cadences
  • Experience consistently meeting appointment-setting or meeting-booked targets
  • Strong cold-calling confidence
  • Ability to navigate common prospect objections
  • Experience collaborating directly with Account Executives
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, performance-driven sales environment

Tools & Technology

CRM Platforms | Sales Engagement Platforms | LinkedIn | Email Outreach Tools | Phone & Dialing Systems | Lead Research Tools | Calendar & Scheduling Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Are confident starting conversations with people who have never heard from you before
  • Are comfortable making high-volume cold calls
  • Can communicate clearly and confidently in English
  • Enjoy outbound prospecting and lead generation
  • Know how to ask effective qualification questions
  • Can handle objections without becoming discouraged
  • Are persistent and disciplined with follow-up
  • Keep your CRM organized and up to date
  • Are motivated by measurable targets
  • Take ownership of your daily prospecting activity
  • Can maintain consistency even when prospects do not respond immediately
  • Understand that qualified meetings matter more than simply maximizing activity

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing your prospecting list, follow-up tasks, and scheduled outreach activities.

Throughout the day, you’ll research target companies and decision-makers, make outbound calls, send emails, connect with prospects through LinkedIn, and follow up with previous conversations.

As prospects engage, you’ll qualify them based on their needs, budget, authority, and timing before scheduling appropriate opportunities with Account Executives.

You’ll also update the CRM, maintain accurate activity records, and collaborate with Sales and Marketing on messaging and prospect feedback.

In short: you create qualified sales opportunities by consistently finding, engaging, qualifying, and converting prospects into meetings for the sales team.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Qualified meetings booked
  • Outbound calls completed
  • Email and LinkedIn outreach activity
  • Prospect response rates
  • Lead-to-meeting conversion rate
  • Meeting qualification quality
  • Consistency of prospect follow-up
  • CRM accuracy and completeness
  • Achievement of weekly and monthly activity targets
  • Achievement of meeting-booked KPIs

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means consistently generating qualified meetings, maintaining strong outbound activity and response rates, keeping accurate CRM records, following up reliably with prospects, and consistently achieving established sales KPIs.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct ownership of outbound prospecting and pipeline generation
  • Multi-channel selling across phone, email, and LinkedIn
  • Opportunity to strengthen cold-calling and qualification skills
  • Clear, measurable performance expectations
  • Close collaboration with Account Executives and Marketing
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior SDR
    • Business Development Representative (BDR)
    • SDR Team Lead
    • Account Executive
    • Sales Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screening Call
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Sales Development Representative, BDR, Appointment Setter, or Outbound Sales professional who is confident with cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn prospecting, lead qualification, and appointment setting, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help build a consistent pipeline of qualified sales opportunities.
